response: {"headword":"abandon","explanation":"動詞「放棄、拋棄」。常用於指放棄某物、某地、某人或某種行為。注意其名詞形是 abandonment。在寫作中，常與 hope, plan, dream 等搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hikers had to <abandon> their attempt to reach the summit due to the sudden severe weather conditions.","translation":"由於突如其來的惡劣天氣，登山者不得不放棄登頂的嘗試。","explanation":"動詞「放棄」。常用於放棄計畫、嘗試或希望。"},{"sentence":"Many people were forced to <abandon> their homes and seek refuge in safer areas after the devastating earthquake.","translation":"在毀滅性的地震之後，許多人被迫拋棄家園，到更安全的地區尋求庇護。","explanation":"動詞「拋棄」。指離開某地或某物，通常是因為危險或必要。"},{"sentence":"Despite facing numerous challenges, she refused to <abandon> her dream of becoming a doctor and continued to study diligently.","translation":"儘管面臨許多挑戰，她仍拒絕放棄成為醫生的夢想，並繼續努力學習。","explanation":"動詞「放棄」。常用於放棄目標、理想或信念。"}],"related_forms":["abandonment"]}

{"headword":"absolute","explanation":"形容詞「絕對的、完全的」。常用於強調某事物的程度或性質是完全的，沒有任何限制或例外。注意其副詞形是 absolutely。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher demanded <absolute> *silence* from the students during the exam to ensure fairness and prevent cheating.","translation":"老師要求學生在考試期間保持絕對安靜，以確保公平並防止作弊。","explanation":"形容詞「絕對的、完全的」。強調程度或狀態的完全性。"},{"sentence":"It's an <absolute> *necessity* for students to develop critical thinking skills to succeed in higher education and future careers.","translation":"學生培養批判性思考能力是絕對必要的，以便在高等教育和未來職業中取得成功。","explanation":"形容詞「絕對的、完全的」。常用於強調某事物的必要性或重要性。"},{"sentence":"The detective had <absolute> *proof* that the suspect was guilty, leaving no room for doubt in the court.","translation":"偵探有嫌疑人有罪的絕對證據，在法庭上沒有留下任何疑點。","explanation":"形容詞「絕對的」。指證據或事實是確鑿無疑的。"}],"related_forms":["absolutely"]}

{"headword":"absorb","explanation":"動詞「吸收」。可指物理上的吸收（如液體、光線），也可指精神上的吸收（如知識、資訊）。常用被動語態 be absorbed in 表示「專心於」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Plants <absorb> sunlight through their leaves to produce energy, a vital process for their growth and survival.","translation":"植物透過葉子吸收陽光來產生能量，這是它們生長和生存的重要過程。","explanation":"動詞「吸收」。指物理上的吸收，如液體、光線或能量。"},{"sentence":"The students were completely <absorbed> *in* the fascinating lecture about ancient civilizations, taking detailed notes.","translation":"學生們完全專心於關於古代文明的精彩講座，並詳細記錄筆記。","explanation":"動詞片語 be absorbed in sth「專心於某事」。常用於描述精神上的專注。"},{"sentence":"It takes time for the human body to <absorb> all the nutrients from food, so a balanced diet is crucial.","translation":"人體需要時間來吸收食物中的所有營養，因此均衡飲食至關重要。","explanation":"動詞「吸收」。指身體吸收物質，如營養或藥物。"}],"related_forms":["absorbed","absorbing","absorption"]}

{"headword":"abstract","explanation":"形容詞「抽象的」。指概念或想法，而非具體的實物。在學術寫作中常用來描述理論、藝術或哲學概念。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many philosophical concepts are quite <abstract>, requiring deep thought and discussion to fully grasp their meaning.","translation":"許多哲學概念都相當抽象，需要深入思考和討論才能完全理解其意義。","explanation":"形容詞「抽象的」。指非具體的概念或想法。"},{"sentence":"The artist's latest exhibition featured <abstract> *paintings* that explored emotions through colors and shapes rather than realistic figures.","translation":"這位藝術家最新的展覽展出了抽象畫作，透過色彩和形狀而非寫實人物來探索情感。","explanation":"形容詞「抽象的」。常用於描述藝術風格，與具象(concrete)相對。"},{"sentence":"It can be challenging for young children to understand <abstract> *ideas* like justice or freedom without concrete examples.","translation":"對於年幼的孩子來說，沒有具體例子很難理解正義或自由等抽象概念。","explanation":"形容詞「抽象的」。強調概念的非物質性。"}],"related_forms":["abstraction"]}

{"headword":"academic","explanation":"形容詞「學術的」。常用於描述與學校、大學、研究或學習相關的事物。注意其名詞形是 academician (院士) 或 academics (學術界人士/學術科目)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university encourages students to participate in <academic> *research* projects to enhance their critical thinking skills.","translation":"大學鼓勵學生參與學術研究計畫，以提升他們的批判性思考能力。","explanation":"形容詞「學術的」。指與學術領域相關的活動或工作。"},{"sentence":"Despite facing personal challenges, she maintained an excellent <academic> *record* throughout her high school years.","translation":"儘管面臨個人挑戰，她在高中時期仍保持著優異的學業成績。","explanation":"形容詞「學術的」。常用於描述學業表現或記錄。"},{"sentence":"The professor published several <academic> *papers* in prestigious journals, contributing significantly to his field of study.","translation":"這位教授在著名期刊上發表了數篇學術論文，對其研究領域做出了重大貢獻。","explanation":"形容詞「學術的」。指與學術寫作或出版物相關。"}],"related_forms":["academically","academy","academician"]}

{"headword":"accent","explanation":"名詞「口音、腔調」。指說話時特有的發音方式，常與地區或語言背景有關。也可指「重音」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Her strong British <accent> made her stand out among the American students during the international exchange program.","translation":"她濃厚的英國口音使她在國際交換計畫中，在美國學生中顯得格外突出。","explanation":"名詞「口音、腔調」。指說話時特有的發音方式。"},{"sentence":"Learning to imitate a native speaker's <accent> can significantly improve one's pronunciation in a foreign language.","translation":"學習模仿母語人士的口音可以顯著提高外語發音。","explanation":"名詞「口音」。強調發音的特徵。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to place the <accent> on the first syllable of the word 'beautiful' when pronouncing it.","translation":"老師要求學生在發音「beautiful」這個詞時，將重音放在第一個音節上。","explanation":"名詞「重音」。指單詞中發音較強的音節。"}],"related_forms":["accented"]}

{"headword":"acceptance","explanation":"名詞「接受、認可」。指對某事物的同意、接納或承認。動詞是 accept。常用於指社會的認可、大學的錄取通知或對現實的接受。","entries":[{"sentence":"Receiving an <acceptance> *letter* from her dream university brought immense joy and relief to the hardworking student.","translation":"收到夢想大學的錄取通知書，給這位努力學習的學生帶來了巨大的喜悅和寬慰。","explanation":"名詞「接受、錄取」。常用於指大學或工作錄取。"},{"sentence":"The new policy faced initial resistance but eventually gained widespread <acceptance> among the community members.","translation":"這項新政策最初遭到抵制，但最終在社區成員中獲得了廣泛的接受。","explanation":"名詞「接受、認可」。指社會或群體對某事物的接納。"},{"sentence":"Learning to find <acceptance> *of* oneself, including flaws and imperfections, is crucial for mental well-being.","translation":"學會接受自己，包括缺點和不完美，對心理健康至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「接受」。指對現實或自身狀況的接納。"}],"related_forms":["accept","acceptable"]}

{"headword":"access","explanation":"名詞「使用權、進入權」或動詞「取得、進入」。作為名詞時，通常不可數，常與 to 搭配。作為動詞時，是及物動詞，後面直接加受詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students need a password to gain <access> *to* the online learning platform and its extensive digital resources.","translation":"學生需要密碼才能使用線上學習平台及其豐富的數位資源。","explanation":"名詞「使用權、進入權」。通常不可數，常與 to 搭配。"},{"sentence":"The researchers were able to <access> a vast amount of historical data from the national archives for their study.","translation":"研究人員能夠從國家檔案館取得大量的歷史數據用於他們的研究。","explanation":"動詞「取得、進入」。作為及物動詞，直接加受詞。"},{"sentence":"Public libraries provide free <access> *to* books and computers, ensuring that everyone can learn and gather information.","translation":"公立圖書館提供免費使用書籍和電腦的權利，確保每個人都能學習和獲取資訊。","explanation":"名詞「使用權」。強調提供使用的機會。"}],"related_forms":["accessible"]}

{"headword":"accidental","explanation":"形容詞「意外的、偶然的」。指非計畫中或非故意的事件。注意其副詞形是 accidentally。","entries":[{"sentence":"The discovery of penicillin was an <accidental> *breakthrough* that revolutionized medicine and saved countless lives.","translation":"青黴素的發現是一項意外的突破，它徹底改變了醫學並拯救了無數生命。","explanation":"形容詞「意外的、偶然的」。指非預期或非故意的事件。"},{"sentence":"He made an <accidental> *discovery* while experimenting in the lab, leading to a new understanding of the chemical reaction.","translation":"他在實驗室做實驗時有了一個意外的發現，導致對化學反應有了新的理解。","explanation":"形容詞「意外的」。強調事件的偶然性。"},{"sentence":"An <accidental> *encounter* with an old friend at the airport led to a delightful reunion and shared memories.","translation":"在機場與一位老朋友的偶然相遇，促成了一次愉快的重逢和共同的回憶。","explanation":"形容詞「偶然的」。指非計畫中的相遇。"}],"related_forms":["accidentally","accident"]}

{"headword":"accompany","explanation":"動詞「陪伴、伴隨」。指與某人同行或某事物與另一事物同時發生。常用於描述人與人之間的陪伴，或事件、現象的伴隨。","entries":[{"sentence":"The principal will <accompany> the students on their field trip to the science museum to ensure their safety.","translation":"校長將陪同學生們前往科學博物館進行戶外教學，以確保他們的安全。","explanation":"動詞「陪伴」。指與某人同行。"},{"sentence":"A sense of excitement and anticipation <accompanied> the announcement of the school's annual sports day.","translation":"學校年度運動會的宣布伴隨著興奮和期待感。","explanation":"動詞「伴隨」。指某事物與另一事物同時發生。"},{"sentence":"The famous singer will be <accompanied> *by* a live orchestra during her upcoming concert tour.","translation":"這位著名歌手在即將到來的巡迴演唱會中將由現場管弦樂團伴奏。","explanation":"動詞「伴奏」。常用被動語態 be accompanied by。"}],"related_forms":["accompaniment"]}

{"headword":"accomplish","explanation":"動詞「達成、完成」；名詞為 accomplishment「成就、完成」。注意兩者的詞性與用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite numerous challenges, the research team managed to <accomplish> their goal of developing a new vaccine within a year.","translation":"儘管面臨許多挑戰，研究團隊仍設法在一年內達成開發新疫苗的目標。","explanation":"動詞「達成、完成」。常用搭配：accomplish a goal/task/mission。主詞通常是人或組織。"},{"sentence":"Graduating with honors was a significant <accomplishment> for her, reflecting years of hard work and dedication to her studies.","translation":"以優異成績畢業對她來說是一項重要的成就，反映了她多年來的努力和對學業的投入。","explanation":"名詞「成就、完成」。常用搭配：a sense of accomplishment (成就感)。"}],"related_forms":["accomplishment","accomplished"]}

{"headword":"accountant","explanation":"名詞「會計師」。指負責處理財務記錄、稅務等專業人員。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company hired a new <accountant> to *manage* their financial records and ensure compliance with tax regulations.","translation":"公司聘請了一位新會計師來管理財務記錄並確保符合稅務法規。","explanation":"名詞「會計師」。負責公司的財務管理和稅務申報。"}],"related_forms":["account","accounting"]}

{"headword":"accuracy","explanation":"名詞「準確性、精確度」。動詞是 be accurate，形容詞是 accurate。","entries":[{"sentence":"Scientists must ensure the <accuracy> *of* their data to avoid misleading conclusions in their research findings.","translation":"科學家必須確保數據的準確性，以避免研究結果出現誤導性結論。","explanation":"名詞「準確性、精確度」。常用搭配：the accuracy of sth。在學術寫作中非常重要。"}],"related_forms":["accurate","accurately"]}

{"headword":"accuse","explanation":"動詞「指控、控告」。固定搭配為 accuse sb of sth。注意介係詞 of。","entries":[{"sentence":"The principal decided to <accuse> the student *of* cheating on the final exam after reviewing the surveillance footage.","translation":"校長在審查監控錄影後，決定指控該學生在期末考作弊。","explanation":"動詞「指控、控告」。固定搭配：accuse sb of sth。常在克漏字測驗中考介係詞 of。"}],"related_forms":["accusation","accused"]}

{"headword":"acid","explanation":"可作名詞「酸」或形容詞「酸性的」。注意其在化學或食物語境中的用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"Lemon juice contains citric <acid>, which gives it its distinctive sour taste and is often used in cooking.","translation":"檸檬汁含有檸檬酸，這賦予它獨特的酸味，並常用於烹飪。","explanation":"名詞「酸」。指一種化學物質，如檸檬酸、硫酸等。"},{"sentence":"The scientist warned that the factory's wastewater was highly <acid> and could severely damage the local ecosystem.","translation":"科學家警告說，工廠的廢水酸性很高，可能會嚴重損害當地生態系統。","explanation":"形容詞「酸性的」。描述物質的性質，通常指pH值低於7。"}],"related_forms":["acidic"]}

{"headword":"acquaintance","explanation":"名詞「熟人」。指認識但不親近的人。常用片語 make one's acquaintance (與某人結識)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although they were not close friends, he considered her a pleasant <acquaintance> whom he often saw at community events.","translation":"儘管他們不是親密的朋友，但他認為她是一位愉快的熟人，他經常在社區活動中見到她。","explanation":"名詞「熟人」。與 friend (朋友) 不同，acquaintance 指的是認識但關係不深的人。"}],"related_forms":["acquaint"]}

{"headword":"acquire","explanation":"動詞「獲得、習得」。通常指透過努力、學習或購買而得到某物或某種能力。","entries":[{"sentence":"Through diligent study and practice, students can <acquire> new knowledge and essential skills for their future careers.","translation":"透過勤奮學習和練習，學生可以習得新知識和未來職業所需的基本技能。","explanation":"動詞「獲得、習得」。常用搭配：acquire knowledge/skills/property。強調過程中的努力。"}],"related_forms":["acquisition"]}

{"headword":"adapt","explanation":"動詞「適應；改編」。常用片語 adapt to sth (適應某事) 和 adapt sth for sth (為某目的改編某物)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After moving to a new country, it took the exchange student some time to <adapt> *to* the local culture and different educational system.","translation":"搬到新國家後，這位交換學生花了一些時間才適應當地文化和不同的教育體系。","explanation":"動詞「適應」。固定搭配：adapt to sth。強調調整自己以符合新環境。"},{"sentence":"The director decided to <adapt> the popular novel *for* the big screen, hoping to attract a wider audience.","translation":"導演決定將這部受歡迎的小說改編成電影，希望能吸引更廣泛的觀眾。","explanation":"動詞「改編」。固定搭配：adapt sth for sth。指將作品形式轉換以適應不同媒介。"}],"related_forms":["adaptation","adaptable"]}

{"headword":"addict","explanation":"可作名詞「上癮者」或動詞「使...上癮」。動詞常用於被動語態 be addicted to sth (對...上癮)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The support group helps former drug <addicts> reintegrate into society and maintain a healthy, drug-free lifestyle.","translation":"這個支持團體幫助前吸毒者重新融入社會，並維持健康、無毒的生活方式。","explanation":"名詞「上癮者」。通常指對藥物、酒精或某種行為有強烈依賴的人。"},{"sentence":"Excessive use of social media can gradually <addict> young people *to* their phones, affecting their studies and social interactions.","translation":"過度使用社群媒體會逐漸使年輕人沉迷於手機，影響他們的學業和社交互動。","explanation":"動詞「使...上癮」。常用於被動語態：be addicted to sth。強調某事物導致上癮的狀態。"}],"related_forms":["addiction","addicted"]}

{"headword":"adequate","explanation":"形容詞「足夠的、適當的」。指數量或品質達到所需標準。反義詞為 inadequate。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school ensures that all students have <adequate> resources and support to succeed academically and personally.","translation":"學校確保所有學生都有足夠的資源和支持，以便在學業和個人方面取得成功。","explanation":"形容詞「足夠的、適當的」。常用搭配：adequate supply/resources/time。強調滿足需求。"}],"related_forms":["adequacy","adequately"]}

{"headword":"adjust","explanation":"動詞「調整」指為了適應新情況或改善而改變某物。常考搭配為 *adjust to* (適應)，後面接名詞或動名詞。名詞 *adjustment* 指「調整」或「適應」，常用片語為 *make an adjustment*。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students often need time to <adjust> *to* the demanding academic schedule and new social environment in college.","translation":"大學生通常需要時間來適應大學裡要求嚴格的學術課程和新的社交環境。","explanation":"動詞「適應」。片語 adjust to sth/doing sth 表示「適應某事」。"},{"sentence":"The company decided to <adjust> its marketing strategy to better *meet* the changing demands of the younger generation.","translation":"該公司決定調整其行銷策略，以更好地滿足年輕一代不斷變化的需求。","explanation":"動詞「調整」。此用法指對某物進行微調或改變。"},{"sentence":"Making an <adjustment> *to* the new work-from-home policy was challenging for many employees at first.","translation":"對許多員工來說，一開始要適應新的居家辦公政策是很有挑戰性的。","explanation":"名詞「調整；適應」。片語 make an adjustment to sth 表示「對某事做出調整/適應」。"}],"related_forms":["adjustment","adjustable"]}

{"headword":"admirable","explanation":"形容詞「令人欽佩的」，指某人或某事值得尊敬或讚揚。常用來描述品格、行為或成就。","entries":[{"sentence":"Her <admirable> *dedication to* community service inspired many young people to volunteer their time.","translation":"她對社區服務令人欽佩的奉獻精神激勵了許多年輕人志願貢獻他們的時間。","explanation":"形容詞「令人欽佩的」。常修飾品格、努力或成就。"},{"sentence":"The scientist's <admirable> *persistence in* research eventually led to a significant breakthrough in medical technology.","translation":"這位科學家在研究中令人欽佩的堅持最終導致了醫學技術的重大突破。","explanation":"形容詞「值得讚揚的」。強調其值得尊敬的特質。"}],"related_forms":["admire","admiration","admirably"]}

{"headword":"admiration","explanation":"名詞「欽佩；讚賞」，指對某人或某事感到尊敬和喜愛。常考搭配為 *have admiration for* 或 *express admiration for*。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students *expressed* their deep <admiration> *for* their teacher's patience and innovative teaching methods.","translation":"學生們表達了他們對老師的耐心和創新教學方法的深深欽佩。","explanation":"名詞「欽佩」。片語 express admiration for sth/sb 表示「表達對…的欽佩」。"},{"sentence":"She *had* great <admiration> *for* her grandmother, who overcame many difficulties to achieve her dreams.","translation":"她對她的祖母懷有極大的欽佩，祖母克服了許多困難才實現了夢想。","explanation":"名詞「欽佩」。片語 have admiration for sth/sb 表示「對…懷有欽佩」。"}],"related_forms":["admire","admirable","admirably"]}

{"headword":"admission","explanation":"名詞「入場許可；入學許可；承認」。(1) 「入場許可」或「入學許可」常搭配介係詞 *to*。(2) 「承認」指承認錯誤或事實，常用片語 *make an admission*。(3) 注意與動詞 *admit* 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university announced that <admission> *to* its highly competitive engineering program would require excellent grades.","translation":"該大學宣布，其競爭激烈的工程學程入學將需要優異的成績。","explanation":"名詞「入學許可」。片語 admission to sth 表示「進入某處的許可」。"},{"sentence":"After hours of questioning, the suspect finally *made an* <admission> *of* guilt regarding the theft.","translation":"經過數小時的審問，嫌疑犯最終承認了盜竊的罪行。","explanation":"名詞「承認」。片語 make an admission of sth 表示「承認某事」。"},{"sentence":"The museum charges a small <admission> *fee* to help maintain its exhibits and support educational programs.","translation":"博物館收取少量入場費，以幫助維護其展品並支持教育計畫。","explanation":"名詞「入場費」。常與 fee 搭配。"}],"related_forms":["admit"]}

{"headword":"adopt","explanation":"動詞「採納；領養」。(1) 「採納」指接受並開始使用某種方法、政策或觀點。(2) 「領養」指合法地收養一個孩子或動物。(3) 注意與 *adapt* (適應) 的拼寫和意義區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The couple decided to <adopt> a child from an orphanage, providing a loving home for the young boy.","translation":"這對夫婦決定從孤兒院領養一個孩子，為這個小男孩提供一個充滿愛的家。","explanation":"動詞「領養」。指合法地收養孩子或動物。"},{"sentence":"Our school decided to <adopt> a new grading system to provide students with more comprehensive feedback on their performance.","translation":"我們學校決定採納新的評分制度，為學生提供更全面的表現回饋。","explanation":"動詞「採納」。指接受並開始使用某種方法或政策。"}],"related_forms":["adoption","adoptive"]}

{"headword":"agency","explanation":"名詞「機構；代理處」。指提供特定服務的組織或公司。常見搭配如 *travel agency* (旅行社)、*advertising agency* (廣告公司)。另有「作用；效力」之意，但較少在GSAT中出現。","entries":[{"sentence":"She found her dream job through a reputable *recruitment* <agency> that specializes in IT professionals.","translation":"她透過一家專門從事資訊科技專業人才的知名招聘機構找到了她的理想工作。","explanation":"名詞「機構；代理處」。指提供特定服務的組織。"},{"sentence":"The government <agency> is responsible for regulating food safety and ensuring public health standards.","translation":"該政府機構負責規範食品安全並確保公共衛生標準。","explanation":"名詞「機構」。指政府部門或組織。"}],"related_forms":["agent"]}

{"headword":"agent","explanation":"名詞「代理人；經紀人；作用劑」。(1) 「代理人」指代表他人行事的人。(2) 「作用劑」指能產生特定效果的物質。","entries":[{"sentence":"The real estate <agent> helped the young couple find their ideal apartment in the bustling city center.","translation":"這位房地產經紀人幫助這對年輕夫婦在繁華的市中心找到了他們理想的公寓。","explanation":"名詞「代理人；經紀人」。指代表客戶處理事務的人。"},{"sentence":"Bleach is a powerful cleaning <agent> that can effectively remove stains and disinfect surfaces.","translation":"漂白水是一種強效的清潔劑，可以有效去除污漬並消毒表面。","explanation":"名詞「作用劑」。指能產生特定效果的物質。"}],"related_forms":["agency"]}

{"headword":"aggressive","explanation":"形容詞「好鬥的；積極進取的」。(1) 「好鬥的」指傾向於攻擊或爭吵。(2) 「積極進取的」指有決心且精力充沛地追求目標，通常帶有強勢的意味。(3) 注意其雙重含義，需根據語境判斷。","entries":[{"sentence":"The coach warned the team against <aggressive> *behavior* on the field, emphasizing fair play and sportsmanship.","translation":"教練警告球隊不要在場上表現出攻擊性行為，強調公平競爭和運動家精神。","explanation":"形容詞「好鬥的；具攻擊性的」。指傾向於攻擊或爭吵的行為。"},{"sentence":"The startup launched an <aggressive> *marketing campaign* to quickly gain market share in the competitive industry.","translation":"這家新創公司發起了一項積極進取的行銷活動，以在競爭激烈的行業中迅速搶佔市場份額。","explanation":"形容詞「積極進取的」。指有決心且精力充沛地追求目標。"}],"related_forms":["aggression","aggressively"]}

{"headword":"agreeable","explanation":"形容詞「令人愉快的；欣然同意的」。(1) 「令人愉快的」指令人感到舒適或喜歡。(2) 「欣然同意的」指樂意接受或同意某事，常搭配介係詞 *to*。","entries":[{"sentence":"The weather was quite <agreeable> for an outdoor picnic, with clear skies and a gentle breeze.","translation":"天氣非常宜人，適合戶外野餐，天空晴朗，微風輕拂。","explanation":"形容詞「令人愉快的；宜人的」。指讓人感到舒適或喜歡。"},{"sentence":"The committee was <agreeable> *to* the proposal, as it offered a practical solution to the budget problem.","translation":"委員會欣然同意這項提案，因為它為預算問題提供了一個實用的解決方案。","explanation":"形容詞「欣然同意的」。片語 agreeable to sth 表示「樂意接受或同意某事」。"}],"related_forms":["agree","agreement","agreeably"]}

{"headword":"alcohol","explanation":"名詞「酒精；酒」。指含有酒精的飲料或化學物質。常用於討論健康、法律或社交場合。注意其不可數名詞的特性。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many universities have strict policies regarding the consumption of <alcohol> on campus, especially for underage students.","translation":"許多大學對校園內飲酒有嚴格的規定，特別是針對未成年學生。","explanation":"名詞「酒精；酒」。指含有酒精的飲料。"},{"sentence":"The doctor advised the patient to avoid <alcohol> *consumption* while taking the prescribed medication.","translation":"醫生建議病患在服用處方藥期間避免飲酒。","explanation":"名詞「酒精」。常與 consumption 搭配，指「飲酒」。"}],"related_forms":["alcoholic"]}

{"headword":"alert","explanation":"此字可作形容詞、動詞和名詞。形容詞「警覺的」常與 be, remain, stay 等動詞連用，表示對危險或重要事物保持警覺。動詞「提醒/使警覺」常搭配介係詞 to，表示提醒某人注意某事。名詞「警報/警覺」常與 on, give, sound 等動詞搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"The security guard remained <alert> *for* any suspicious activity near the entrance, ensuring everyone's safety during the event.","translation":"保全人員對入口附近的任何可疑活動保持警覺，確保活動期間每個人的安全。","explanation":"形容詞「警覺的」。常與介係詞 for 連用，表示對...保持警覺。"},{"sentence":"The weather forecast <alerted> residents *to* the possibility of heavy thunderstorms, advising them to stay indoors for safety.","translation":"天氣預報提醒居民注意可能發生的強雷雨，建議他們為了安全待在室內。","explanation":"動詞「提醒/使警覺」。常用句型 alert sb to sth。"},{"sentence":"The sudden fire alarm *sounded* an <alert> throughout the building, prompting everyone to evacuate quickly and calmly.","translation":"突然響起的火災警報聲響徹整棟大樓，促使每個人迅速而平靜地疏散。","explanation":"名詞「警報」。常用搭配 sound an alert 或 be on alert (保持警覺)。"}],"related_forms":["alertness"]}

{"headword":"allowance","explanation":"名詞「零用錢」或「津貼」。也指在特定情況下允許的數量或限度，如行李限額。注意此字與動詞 allow (允許) 意義不同，不可混淆。","entries":[{"sentence":"My parents give me a weekly <allowance> to manage my personal expenses, teaching me the importance of budgeting.","translation":"我的父母每週給我零用錢來管理我的個人開支，教導我預算的重要性。","explanation":"名詞「零用錢」。常用搭配 give/receive an allowance。"},{"sentence":"The airline has a strict baggage <allowance>, so passengers must ensure their luggage doesn't exceed the weight limit.","translation":"該航空公司有嚴格的行李限額，因此乘客必須確保他們的行李沒有超過重量限制。","explanation":"名詞「限額/津貼」。常用搭配 baggage allowance, travel allowance。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"alternative","explanation":"此字可作形容詞和名詞。形容詞「替代的」指可供選擇的方案或方法。名詞「替代方案」指可供選擇的事物或方案，常與介係詞 to 連用。注意其單複數形。","entries":[{"sentence":"Faced with a traffic jam, the driver decided to take an <alternative> *route* to reach his destination on time.","translation":"面對交通堵塞，司機決定走一條替代路線，以便準時到達目的地。","explanation":"形容詞「替代的」。常用搭配 alternative route/method/energy。"},{"sentence":"Since public transportation was on strike, cycling became the only viable <alternative> *to* getting to work that day.","translation":"由於大眾運輸罷工，騎自行車成了那天上班唯一可行的替代方案。","explanation":"名詞「替代方案」。常用搭配 alternative to sth。"}],"related_forms":["alternatively"]}

{"headword":"amateur","explanation":"此字可作形容詞和名詞。形容詞「業餘的」指非專業的。名詞「業餘愛好者」指非專業人士，常與 professional (專業人士) 對比。注意其發音與拼寫。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite being an <amateur> *photographer*, her stunning landscape pictures won first prize in the local competition.","translation":"儘管她是一名業餘攝影師，她令人驚嘆的風景照片在當地比賽中贏得了第一名。","explanation":"形容詞「業餘的」。常用搭配 amateur photographer/athlete/artist。"},{"sentence":"The concert featured several talented <amateurs> who performed alongside professional musicians, showcasing their passion for music.","translation":"這場音樂會邀請了幾位才華橫溢的業餘愛好者與專業音樂家一同表演，展現他們對音樂的熱情。","explanation":"名詞「業餘愛好者」。常與 professional (專業人士) 對比。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"ambiguous","explanation":"形容詞「模稜兩可的」、「不明確的」。常因有多種解釋而造成困惑或不確定性。注意其名詞形式 ambiguity。","entries":[{"sentence":"The politician's statement was so <ambiguous> that both supporters and opponents interpreted it differently, causing confusion.","translation":"這位政治家的聲明如此模稜兩可，以至於支持者和反對者對其有不同的解讀，造成了混亂。","explanation":"形容詞「模稜兩可的」。常用搭配 ambiguous statement/meaning/answer。"}],"related_forms":["ambiguity","ambiguously"]}

{"headword":"ambitious","explanation":"形容詞「有抱負的」、「雄心勃勃的」。描述一個人有強烈的願望去實現某個目標，通常是困難或宏大的目標。注意其名詞形式 ambition。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young entrepreneur had <ambitious> *goals* to expand her startup globally within five years, requiring significant effort.","translation":"這位年輕的企業家有雄心勃勃的目標，要在五年內將她的新創公司擴展到全球，這需要付出巨大的努力。","explanation":"形容詞「有抱負的/雄心勃勃的」。常用搭配 ambitious goals/plans/project。"}],"related_forms":["ambition","ambitiously"]}

{"headword":"amuse","explanation":"動詞「使發笑/娛樂」。常用於被動語態 be amused by/at，表示被逗樂或感到有趣。其名詞形式 amusement 指「娛樂/樂趣」，常用於 amusement park (遊樂園)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The comedian's witty jokes never failed to <amuse> the audience, making everyone laugh throughout the entire show.","translation":"這位喜劇演員機智的笑話總能逗樂觀眾，讓大家在整個表演中笑聲不斷。","explanation":"動詞「使發笑/娛樂」。常用句型 amuse sb。"},{"sentence":"We were greatly <amused> *by* the children's spontaneous dance performance during the school talent show.","translation":"我們被孩子們在學校才藝表演中自發的舞蹈表演逗樂了。","explanation":"動詞「被逗樂」。常用被動語態 be amused by/at sth。"},{"sentence":"The new theme park offers a wide range of rides and attractions for everyone's <amusement>, from toddlers to adults.","translation":"這個新的主題公園提供各種遊樂設施和景點，供從幼兒到成人所有人的娛樂。","explanation":"名詞「娛樂/樂趣」。常用搭配 for amusement 或 amusement park。"}],"related_forms":["amusing","amused","amusement"]}

{"headword":"analysis","explanation":"名詞「分析」。指對事物進行詳細檢視以理解其組成、結構或原因。常與介係詞 of 連用。注意其動詞形式為 analyze。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scientist's detailed <analysis> *of* the soil samples revealed unexpected levels of pollution in the agricultural area.","translation":"科學家對土壤樣本的詳細分析揭示了農業區意想不到的污染程度。","explanation":"名詞「分析」。常用搭配 analysis of sth。"}],"related_forms":["analyze","analytical"]}

{"headword":"analyze","explanation":"動詞「分析」。指對事物進行詳細檢視以理解其組成、結構或原因。常搭配 data, results, information 等。注意其名詞形式為 analysis。","entries":[{"sentence":"Researchers will <analyze> the collected data to identify patterns and draw conclusions about the effectiveness of the new teaching method.","translation":"研究人員將分析收集到的數據，以識別模式並就新教學方法的有效性得出結論。","explanation":"動詞「分析」。常用搭配 analyze data/results/information。"}],"related_forms":["analysis","analytical"]}

{"headword":"ancestor","explanation":"名詞「祖先」、「祖宗」。指某人或某群體在過去的血緣關係中的前輩。注意其複數形為 ancestors。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many people research their family history to learn more about their <ancestors> and understand their cultural heritage.","translation":"許多人研究他們的家族歷史，以了解更多關於他們的祖先並理解他們的文化遺產。","explanation":"名詞「祖先」。常用搭配 common ancestor, direct ancestor。"}],"related_forms":["ancestry"]}

{"headword":"anniversary","explanation":"名詞「週年紀念日」。常用於結婚紀念日 (wedding anniversary)、公司成立紀念日 (company anniversary) 等。注意其單複數變化。","entries":[{"sentence":"The couple celebrated their tenth wedding <anniversary> *with* a romantic dinner and a weekend getaway to a quiet beach resort.","translation":"這對夫妻以浪漫晚餐和週末到寧靜海灘度假的方式，慶祝他們的結婚十週年紀念日。","explanation":"名詞「週年紀念日」。常用搭配：celebrate an anniversary, wedding anniversary。介係詞常用 with。"},{"sentence":"Our school will host a grand event next month to mark its 50th <anniversary>, inviting alumni from all over the world.","translation":"我們學校下個月將舉辦一場盛大活動來慶祝其50週年校慶，邀請來自世界各地的校友。","explanation":"名詞「週年紀念日」。mark an anniversary (慶祝/紀念週年)。"}],"related_forms":["anniversaries"]}

{"headword":"annoy","explanation":"動詞「使惱怒，使煩躁」。常用於描述某人或某事引起的不悅情緒。注意其形容詞形式 annoying (令人惱怒的) 和 annoyed (感到惱怒的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The constant noise from the construction site next door began to <annoy> the residents, who eventually filed a complaint.","translation":"隔壁工地持續不斷的噪音開始使居民感到惱怒，他們最終提出了投訴。","explanation":"動詞「使惱怒」。主詞是造成惱怒的事物。"},{"sentence":"It really <annoys> me when people talk loudly on their phones in public places, especially during quiet study hours.","translation":"當人們在公共場所大聲講電話時，尤其是在安靜的自習時間，這真的讓我很惱火。","explanation":"動詞「使惱怒」。常用句型：It annoys me when...。"}],"related_forms":["annoys","annoyed","annoying","annoyance"]}

{"headword":"annual","explanation":"形容詞「每年的，一年一度的」。常用於描述定期發生的事件或報告。注意與 yearly (形容詞/副詞) 的區別，annual 語氣較正式。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company holds its <annual> *meeting* in December to review the year's performance and plan for the next fiscal year.","translation":"該公司在十二月舉行年度會議，以檢討當年的績效並規劃下一個財政年度。","explanation":"形容詞「每年的，年度的」。常用搭配：annual meeting, annual report, annual leave。"},{"sentence":"Students eagerly anticipate the <annual> *sports* day, where they compete in various events and show great team spirit.","translation":"學生們熱切期待一年一度的運動會，他們在各種項目中競爭並展現出很棒的團隊精神。","explanation":"形容詞「一年一度的」。"}],"related_forms":["annually"]}

{"headword":"anxiety","explanation":"名詞「焦慮，不安」。指對未來或不確定情況的擔憂。注意其形容詞形式 anxious (焦慮的)。常與介係詞 about 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students experience <anxiety> *about* final exams, which can sometimes affect their concentration and performance.","translation":"許多學生對期末考感到焦慮，這有時會影響他們的專注力和表現。","explanation":"名詞「焦慮」。常用搭配：anxiety about sth。"},{"sentence":"The sudden economic downturn caused widespread <anxiety> among investors, who feared losing their savings.","translation":"突如其來的經濟衰退在投資者中引起了普遍的焦慮，他們擔心會失去積蓄。","explanation":"名詞「焦慮」。widespread anxiety (普遍的焦慮)。"}],"related_forms":["anxious"]}

{"headword":"apology","explanation":"名詞「道歉」。常用片語 make an apology (道歉)。注意其動詞形式 apologize (道歉)。常與介係詞 for 搭配，表示為某事道歉。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student offered a sincere <apology> *for* being late to class, explaining that his bus had broken down on the way.","translation":"這名學生為上課遲到真誠地道歉，解釋說他的公車在路上拋錨了。","explanation":"名詞「道歉」。常用搭配：make an apology for sth。"},{"sentence":"After realizing her mistake, she immediately sent an email to express her <apology> to her colleague for the misunderstanding.","translation":"意識到自己的錯誤後，她立即發送了一封電子郵件，向同事表達她的歉意，以消除誤會。","explanation":"名詞「道歉」。express one's apology (表達歉意)。"}],"related_forms":["apologies","apologize"]}

{"headword":"apparent","explanation":"形容詞「顯而易見的，明顯的」。常用於描述容易被看見或理解的事物。注意其副詞形式 apparently (顯然地)。常與 it is apparent that... 句型搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"It was <apparent> *to* everyone that the new policy would have a significant impact on the company's future operations.","translation":"對所有人來說，新政策將對公司未來的營運產生重大影響是顯而易見的。","explanation":"形容詞「顯而易見的」。常用句型：It is apparent to sb that...。"},{"sentence":"Despite his efforts to hide it, his nervousness became <apparent> during the job interview when he started to stammer.","translation":"儘管他努力隱藏，但在面試時他開始口吃，他的緊張就變得顯而易見了。","explanation":"形容詞「明顯的」。become apparent (變得明顯)。"}],"related_forms":["apparently"]}

{"headword":"applicant","explanation":"名詞「申請人」。指提出申請的人，例如求職者、入學者等。注意其動詞形式 apply (申請) 和名詞形式 application (申請書/應用)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Each <applicant> for the scholarship must submit a personal statement and two letters of recommendation by the deadline.","translation":"每位獎學金申請者都必須在截止日期前提交一份個人陳述和兩封推薦信。","explanation":"名詞「申請人」。常用搭配：applicant for sth。"},{"sentence":"The company received hundreds of resumes, but only a few <applicants> were invited for a second round of interviews.","translation":"該公司收到了數百份履歷，但只有少數申請者被邀請參加第二輪面試。","explanation":"名詞「申請人」。"}],"related_forms":["applicants","apply","application"]}

{"headword":"application","explanation":"名詞「申請書；應用」。指提出申請的行為或文件，或指某物的使用方式。注意其動詞形式 apply (申請/應用)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students must complete the online <application> *form* and submit it before the university's admission deadline.","translation":"學生必須填寫線上申請表並在大學入學截止日期前提交。","explanation":"名詞「申請書」。常用搭配：application form, submit an application。"},{"sentence":"The new software has many practical <applications> in various fields, from scientific research to daily business operations.","translation":"這款新軟體在各個領域都有許多實用的應用，從科學研究到日常商業營運。","explanation":"名詞「應用」。practical applications (實際應用)。"}],"related_forms":["applications","apply","applicant"]}

{"headword":"appoint","explanation":"動詞「任命，指派」。指正式選定某人擔任職位。名詞 appointment (約會；任命)。注意動詞與名詞的詞性與用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"The board of directors decided to <appoint> a new CEO to lead the company through its challenging period of transformation.","translation":"董事會決定任命一位新的執行長，帶領公司度過轉型期的挑戰。","explanation":"動詞「任命」。常用句型：appoint sb (as) sth。"},{"sentence":"I have a dental <appointment> tomorrow morning, so I won't be able to attend the early team meeting.","translation":"我明天早上有一個牙醫預約，所以我無法參加早上的團隊會議。","explanation":"名詞「約會」。常用搭配：make an appointment, have an appointment。"},{"sentence":"The government announced the <appointment> *of* a special committee to investigate the recent scandal and propose solutions.","translation":"政府宣布任命一個特別委員會，調查最近的醜聞並提出解決方案。","explanation":"名詞「任命」。常用搭配：appointment of sb (任命某人)。"}],"related_forms":["appointed","appointing","appointment","appointments"]}

{"headword":"appreciation","explanation":"名詞「欣賞；感謝」。指對某事物的價值或優點的認識，或對幫助的感激。注意其動詞形式 appreciate (欣賞/感謝)。常與介係詞 for 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"We would like to express our sincere <appreciation> *for* your generous donation, which will greatly support our charity.","translation":"我們想對您的慷慨捐款表達誠摯的感謝，這將大大支持我們的慈善機構。","explanation":"名詞「感謝」。常用搭配：express appreciation for sth。"},{"sentence":"His deep <appreciation> *of* classical music led him to attend every symphony concert held in the city.","translation":"他對古典音樂的深刻欣賞使他參加了城市裡舉辦的每一場交響音樂會。","explanation":"名詞「欣賞」。常用搭配：appreciation of sth。"}],"related_forms":["appreciate","appreciative"]}

{"headword":"appropriate","explanation":"形容詞「適當的」，常接介係詞 for 或 to。動詞用法（較少見）指「挪用/撥款」。注意與 proper 的細微差異，appropriate 強調符合情境。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is not <appropriate> *to* make jokes during such a solemn memorial service for the victims of the natural disaster.","translation":"在為自然災害受害者舉行的莊嚴追悼會上開玩笑是不適當的。","explanation":"形容詞用法，搭配介係詞 to，表示對某場合適當。"},{"sentence":"The teacher selected <appropriate> *materials* for the students to read, ensuring the content matched their current English proficiency level.","translation":"老師為學生挑選了適當的教材，確保內容符合他們目前的英語能力水準。","explanation":"形容詞用法，修飾名詞 materials，表示合適的。"}],"related_forms":["appropriately","appropriateness"]}

{"headword":"approval","explanation":"名詞「批准/贊同」。常見搭配：seek/gain/win approval (獲得批准)；express/show one's approval (表示贊同)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school board finally gave its <approval> *for* the construction of a new library building on the campus next year.","translation":"校董會終於批准了明年在校園內興建新圖書館大樓的計畫。","explanation":"名詞「批准」，give approval for sth 為常見用法。"},{"sentence":"She looked at her father with a smile, hoping to see his <approval> *of* her decision to study abroad after graduation.","translation":"她微笑著看著父親，希望能看到他贊同她畢業後出國留學的決定。","explanation":"名詞「贊同」，approval of sth 表示對某事的認可。"}],"related_forms":["approve"]}

{"headword":"aquarium","explanation":"名詞「水族館/魚缸」。複數形式為 aquariums 或 aquaria。","entries":[{"sentence":"We visited the local <aquarium> to observe various marine creatures and learn about the importance of ocean conservation efforts.","translation":"我們參觀了當地的水族館，觀察各種海洋生物並了解海洋保育工作的重要性。","explanation":"指大型公共水族館。"},{"sentence":"The small <aquarium> *in* the living room is filled with colorful tropical fish that require careful maintenance and regular feeding.","translation":"客廳裡的小魚缸裝滿了色彩鮮豔的熱帶魚，需要細心的維護和定期的餵食。","explanation":"指家庭用的小型魚缸。"}],"related_forms":["aquariums","aquaria"]}

{"headword":"arch","explanation":"名詞「拱門/拱形結構」；動詞「使成拱形」。常與建築或身體部位（如腳背）相關。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ancient stone <arch> *at* the entrance of the park has stood for centuries, serving as a symbol of the city.","translation":"公園入口處的古老石拱門已經矗立了幾個世紀，成為這座城市的象徵。","explanation":"名詞「拱門」。"},{"sentence":"The cat <arched> *its* back in fear when it encountered a large, barking dog on the quiet suburban street.","translation":"當貓在安靜的郊區街道上遇到一隻大聲吠叫的狗時，牠因恐懼而拱起了背。","explanation":"動詞「使成拱形」，arch one's back 為常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["arched","arching"]}

{"headword":"arise","explanation":"動詞「發生/出現/產生」。為不規則動詞 (arise-arose-arisen)。常與問題、困難搭配，類似 occur 或 happen。","entries":[{"sentence":"Should any unexpected problems <arise> *during* the project, please report them to the team leader immediately for further assistance.","translation":"如果在專案期間出現任何意外問題，請立即向組長報告以尋求進一步協助。","explanation":"動詞「出現/發生」，常用於正式場合。"},{"sentence":"The conflict between the two departments <arose> *from* a misunderstanding regarding the distribution of the limited annual budget resources.","translation":"這兩個部門之間的衝突源於對有限年度預算資源分配的誤解。","explanation":"動詞片語 arise from = result from，表示起因於。"}],"related_forms":["arose","arisen"]}

{"headword":"arms","explanation":"名詞「武器/軍備」。常用複數形。片語：up in arms (憤怒抗議)；lay down one's arms (放下武器/投降)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government decided to limit the trade of <arms> *to* maintain regional stability and prevent further escalation of the ongoing conflict.","translation":"政府決定限制武器貿易，以維持區域穩定並防止持續的衝突進一步升級。","explanation":"名詞「武器」，常與 trade, control 等字連用。"},{"sentence":"Local residents were up in <arms> *about* the new factory plan, fearing that it would cause severe pollution in their neighborhood.","translation":"當地居民對新的工廠計畫感到憤怒抗議，擔心這會對他們的社區造成嚴重的污染。","explanation":"片語 up in arms about sth，表示對某事極度憤怒並強烈反對。"}],"related_forms":["arm"]}

{"headword":"artificial","explanation":"形容詞「人工的/人造的/虛假的」。與 natural 相對。常用於 artificial intelligence (AI) 或 artificial light。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many scientists believe that <artificial> *intelligence* will fundamentally change the way we work and interact with each other in society.","translation":"許多科學家認為人工智慧將從根本上改變我們在社會中工作和互動的方式。","explanation":"常用搭配 artificial intelligence (AI)。"},{"sentence":"The flowers in the vase are <artificial>, yet they look so realistic that most visitors cannot tell they are not real.","translation":"花瓶裡的花是人造的，但它們看起來非常逼真，大多數訪客都無法分辨它們不是真的。","explanation":"形容詞「人造的」，與 real 相對。"}],"related_forms":["artificially"]}

{"headword":"artistic","explanation":"形容詞「藝術的/有藝術天份的」。指與藝術相關的，或形容人具有藝術氣質。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student showed great <artistic> *talent* by creating a stunning painting that won the first prize in the national competition.","translation":"這位學生展現了極高的藝術天份，創作了一幅令人驚豔的畫作，贏得了全國比賽的第一名。","explanation":"形容詞「藝術的」，常修飾 talent, ability 等字。"},{"sentence":"She has an <artistic> *eye* for interior design, which allows her to transform simple rooms into beautiful and comfortable living spaces.","translation":"她對室內設計有藝術眼光，這使她能夠將簡單的房間轉變為美麗舒適的居住空間。","explanation":"形容詞「有藝術感的」，artistic eye 為常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["artist","artistry"]}

{"headword":"ashamed","explanation":"形容詞「感到羞恥的/慚愧的」。常見搭配：be ashamed of sth/sb；be ashamed to do sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"He felt deeply <ashamed> *of* his behavior at the party and decided to apologize to his friends for his rude actions.","translation":"他對自己在派對上的行為感到非常羞愧，並決定為自己的粗魯舉動向朋友們道歉。","explanation":"形容詞用法，搭配介係詞 of，表示對某事感到羞恥。"},{"sentence":"She was too <ashamed> *to* admit that she had failed the exam, so she kept the truth from her worried parents.","translation":"她感到太羞愧而不敢承認自己考試不及格，所以對擔心的父母隱瞞了真相。","explanation":"形容詞用法，搭配不定詞 to do sth，表示因羞愧而不願做某事。"}],"related_forms":["shame"]}

{"headword":"aspect","explanation":"名詞「層面/觀點」。常用於探討問題的各個面向。搭配介係詞 of。","entries":[{"sentence":"We need to consider every <aspect> *of* the plan before making a final decision to ensure that nothing is overlooked.","translation":"在做出最終決定之前，我們需要考慮該計畫的每一個層面，以確保沒有任何遺漏。","explanation":"名詞「層面」，every aspect of 為常見用法。"},{"sentence":"The most challenging <aspect> *of* learning a new language is mastering the complex grammar rules and the vast vocabulary range.","translation":"學習新語言最具挑戰性的層面是掌握複雜的語法規則和龐大的詞彙量。","explanation":"名詞「層面/面向」，指問題的某一部分。"}],"related_forms":["aspects"]}

{"headword":"aspirin","explanation":"名詞「阿斯匹靈」。不可數名詞，指藥物本身。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor suggested taking an <aspirin> *to* relieve the mild headache she had been experiencing since early this morning.","translation":"醫生建議服用一顆阿斯匹靈來緩解她從今天清晨開始出現的輕微頭痛。","explanation":"名詞「阿斯匹靈」，常用於緩解疼痛。"},{"sentence":"It is important to check the expiration date on the bottle of <aspirin> before consuming any medication for your health.","translation":"在服用任何藥物以維護健康之前，檢查阿斯匹靈瓶上的有效期限是很重要的。","explanation":"名詞「阿斯匹靈」，指藥物。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"assemble","explanation":"動詞「組裝/集合」。指將零件拼湊起來，或指人聚集在一起。","entries":[{"sentence":"The workers spent several hours <assembling> *the* furniture pieces according to the instructions provided in the manual by the manufacturer.","translation":"工人們花了幾個小時按照製造商手冊中提供的說明組裝家具零件。","explanation":"動詞「組裝」，常用於組裝機器或家具。"},{"sentence":"Students were asked to <assemble> *in* the school auditorium for a special announcement regarding the upcoming annual sports competition.","translation":"學生們被要求在學校禮堂集合，聽取關於即將到來的年度運動比賽的特別公告。","explanation":"動詞「集合」，指人聚集。"}],"related_forms":["assembly"]}

{"headword":"assembly","explanation":"名詞「集會/組裝」。指學校的早會或集體會議，也指製造過程中的裝配線。","entries":[{"sentence":"The principal gave a speech during the morning <assembly> to encourage students to participate actively in various extracurricular school activities.","translation":"校長在早會期間發表了演講，鼓勵學生積極參與各種課外學校活動。","explanation":"名詞「集會」，指學校的集體會議。"},{"sentence":"The car <assembly> *line* is highly automated, allowing for the efficient production of thousands of vehicles every single month.","translation":"汽車裝配線高度自動化，使每個月都能有效率地生產數千輛汽車。","explanation":"名詞「組裝」，assembly line 為固定搭配。"}],"related_forms":["assemble"]}

{"headword":"assign","explanation":"動詞「分配/指派」。名詞為 assignment。常見搭配：assign sb sth 或 assign sth to sb。","entries":[{"sentence":"The manager decided to <assign> *the* most difficult task to the new employee to test his problem-solving skills and patience.","translation":"經理決定將最困難的任務指派給新員工，以測試他的解決問題能力和耐心。","explanation":"動詞「指派」，assign sth to sb 為常見用法。"},{"sentence":"The teacher gave us a challenging writing <assignment> *on* the topic of environmental protection to complete by next Friday.","translation":"老師給了我們一份關於環境保護主題的挑戰性寫作作業，要在下週五前完成。","explanation":"名詞「作業/任務」，assignment on sth 為常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["assignment"]}

{"headword":"assistance","explanation":"名詞「協助/援助」。不可數名詞。常見搭配：provide/offer assistance；seek assistance。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you require any <assistance> *with* your research project, please feel free to contact the library staff for further guidance.","translation":"如果您在研究專案上需要任何協助，請隨時聯繫圖書館工作人員以獲得進一步指導。","explanation":"名詞「協助」，assistance with sth 為常見用法。"},{"sentence":"The international organization provided financial <assistance> *to* the developing countries to help them improve their basic education systems.","translation":"該國際組織向開發中國家提供了經濟援助，以幫助他們改善基礎教育系統。","explanation":"名詞「援助」，provide assistance to sb 為常見用法。"}],"related_forms":["assist","assistant"]}

{"headword":"associate","explanation":"動詞「聯想/結交」；名詞「夥伴/同事」。常見搭配：associate A with B (將A與B聯想在一起)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many people <associate> *the* color red *with* passion, energy, and excitement in various cultures around the world today.","translation":"在當今世界各地的多種文化中，許多人將紅色與熱情、活力和興奮聯想在一起。","explanation":"動詞用法，associate A with B 為固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"He is a close business <associate> *of* mine, and we have been working together on several successful projects for years.","translation":"他是我的親密商業夥伴，我們多年來一直合作進行幾個成功的專案。","explanation":"名詞「夥伴/同事」，指工作上的合作關係。"}],"related_forms":["association"]}

{"headword":"association","explanation":"名詞「協會/關聯」。指組織或事物之間的連結。","entries":[{"sentence":"She joined the local teachers' <association> to network with other educators and share innovative teaching methods with them.","translation":"她加入了當地的教師協會，以便與其他教育工作者建立聯繫，並與他們分享創新的教學方法。","explanation":"名詞「協會」，指組織。"},{"sentence":"There is a strong <association> *between* regular physical exercise and improved mental health in people of all age groups.","translation":"在各個年齡層的人群中，規律的體育鍛鍊與改善心理健康之間有著強烈的關聯。","explanation":"名詞「關聯」，association between A and B 為常見用法。"}],"related_forms":["associate"]}

{"headword":"assurance","explanation":"名詞「保證/自信」。常用於給予他人信心或承諾。常見搭配：give/receive an assurance。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company gave us an <assurance> *that* the new product would be delivered to our office before the end of this month.","translation":"公司向我們保證新產品將會在月底前送到我們的辦公室。","explanation":"名詞「保證」，後接 that 子句。"},{"sentence":"Despite the difficult circumstances, she spoke with great <assurance>, convincing everyone that the team could overcome the upcoming challenges.","translation":"儘管情況困難，她說話時充滿自信，說服了每個人團隊能夠克服即將到來的挑戰。","explanation":"名詞「自信」，with assurance 表示自信地。"}],"related_forms":["assure"]}

{"headword":"assure","explanation":"動詞「向...保證」。常見用法：assure sb (that) ...；assure sb of sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tour guide <assured> *us* that the weather would be perfect for our hiking trip to the mountains tomorrow morning.","translation":"導遊向我們保證，明早去山上的健行之旅天氣會非常完美。","explanation":"動詞「向...保證」，assure sb that... 為常見用法。"},{"sentence":"I want to <assure> *you* of my full support regarding your decision to pursue a career in the field of medicine.","translation":"我想向你保證，我完全支持你決定從事醫學領域的職業。","explanation":"動詞「向...保證」，assure sb of sth 為常見用法。"}],"related_forms":["assurance"]}

{"headword":"athletic","explanation":"形容詞「運動的/體育的」。指擅長運動或與運動相關的。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school provides excellent <athletic> *facilities*, including a large swimming pool and a well-equipped gym for all the students.","translation":"學校提供優良的運動設施，包括一個大型游泳池和設備齊全的健身房供所有學生使用。","explanation":"形容詞「運動的」，athletic facilities 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"He has always been very <athletic>, participating in various sports competitions since he was a young boy in elementary school.","translation":"他一直很有運動天份，從小學時起就參加各種體育比賽。","explanation":"形容詞「擅長運動的」，指人的體能狀態。"}],"related_forms":["athlete","athletics"]}

{"headword":"atmosphere","explanation":"名詞「氣氛/大氣層」。(1) 指環境氛圍時，常搭配 tense, relaxed, friendly 等形容詞。(2) 指科學上的大氣層時，常與 earth 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <atmosphere> in the classroom was *tense* as students waited for the final results of the difficult mathematics examination.","translation":"當學生們等待困難數學考試的最終結果時，教室裡的氣氛很緊張。","explanation":"指環境氛圍。搭配形容詞 tense 描述緊張感。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are studying how the Earth's <atmosphere> *protects* us from harmful solar radiation by filtering out dangerous ultraviolet rays.","translation":"科學家們正在研究地球的大氣層如何透過過濾危險的紫外線來保護我們免受有害太陽輻射的傷害。","explanation":"指科學上的大氣層。動詞 protect 與介係詞 from 是常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["atmospheres"]}

{"headword":"atom","explanation":"名詞「原子」。指物質的基本組成單位。常見於科學文章，強調微小結構。","entries":[{"sentence":"Every physical object in the universe is *composed* of tiny particles known as <atoms>, which form the building blocks of matter.","translation":"宇宙中的每個實體物體都由稱為原子的微小粒子組成，它們構成了物質的基本單元。","explanation":"指科學上的原子。片語 be composed of 為常見用法。"},{"sentence":"The scientist explained that the <atom> *consists* of a nucleus surrounded by electrons, which is a fundamental concept in chemistry.","translation":"科學家解釋說原子由原子核和周圍的電子組成，這是化學中的一個基本概念。","explanation":"指原子的結構。動詞 consist of 常用於描述組成成分。"}],"related_forms":["atoms"]}

{"headword":"atomic","explanation":"形容詞「原子的/原子能的」。多用於科學或軍事領域，如 atomic energy, atomic bomb。","entries":[{"sentence":"The country decided to invest more in <atomic> *energy* as a cleaner alternative to traditional fossil fuels for power generation.","translation":"該國決定投資更多原子能，作為發電時傳統化石燃料的更清潔替代方案。","explanation":"指原子能。搭配 energy 形成固定用法。"},{"sentence":"Researchers are using <atomic> *clocks* to measure time with extreme precision, which is essential for modern global positioning systems.","translation":"研究人員正在使用原子鐘來極其精確地測量時間，這對於現代全球定位系統至關重要。","explanation":"指與原子相關的技術。atomic clock 為專有名詞。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"attach","explanation":"動詞「附加/連接」。(1) attach A to B 將A連接到B。(2) 心理上的依戀 (be attached to)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please <attach> the *required* documents to your application form before you submit it to the human resources department today.","translation":"請在今天將所需文件附加到申請表上，再提交給人力資源部門。","explanation":"指附加文件。搭配介係詞 to。"},{"sentence":"Children often become deeply <attached> *to* their favorite toys, which provide them with a sense of security and comfort.","translation":"孩子們通常會對他們最喜歡的玩具產生深厚的依戀，這給了他們安全感和安慰。","explanation":"指心理上的依戀。be attached to 為固定用法。"}],"related_forms":["attachment","attached"]}

{"headword":"attraction","explanation":"名詞「吸引力/景點」。(1) 抽象的吸引力 (attraction to)。(2) 觀光景點 (tourist attraction)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ancient castle is the main tourist <attraction> in this small town, *drawing* thousands of visitors from all over the world.","translation":"這座古老的城堡是這個小鎮的主要觀光景點，吸引了來自世界各地的數千名遊客。","explanation":"指觀光景點。常與 tourist 搭配。"},{"sentence":"There is a strong mutual <attraction> *between* the two characters, which makes their relationship the focus of the romantic novel.","translation":"這兩個角色之間有強烈的相互吸引力，這使得他們的關係成為這部浪漫小說的焦點。","explanation":"指人與人之間的吸引力。搭配介係詞 between 或 to。"}],"related_forms":["attractions","attractive"]}

{"headword":"audio","explanation":"形容詞「聲音的/音頻的」。指與聽覺或錄音相關的技術或設備。","entries":[{"sentence":"The language lab provides high-quality <audio> *equipment* to help students improve their listening skills through daily practice and repetition.","translation":"語言實驗室提供高品質的音頻設備，幫助學生透過日常練習和重複來提高聽力技巧。","explanation":"指音頻設備。audio equipment 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"You can download the <audio> *version* of this textbook if you prefer listening to the lessons while commuting to school.","translation":"如果你喜歡在通勤上學時聽課程，你可以下載這本教科書的音頻版本。","explanation":"指聲音格式。audio version 指有聲書或錄音版本。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"authentic","explanation":"形容詞「真實的/道地的」。指物品是真的，非仿冒品，或指食物口味非常道地。","entries":[{"sentence":"The museum curator confirmed that the painting is an <authentic> *work* by the famous artist, not a copy made later.","translation":"博物館館長證實這幅畫是那位著名藝術家的真跡，而不是後來製作的複製品。","explanation":"指真實的藝術品。authentic work 指真跡。"},{"sentence":"We visited a small restaurant in Italy to enjoy <authentic> *Italian* pasta, which tasted much better than the local versions.","translation":"我們造訪了義大利的一家小餐館，品嚐了道地的義大利麵，味道比當地的版本好多了。","explanation":"指道地的食物。authentic Italian 指道地的義大利風味。"}],"related_forms":["authenticity"]}

{"headword":"authority","explanation":"名詞「權威/當局」。(1) 權力/職權 (have the authority to)。(2) 政府當局 (the authorities)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school principal has the <authority> *to* make final decisions regarding student discipline and the enforcement of campus rules.","translation":"校長有權對學生紀律和校規的執行做出最終決定。","explanation":"指職權。have the authority to V 為固定用法。"},{"sentence":"Local <authorities> *issued* a warning to residents about the approaching typhoon and advised them to stay indoors for safety.","translation":"地方當局向居民發布了關於颱風逼近的警告，並建議他們待在室內以策安全。","explanation":"指政府當局。常用複數 the authorities。"}],"related_forms":["authorities","authoritative"]}

{"headword":"autobiography","explanation":"名詞「自傳」。指作者親自撰寫的個人生平故事。","entries":[{"sentence":"In his moving <autobiography>, the former president *shares* his personal struggles and the challenges he faced during his political career.","translation":"在前總統感人的自傳中，他分享了他在政治生涯中所面臨的個人掙扎與挑戰。","explanation":"指自傳。動詞 share 常用於描述書中內容。"},{"sentence":"Writing an <autobiography> *requires* a great deal of reflection, as the author must look back on their life experiences honestly.","translation":"撰寫自傳需要大量的反思，因為作者必須誠實地回顧他們的人生經歷。","explanation":"指撰寫自傳的過程。動詞 require 搭配名詞 reflection。"}],"related_forms":["autobiographies"]}

{"headword":"autograph","explanation":"名詞/動詞「親筆簽名」。指名人親手簽下的名字。","entries":[{"sentence":"The excited fans waited for hours outside the theater, hoping to get an <autograph> *from* their favorite movie star after the show.","translation":"興奮的粉絲在劇院外等了幾個小時，希望演出結束後能得到他們最喜歡的電影明星的親筆簽名。","explanation":"指名詞簽名。搭配介係詞 from。"},{"sentence":"The famous athlete kindly <autographed> *a* baseball for the young boy, making his dream of meeting his hero come true.","translation":"那位著名的運動員親切地為小男孩在棒球上簽名，實現了他見到偶像的夢想。","explanation":"指動詞簽名。autograph a [thing] 為常見用法。"}],"related_forms":["autographs","autographed"]}

{"headword":"await","explanation":"動詞「等待」。與 wait 不同，await 為及物動詞，後面直接接名詞，不需加 for。","entries":[{"sentence":"The graduates <await> *the* results of their final exams with great anxiety, hoping to get into their dream universities this year.","translation":"畢業生們焦急地等待期末考試的結果，希望今年能進入他們夢想中的大學。","explanation":"及物動詞，後面直接接名詞，不可加 for。"},{"sentence":"A bright future <awaits> *those* who are willing to work hard and never give up on their goals despite many difficulties.","translation":"光明的未來等待著那些願意努力工作，儘管困難重重也不放棄目標的人。","explanation":"及物動詞，表示某事正等待著某人。"}],"related_forms":["awaited","awaiting"]}

{"headword":"bald","explanation":"形容詞「禿頭的」。可用於描述人，也可用於描述輪胎磨損。","entries":[{"sentence":"The man decided to shave his head completely <bald> because he felt it was easier to maintain than having thinning hair.","translation":"那個男人決定把頭剃成全禿，因為他覺得這比留著稀疏的頭髮更容易打理。","explanation":"描述人的狀態。常用 shave one's head bald。"},{"sentence":"Driving with <bald> *tires* is extremely dangerous, especially on wet roads, as they lack the grip needed for safe braking.","translation":"使用磨損的輪胎開車非常危險，尤其是在濕滑的道路上，因為它們缺乏安全煞車所需的抓地力。","explanation":"描述輪胎磨損。bald tires 指胎紋磨平的輪胎。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"ballet","explanation":"名詞「芭蕾舞」。指一種古典舞蹈藝術形式。","entries":[{"sentence":"She has been taking <ballet> *lessons* since she was five years old, dreaming of becoming a professional dancer in the future.","translation":"她從五歲起就開始上芭蕾舞課，夢想著未來能成為一名專業舞者。","explanation":"指芭蕾舞課程。搭配 lessons。"},{"sentence":"The performance of the classic <ballet> *Swan* Lake was so breathtaking that the entire audience stood up to applaud at the end.","translation":"經典芭蕾舞劇《天鵝湖》的演出令人嘆為觀止，以至於演出結束時全場觀眾都起立鼓掌。","explanation":"指芭蕾舞劇。Swan Lake 為經典劇目。"}],"related_forms":["ballets"]}

{"headword":"bandage","explanation":"名詞/動詞「繃帶/包紮」。指醫療用的繃帶或用繃帶纏繞傷口。","entries":[{"sentence":"The nurse applied a clean <bandage> *to* the patient's wound to prevent infection and help the skin heal more quickly.","translation":"護士在病人的傷口上貼了一塊乾淨的繃帶，以防止感染並幫助皮膚更快癒合。","explanation":"名詞用法。搭配介係詞 to。"},{"sentence":"After the accident, the doctor <bandaged> *up* the injured arm carefully to ensure that the bone could heal properly over time.","translation":"事故發生後，醫生小心地包紮了受傷的手臂，以確保骨頭能隨著時間適當地癒合。","explanation":"動詞用法。常搭配 up。"}],"related_forms":["bandages","bandaged"]}

{"headword":"bankrupt","explanation":"形容詞/動詞/名詞「破產」。指個人或公司失去償債能力。","entries":[{"sentence":"The small company went <bankrupt> *after* facing severe financial losses and failing to secure a loan from the local bank.","translation":"這家小公司在面臨嚴重的財務損失且未能從當地銀行獲得貸款後破產了。","explanation":"形容詞用法。go bankrupt 為固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"The sudden economic crisis <bankrupted> *many* small businesses that were already struggling to survive in a highly competitive market environment.","translation":"突如其來的經濟危機使許多在競爭激烈的市場環境中苦苦掙扎的小企業破產了。","explanation":"動詞用法。指導致破產。"}],"related_forms":["bankruptcy"]}

{"headword":"bargain","explanation":"名詞/動詞「交易/討價還價」。(1) 名詞指划算的交易 (a good bargain)。(2) 動詞指討價還價 (bargain with)。","entries":[{"sentence":"This high-quality camera was a real <bargain> *at* half the original price, so I decided to buy it immediately.","translation":"這台高品質相機以原價的一半買到真是太划算了，所以我決定馬上買下它。","explanation":"名詞用法。指划算的交易。搭配介係詞 at。"},{"sentence":"In some traditional markets, you can <bargain> *with* the vendors to get a lower price if you buy several items together.","translation":"在一些傳統市場，如果你一次買幾樣東西，你可以和攤販討價還價以獲得更低的價格。","explanation":"動詞用法。指討價還價。搭配介係詞 with。"}],"related_forms":["bargains","bargained"]}

{"headword":"barrier","explanation":"名詞「障礙/隔閡」。(1) 實體障礙 (road barrier)。(2) 抽象障礙 (language barrier)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The language <barrier> *made* it difficult for the international students to communicate effectively with their local classmates during the group project.","translation":"語言障礙使得國際學生在小組專題中很難與當地同學進行有效溝通。","explanation":"抽象障礙。language barrier 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The police set up a road <barrier> *to* block traffic and ensure the safety of the pedestrians during the annual parade.","translation":"警方設置了路障來阻擋交通，並確保年度遊行期間行人的安全。","explanation":"實體障礙。搭配介係詞 to。"}],"related_forms":["barriers"]}

{"headword":"basin","explanation":"名詞「盆地/洗臉盆」。(1) 地理上的盆地。 (2) 浴室裡的洗臉盆。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city is located in a large <basin> *surrounded* by high mountains, which often causes air pollution to get trapped inside.","translation":"這座城市位於一個被高山環繞的大盆地中，這常導致空氣污染被困在裡面。","explanation":"地理盆地。常用 surrounded by 描述其地形。"},{"sentence":"Please wash your hands in the <basin> *in* the bathroom before we start preparing the meal for the dinner party.","translation":"在我們開始為晚宴準備餐點之前，請先在浴室的洗臉盆洗手。","explanation":"指洗臉盆。搭配介係詞 in。"}],"related_forms":["basins"]}

{"headword":"battery","explanation":"名詞「電池」。指儲存電能的裝置。","entries":[{"sentence":"My laptop <battery> *ran* out of power during the meeting, so I had to find a charger to continue my presentation.","translation":"我的筆電電池在會議期間沒電了，所以我必須找個充電器來繼續我的簡報。","explanation":"指電池。run out of power 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"It is important to recycle used <batteries> *properly* because they contain chemicals that can be harmful to the environment if discarded.","translation":"正確回收廢電池很重要，因為它們含有如果隨意丟棄會對環境有害的化學物質。","explanation":"指電池。常用複數 batteries。"}],"related_forms":["batteries"]}

{"headword":"beggar","explanation":"名詞「乞丐」。指在街頭乞討的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The kind woman gave some money to the <beggar> *on* the street corner, hoping to help him buy a warm meal today.","translation":"那位善良的女士給了街角的乞丐一些錢，希望能幫助他今天買到一頓熱騰騰的飯菜。","explanation":"指乞丐。搭配介係詞 on。"},{"sentence":"Society should find ways to support the homeless and the <beggars> *rather* than simply ignoring their presence in public spaces.","translation":"社會應該想辦法支持無家可歸者和乞丐，而不是僅僅忽視他們在公共場所的存在。","explanation":"指乞丐群體。常用複數 beggars。"}],"related_forms":["beggars"]}

{"headword":"behavior","explanation":"名詞「行為/舉止」。注意拼字，美式拼法為 behavior，英式為 behaviour。常見搭配包括 good/bad behavior 以及 behavioral (形容詞)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher praised the students for their *exemplary* <behavior> during the school assembly, noting how quietly they listened to the guest speaker.","translation":"老師稱讚學生在學校集會期間的模範行為，並提到他們多麼安靜地聆聽演講者的發言。","explanation":"指個人的品行或舉止。exemplary behavior 是常見的高級搭配。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are studying the *social* <behavior> of dolphins in the wild to better understand how they communicate and hunt in groups.","translation":"科學家們正在研究野生海豚的社會行為，以更了解牠們如何在群體中溝通和狩獵。","explanation":"指動物或系統的運作模式。social behavior 是生物學與社會學常見詞彙。"}],"related_forms":["behave","behavioral"]}

{"headword":"bin","explanation":"名詞「垃圾桶/容器」。在英式英語中常用於指垃圾桶，美式英語則較常使用 trash can 或 garbage can。注意雙寫 n。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please make sure to *sort* your recyclable waste and place it into the correct <bin> before leaving the cafeteria after lunch.","translation":"午餐後離開餐廳前，請務必將可回收垃圾分類並放入正確的垃圾桶中。","explanation":"指放置垃圾的容器。sort... into the correct bin 是環保教育常見用語。"},{"sentence":"The librarian asked the students to *empty* the paper <bin> at the end of the day to keep the study room tidy.","translation":"圖書管理員要求學生在一天結束時清空紙張回收桶，以保持自習室整潔。","explanation":"指特定用途的容器。empty the bin 是常見的動詞搭配。"}],"related_forms":["bins"]}

{"headword":"biography","explanation":"名詞「傳記」。指對某人一生的紀錄。若作者寫的是自己的生平，則稱為 autobiography (自傳)。","entries":[{"sentence":"I just finished reading a *fascinating* <biography> of Steve Jobs, which details his journey from a college dropout to a tech visionary.","translation":"我剛讀完一本關於史蒂夫·賈伯斯的精彩傳記，書中詳細描述了他從大學輟學生到科技遠見者的歷程。","explanation":"指關於某人一生的書。fascinating biography 是常見的形容詞搭配。"},{"sentence":"The author spent five years *researching* for the <biography> of the famous historical figure, interviewing many people who knew him well.","translation":"作者花了五年時間研究這位歷史名人的傳記，並採訪了許多了解他的人。","explanation":"指傳記的撰寫過程。researching for the biography 顯示了寫作的嚴謹性。"}],"related_forms":["biographical","biographer"]}

{"headword":"biology","explanation":"名詞「生物學」。指研究生命現象的科學。注意其形容詞形式為 biological，相關從業人員為 biologist。","entries":[{"sentence":"In our <biology> class today, we *examined* the structure of plant cells under a microscope to see how they function in nature.","translation":"在今天的生物課上，我們用顯微鏡觀察了植物細胞的結構，以了解它們在自然界中如何運作。","explanation":"指學科名稱。biology class 是常見的校園場景。"},{"sentence":"Advances in modern <biology> have *enabled* scientists to develop new vaccines that can effectively prevent the spread of infectious diseases worldwide.","translation":"現代生物學的進步使科學家能夠開發出能有效預防傳染病在全球傳播的新疫苗。","explanation":"指科學領域。advances in biology 是學術寫作中的常見用法。"}],"related_forms":["biological","biologist"]}

{"headword":"blade","explanation":"名詞「刀刃/葉片」。可用於指刀具的鋒利部分，或草葉、螺旋槳葉片等形狀扁平的物體。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chef carefully sharpened the <blade> of his knife to ensure he could *slice* the vegetables with precision and ease.","translation":"廚師小心地磨利他的刀刃，以確保他能精確且輕鬆地切開蔬菜。","explanation":"指刀具的鋒利部分。sharpen the blade 是常見動作。"},{"sentence":"As the wind picked up, the <blade> of the windmill began to *spin* rapidly, generating clean energy for the small village nearby.","translation":"隨著風勢增強，風車的葉片開始快速旋轉，為附近的小村莊產生清潔能源。","explanation":"指風車或螺旋槳的葉片。spin rapidly 是描述其運作的常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["blades"]}

{"headword":"blend","explanation":"動詞「混合」；名詞「混合物」。強調將不同成分融合在一起，使其難以分辨個別部分。","entries":[{"sentence":"You should <blend> the ingredients *thoroughly* until the mixture becomes smooth, which is the secret to making a perfect chocolate cake.","translation":"你應該將材料徹底混合直到變得滑順，這是做出完美巧克力蛋糕的秘訣。","explanation":"動詞用法。blend thoroughly 是強調混合程度的常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The new building features a unique <blend> of *modern* architecture and traditional design, making it a landmark in the city center.","translation":"這棟新建築結合了現代建築與傳統設計的獨特風格，使其成為市中心的標誌性建築。","explanation":"名詞用法。a blend of A and B 是固定句型。"}],"related_forms":["blended","blender"]}

{"headword":"blessing","explanation":"名詞「祝福/幸運的事」。常指來自神或長輩的祝福，也可用於指一件雖然起初看起來不好，但結果卻是好事的情況 (a blessing in disguise)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Receiving a scholarship was a true <blessing> for the student, as it *relieved* the financial burden on his family during his studies.","translation":"獲得獎學金對這名學生來說真是個祝福，因為這減輕了他求學期間家庭的經濟負擔。","explanation":"指幸運的事。a true blessing 強調其重要性。"},{"sentence":"Losing his job turned out to be a <blessing> in *disguise* because it gave him the opportunity to pursue his dream career.","translation":"失去工作結果竟是因禍得福，因為這給了他追求夢想職業的機會。","explanation":"固定片語 a blessing in disguise (因禍得福)。"}],"related_forms":["bless"]}

{"headword":"blink","explanation":"動詞「眨眼」；名詞「眨眼」。指眼睛快速開合。常見片語 in the blink of an eye (轉眼間)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The bright light caused everyone in the room to <blink> *repeatedly* as they tried to adjust their eyes to the sudden change.","translation":"強光導致房間裡的每個人都不停地眨眼，因為他們試圖讓眼睛適應這突如其來的變化。","explanation":"動詞用法。blink repeatedly 描述持續的動作。"},{"sentence":"Everything changed in the <blink> of an *eye*, leaving the spectators in complete shock as the underdog team won the championship.","translation":"一切都在轉眼間改變了，當弱勢隊伍贏得冠軍時，觀眾們感到無比震驚。","explanation":"固定片語 in the blink of an eye，意指極短的時間內。"}],"related_forms":["blinks","blinked"]}

{"headword":"bloom","explanation":"名詞「花/開花期」；動詞「開花」。強調植物盛開的狀態，也可用於比喻人的才華或美貌展現。","entries":[{"sentence":"The cherry trees are in full <bloom> this week, *attracting* thousands of tourists who want to take photos of the beautiful pink flowers.","translation":"櫻花樹這週正值盛開期，吸引了成千上萬想要拍攝美麗粉紅色花朵的遊客。","explanation":"名詞用法。in full bloom 是描述花朵盛開的固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"These flowers usually <bloom> in *early* spring when the temperature begins to rise and the days become longer and warmer.","translation":"這些花通常在初春時開花，那時氣溫開始回升，白天也變得更長、更溫暖。","explanation":"動詞用法。描述植物的生長週期。"}],"related_forms":["blooms","bloomed"]}

{"headword":"blossom","explanation":"名詞「花/開花」；動詞「開花/發展」。與 bloom 意思相近，但 blossom 常指果樹的花，或比喻關係、才華的發展。","entries":[{"sentence":"The apple trees are covered in white <blossom>, *promising* a bountiful harvest of fresh fruit for the farmers later this autumn.","translation":"蘋果樹上開滿了白色的花朵，預示著農民今年秋天將會有豐碩的水果收成。","explanation":"名詞用法。指果樹的花。"},{"sentence":"Their friendship began to <blossom> during the summer camp, as they *shared* many common interests and spent time talking every single day.","translation":"他們的友誼在夏令營期間開始發展，因為他們分享了許多共同興趣，並且每天都花時間聊天。","explanation":"動詞用法。比喻關係的發展。"}],"related_forms":["blossoms","blossomed"]}

{"headword":"boast","explanation":"動詞「吹噓/擁有(引以為傲的事物)」；名詞「吹噓」。注意 boast of/about sth 的用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"He likes to <boast> *about* his academic achievements, which often makes his classmates feel uncomfortable during group discussions and study sessions.","translation":"他喜歡吹噓自己的學業成就，這常讓同學在小組討論和讀書會時感到不自在。","explanation":"動詞用法。boast about/of sth 指自誇。"},{"sentence":"The university <boasts> a *state-of-the-art* library that provides students with access to millions of books and digital research resources.","translation":"這所大學引以為傲地擁有一座最先進的圖書館，為學生提供數百萬冊書籍和數位研究資源的管道。","explanation":"動詞用法。指某地擁有值得驕傲的設施。"}],"related_forms":["boasts","boasted"]}

{"headword":"bond","explanation":"名詞「連結/羈絆/債券」；動詞「建立連結」。指人與人之間的情感聯繫，或化學上的鍵結。","entries":[{"sentence":"The shared experience of overcoming challenges helped to *strengthen* the <bond> between the two teammates, creating a lifelong friendship.","translation":"共同克服挑戰的經歷有助於加強兩位隊友之間的羈絆，建立起終身的友誼。","explanation":"名詞用法。strengthen the bond 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"New mothers often <bond> with their babies through *physical* contact and constant care during the first few months of life.","translation":"新手媽媽通常在寶寶出生後的最初幾個月，透過身體接觸和持續的照顧與寶寶建立連結。","explanation":"動詞用法。指建立情感連結。"}],"related_forms":["bonds","bonded"]}

{"headword":"bounce","explanation":"動詞「彈跳」；名詞「彈跳」。指物體撞擊表面後反彈，也可用於形容人的活力 (bouncy)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The basketball started to <bounce> *erratically* on the uneven ground, making it difficult for the player to maintain control of the ball.","translation":"籃球開始在不平的地面上不規則地彈跳，使得球員很難保持對球的控制。","explanation":"動詞用法。bounce erratically 描述彈跳不穩定。"},{"sentence":"The child watched the colorful ball <bounce> *off* the wall and roll across the room toward the open door in the hallway.","translation":"孩子看著彩色的球從牆上彈開，滾過房間朝走廊上敞開的門滾去。","explanation":"動詞用法。bounce off sth 是固定搭配。"}],"related_forms":["bounces","bounced"]}

{"headword":"bracelet","explanation":"名詞「手鍊/手鐲」。指戴在手腕上的裝飾品。","entries":[{"sentence":"She received a beautiful silver <bracelet> as a *birthday* gift from her best friend, and she wears it every single day.","translation":"她從最好的朋友那裡收到一條美麗的銀手鍊作為生日禮物，而且她每天都戴著它。","explanation":"名詞用法。birthday gift 是常見的搭配。"},{"sentence":"The antique <bracelet> was *decorated* with small diamonds, making it a very valuable piece of jewelry in her collection.","translation":"這條古董手鍊裝飾著小鑽石，使它成為她收藏中非常有價值的一件珠寶。","explanation":"名詞用法。decorated with 是描述飾品的常見用法。"}],"related_forms":["bracelets"]}

{"headword":"breed","explanation":"名詞「品種」；動詞「繁殖/飼養」。指動物的種類，或指培育動物的行為。","entries":[{"sentence":"This specific <breed> of dog is known for its *friendly* nature and high intelligence, making it a popular choice for families.","translation":"這種特定的狗品種以其友善的天性和高智商而聞名，這使它成為家庭的熱門選擇。","explanation":"名詞用法。指動物品種。"},{"sentence":"Farmers often <breed> cattle to *improve* the quality of their meat and milk, ensuring they can meet the market demand efficiently.","translation":"農民經常飼養牛隻以提高肉和奶的品質，確保他們能有效地滿足市場需求。","explanation":"動詞用法。指培育動物。"}],"related_forms":["breeds","bred"]}

{"headword":"bridegroom","explanation":"名詞「新郎」。通常簡稱為 groom。指婚禮當天結婚的男性。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <bridegroom> stood at the altar, waiting *anxiously* for his bride to walk down the aisle in her beautiful white wedding dress.","translation":"新郎站在祭壇前，焦急地等待著他的新娘穿著美麗的白色婚紗走過紅毯。","explanation":"名詞用法。指婚禮中的男性角色。"},{"sentence":"All the guests cheered as the <bridegroom> and his bride *exchanged* their wedding vows during the emotional ceremony in the garden.","translation":"當新郎和新娘在花園裡感人的儀式中交換結婚誓詞時，所有的客人都歡呼起來。","explanation":"名詞用法。exchanged vows 是婚禮常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["groom"]}

{"headword":"broke","explanation":"形容詞「身無分文的」。為 break 的過去式，但在此作為形容詞使用，意指沒錢。注意不可與 broken (損壞的) 混淆。","entries":[{"sentence":"After paying for his tuition and rent, he was completely <broke> and had to *rely* on instant noodles for the rest of the month.","translation":"在支付學費和房租後，他完全身無分文，不得不靠泡麵度過這個月的剩餘時間。","explanation":"形容詞用法。be broke 是口語中表示沒錢的常見說法。"},{"sentence":"Many students find themselves <broke> by the end of the semester because they *spend* too much money on social activities and dining out.","translation":"許多學生發現自己在學期末時身無分文，因為他們在社交活動和外食上花太多錢了。","explanation":"形容詞用法。描述經濟拮据的狀態。"}],"related_forms":["break"]}

{"headword":"broom","explanation":"名詞「掃帚」。用於清掃地面的工具。","entries":[{"sentence":"The janitor used a long-handled <broom> to *sweep* the dust and fallen leaves off the school playground before the students arrived.","translation":"清潔工在學生到達之前，用長柄掃帚清掃學校操場上的灰塵和落葉。","explanation":"名詞用法。sweep with a broom 是常見動作。"},{"sentence":"Please put the <broom> back in the *storage* closet after you finish cleaning the classroom so that it stays organized.","translation":"請在清掃完教室後將掃帚放回儲藏室，以便保持整潔。","explanation":"名詞用法。指工具的存放。"}],"related_forms":["brooms"]}

{"headword":"brutal","explanation":"形容詞「殘忍的/嚴酷的」。可用於形容暴力行為，或形容天氣、競爭等極端嚴苛的情況。","entries":[{"sentence":"The soldiers faced <brutal> conditions during the winter, with *freezing* temperatures and very little food to survive the harsh environment.","translation":"士兵們在冬天面臨嚴酷的條件，氣溫極低，且幾乎沒有食物能在惡劣的環境中生存。","explanation":"形容詞用法。指環境或天氣極端嚴苛。"},{"sentence":"The competition for the limited number of scholarships was <brutal>, as all the applicants were *highly* qualified and motivated students.","translation":"有限獎學金的競爭非常殘酷，因為所有的申請者都是高素質且積極進取的學生。","explanation":"形容詞用法。指競爭非常激烈。"}],"related_forms":["brutality"]}

{"headword":"bulletin","explanation":"名詞「公告/簡報」。指發布重要消息的短文或看板。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school posted a <bulletin> on the notice board to *inform* students about the upcoming changes to the library's opening hours.","translation":"學校在佈告欄上張貼了一則公告，通知學生關於圖書館開放時間即將變動的消息。","explanation":"名詞用法。post a bulletin 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"We receive a weekly <bulletin> from the department that *highlights* important events, deadlines, and news for all the students enrolled.","translation":"我們每週會收到系上發出的簡報，重點介紹所有註冊學生的重要活動、截止日期和新聞。","explanation":"名詞用法。指定期發布的資訊。"}],"related_forms":["bulletins"]}

{"headword":"burglar","explanation":"指「竊賊」，特別指闖入建築物行竊的人。與 thief（泛指小偷）不同，burglar 強調非法侵入住宅或建築物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <burglar> *broke into* the house through the back window while the family was away on their summer vacation.","translation":"竊賊趁這家人去暑假度假時，從後窗闖入了房子。","explanation":"描述闖入行為，搭配動詞 break into。"},{"sentence":"Police are searching for the <burglar> who *stole* valuable jewelry from several homes in this quiet residential neighborhood last night.","translation":"警方正在搜尋昨晚從這個安靜住宅區幾戶人家中偷走貴重珠寶的竊賊。","explanation":"描述竊賊的犯罪行為，搭配動詞 steal。"}],"related_forms":["burglary"]}

{"headword":"cabinet","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 名詞「櫥櫃」，如 kitchen cabinet；(2) 名詞「內閣」，指政府的高級官員會議。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please put the dishes back into the kitchen <cabinet> after you have finished washing and drying them this evening.","translation":"今晚洗完碗盤並擦乾後，請將它們放回廚房櫥櫃裡。","explanation":"指家具櫥櫃，常見於居家生活場景。"},{"sentence":"The Prime Minister held an emergency meeting with the <cabinet> to discuss the *economic crisis* facing the entire nation.","translation":"總理與內閣召開了緊急會議，討論全國面臨的經濟危機。","explanation":"指政府內閣，常與 meeting, minister 等字連用。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"calculate","explanation":"動詞「計算」，指透過數學運算得出結果，或指「估計、推測」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students are required to <calculate> the *total cost* of the project by adding up all the expenses incurred during the process.","translation":"學生必須透過加總過程中產生的所有費用，來計算該專案的總成本。","explanation":"指數學上的計算，搭配 total cost。"},{"sentence":"It is difficult to <calculate> the *exact impact* of climate change on local agriculture over the next few decades.","translation":"很難計算氣候變遷在未來幾十年對當地農業造成的確切影響。","explanation":"指估計或預測，常用於學術討論。"}],"related_forms":["calculation","calculator"]}

{"headword":"calculation","explanation":"名詞「計算」，指運算的過程或結果，也可用於指「深思熟慮的計畫」。","entries":[{"sentence":"After a quick <calculation>, the accountant realized that the company had *exceeded its budget* for the first quarter of the year.","translation":"經過快速計算後，會計師意識到公司第一季的預算超支了。","explanation":"指數學運算過程，搭配動詞 realize。"},{"sentence":"His decision to resign was based on a careful <calculation> of his *future career* prospects in the competitive tech industry.","translation":"他辭職的決定是基於對自己在競爭激烈的科技產業中未來職涯前景的審慎評估。","explanation":"指深思熟慮的評估或盤算。"}],"related_forms":["calculate","calculator"]}

{"headword":"calorie","explanation":"名詞「卡路里」，指熱量單位。在健康議題中，常與 intake（攝取量）或 burn（消耗）搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"To maintain a healthy weight, you should pay attention to your daily <calorie> *intake* and engage in regular physical exercise.","translation":"為了維持健康體重，你應該注意每日的卡路里攝取量，並進行規律的體育鍛鍊。","explanation":"指熱量攝取，搭配 intake。"},{"sentence":"Running for thirty minutes can help you <burn> a significant number of <calories>, which is beneficial for your overall fitness level.","translation":"跑步三十分鐘可以幫助你消耗大量的卡路里，這對你的整體健康水準很有幫助。","explanation":"指消耗熱量，常用動詞 burn。"}],"related_forms":["caloric"]}

{"headword":"campaign","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 名詞「活動/運動」，如 political campaign, advertising campaign；(2) 動詞「發起運動/參與競選」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The environmental group launched a nationwide <campaign> to *raise awareness* about the importance of reducing plastic waste in our oceans.","translation":"環保團體發起了一項全國性的運動，以提高人們對減少海洋塑膠垃圾重要性的認識。","explanation":"名詞，指為了特定目的發起的活動，搭配 raise awareness。"},{"sentence":"The senator spent several months <campaigning> across the country to *gain support* from voters before the upcoming general election.","translation":"在即將到來的大選前，這位參議員花了幾個月在全國各地競選，以爭取選民的支持。","explanation":"動詞，指參與競選或推動運動，搭配 gain support。"}],"related_forms":["campaigner"]}

{"headword":"candidate","explanation":"名詞「候選人」或「應徵者」。指參加選舉的人，或申請職位的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"Each <candidate> for the student council president must deliver a speech to *present their vision* for the school's future development.","translation":"每位學生會會長候選人都必須發表一場演說，以呈現他們對學校未來發展的願景。","explanation":"指選舉候選人，搭配 present their vision。"},{"sentence":"The human resources manager interviewed every qualified <candidate> to find the best person for the *challenging position* in the marketing department.","translation":"人力資源經理面試了每一位合格的應徵者，以找到最適合行銷部門這個挑戰性職位的人選。","explanation":"指求職者，搭配 interview。"}],"related_forms":["candidacy"]}

{"headword":"cane","explanation":"名詞「手杖」或「藤條」。指輔助行走用的杖，或植物的莖。","entries":[{"sentence":"The elderly man walked slowly down the street, leaning heavily on his wooden <cane> to *maintain his balance* on the uneven sidewalk.","translation":"那位老先生緩慢地走在街上，沉重地倚靠著他的木製手杖，以在不平的人行道上保持平衡。","explanation":"指輔助行走的手杖，搭配 lean on。"},{"sentence":"Sugar <cane> is widely grown in tropical regions and is the *primary source* of sugar production for many countries around the world.","translation":"甘蔗在熱帶地區廣泛種植，是世界上許多國家生產糖的主要來源。","explanation":"指植物的莖，如 sugar cane。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"canoe","explanation":"名詞「獨木舟」；動詞「划獨木舟」。","entries":[{"sentence":"We rented a <canoe> and paddled across the calm lake to explore the *hidden island* located in the middle of the water.","translation":"我們租了一艘獨木舟，划過平靜的湖面，去探索位於水中央的隱密小島。","explanation":"名詞，指交通工具，搭配 paddle。"},{"sentence":"During our summer camp, we had the opportunity to <canoe> down the river and enjoy the *breathtaking scenery* along the riverbanks.","translation":"在夏令營期間，我們有機會沿著河流划獨木舟，並欣賞河岸邊令人屏息的景色。","explanation":"動詞，指划船的動作。"}],"related_forms":["canoeing"]}

{"headword":"capacity","explanation":"名詞「容量」、「能力」或「職位」。指能容納的空間，或某人能做某事的能力。","entries":[{"sentence":"The stadium has a seating <capacity> of fifty thousand people, making it the perfect venue for *large-scale concerts* and sports events.","translation":"這座體育場有五萬人的座位容量，使其成為舉辦大型演唱會和體育賽事的完美場地。","explanation":"指容量，搭配 seating capacity。"},{"sentence":"She has the amazing <capacity> to *stay calm* under pressure, which makes her an excellent leader in times of crisis.","translation":"她有在壓力下保持冷靜的驚人能力，這使她成為危機時刻中優秀的領導者。","explanation":"指能力，搭配 stay calm。"}],"related_forms":["capacitate"]}

{"headword":"capital","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 名詞「首都」；(2) 名詞「資本/資金」；(3) 名詞「大寫字母」。注意 capitalism 為「資本主義」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Taipei is the <capital> of Taiwan and serves as the *political and economic center* of the entire island nation.","translation":"台北是台灣的首都，也是整個島國的政治與經濟中心。","explanation":"指首都，常與 city 搭配。"},{"sentence":"The startup company needs to raise more <capital> from investors to *expand its business* and develop new products for the market.","translation":"這家新創公司需要從投資者那裡籌集更多資金，以擴展業務並開發市場新產品。","explanation":"指資金，搭配 raise capital。"}],"related_forms":["capitalism","capitalist"]}

{"headword":"capitalist","explanation":"名詞「資本家」或「資本主義者」。指支持資本主義制度的人，或擁有大量資本的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <capitalist> argued that *free market* competition is the most effective way to drive innovation and economic growth in society.","translation":"那位資本家主張，自由市場競爭是推動社會創新與經濟成長最有效的方式。","explanation":"指支持資本主義的人，搭配 free market。"},{"sentence":"Many critics of the <capitalist> system believe that it often leads to *wealth inequality* and social division among different groups of people.","translation":"許多資本主義制度的批評者認為，它往往會導致財富不均以及不同群體之間的社會分裂。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指與資本主義相關的。"}],"related_forms":["capital","capitalism"]}

{"headword":"cargo","explanation":"名詞「貨物」，指船隻、飛機或車輛運載的貨物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ship was carrying a heavy <cargo> of electronic goods that were *destined for* major ports across the European continent.","translation":"這艘船載運著大批電子產品貨物，目的地是歐洲大陸各個主要港口。","explanation":"指運載的貨物，搭配 carry。"},{"sentence":"The airport has a special terminal dedicated to handling air <cargo> to ensure *efficient delivery* of international packages and mail.","translation":"機場設有專門處理航空貨物的航廈，以確保國際包裹與郵件的高效遞送。","explanation":"指航空貨物，搭配 air cargo。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"carrier","explanation":"名詞「運輸工具」、「電信業者」或「帶原者」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The airline is a major <carrier> that provides *international flights* connecting many cities around the world on a daily basis.","translation":"這家航空公司是一家主要的運輸業者，提供連接世界各地許多城市的國際航班。","explanation":"指運輸業者，如航空公司。"},{"sentence":"Some people can be a <carrier> of the virus without showing any *obvious symptoms*, which makes disease prevention more difficult.","translation":"有些人可能是病毒的帶原者卻沒有表現出任何明顯症狀，這使得疾病預防更加困難。","explanation":"指疾病帶原者，搭配 virus。"}],"related_forms":["carry"]}

{"headword":"carve","explanation":"動詞「雕刻」或「切（肉）」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The artist spent months trying to <carve> a beautiful statue out of a *large block* of marble for the museum exhibition.","translation":"藝術家花了幾個月的時間，試圖從一大塊大理石中雕刻出一座美麗的雕像，以供博物館展覽。","explanation":"指雕刻藝術品，搭配 marble。"},{"sentence":"It is a tradition for the father to <carve> the turkey during the *Thanksgiving dinner* while the whole family gathers around.","translation":"在感恩節晚餐時，由父親負責切火雞是一項傳統，全家人都會圍聚在一起。","explanation":"指切肉，特別指節慶食物。"}],"related_forms":["carving"]}

{"headword":"catalogue","explanation":"名詞「目錄」；動詞「將...編入目錄」。","entries":[{"sentence":"I looked through the university <catalogue> to find a list of *required courses* for my major in the upcoming semester.","translation":"我瀏覽了大學目錄，以找到下學期主修課程的必修清單。","explanation":"指課程或商品目錄。"},{"sentence":"The librarian spent the entire morning <cataloguing> the *new books* that had just arrived at the library from the publisher.","translation":"圖書館員花了一整個早上將剛從出版社送到圖書館的新書編入目錄。","explanation":"動詞，指編目作業。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"category","explanation":"名詞「類別」或「範疇」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The bookstore organizes its books into different <categories> so that customers can easily find their *favorite genres* of literature.","translation":"書店將書籍分類，以便顧客能輕鬆找到他們喜愛的文學類型。","explanation":"指分類，常用複數 categories。"},{"sentence":"Athletes are divided into different weight <categories> to ensure that the *competitive environment* remains fair for everyone involved.","translation":"運動員被分為不同的體重級別，以確保對所有參與者而言，競爭環境保持公平。","explanation":"指比賽級別或範疇。"}],"related_forms":["categorize"]}

{"headword":"cease","explanation":"動詞「停止/終止」。較 formal 的用法，常指停止某種狀態或行為。","entries":[{"sentence":"The heavy rain finally <ceased> after three days, allowing the rescue team to *resume their search* for the missing hikers.","translation":"大雨在三天後終於停止，讓搜救隊得以恢復對失蹤登山客的搜尋。","explanation":"指停止狀態，搭配 resume。"},{"sentence":"Both countries agreed to <cease> fire immediately to *prevent further casualties* and seek a peaceful solution to the conflict.","translation":"兩國同意立即停火，以防止更多傷亡並尋求衝突的和平解決方案。","explanation":"指停止行為，如 cease fire（停火）。"}],"related_forms":["ceaseless"]}

{"headword":"celebration","explanation":"名詞「慶祝」或「慶祝活動」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The entire city was filled with joy during the <celebration> of the *national holiday*, with fireworks lighting up the night sky.","translation":"在國定假日的慶祝活動期間，整座城市充滿了歡樂，煙火照亮了夜空。","explanation":"指慶祝活動，搭配 national holiday。"},{"sentence":"We organized a small party in <celebration> of our team's *great achievement* in the national science competition last week.","translation":"我們舉辦了一個小型派對，以慶祝我們團隊上週在全國科學競賽中的重大成就。","explanation":"片語 in celebration of，表「為了慶祝...」。"}],"related_forms":["celebrate","celebrity"]}

{"headword":"chamber","explanation":"名詞「房間」、「議事廳」或「腔室」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The members of the parliament gathered in the main <chamber> to *debate the new law* that would affect the entire country.","translation":"國會議員聚集在主議事廳，辯論將影響全國的新法律。","explanation":"指議事廳，搭配 debate。"},{"sentence":"The heart has four <chambers> that work together to *pump blood* throughout the human body efficiently every single second.","translation":"心臟有四個腔室，它們共同運作，每一秒都有效地將血液輸送到全身。","explanation":"指生物學上的腔室，搭配 pump blood。"}],"related_forms":[]}
