{"headword":"depart","explanation":"動詞「離開/出發」。比 leave 更正式，常用於交通運輸。","entries":[{"sentence":"The train is scheduled to <depart> from the *main* station at exactly eight o'clock, so please arrive at least ten minutes early.","translation":"火車預定在八點整從總站出發，所以請至少提早十分鐘到達。","explanation":"depart from... 為固定搭配，意指從某地出發。"},{"sentence":"After the meeting, the CEO <departed> for a *business* trip to Europe to discuss the new partnership with international investors.","translation":"會議結束後，執行長出發前往歐洲進行商務旅行，討論與國際投資者的新合作關係。","explanation":"depart for... 為固定搭配，意指前往某地。"}],"related_forms":["departs","departed","departing","departure"]}

{"headword":"departure","explanation":"名詞「離開/出發」。常用於機場或車站的時刻表。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please check the <departure> *board* at the airport to confirm the gate number and the boarding time for your flight.","translation":"請查看機場的離境看板，以確認您航班的登機門號碼和登機時間。","explanation":"departure board 為常見搭配，意指離境看板。"},{"sentence":"The sudden <departure> of the manager caused a lot of *confusion* among the staff members regarding the upcoming project deadlines.","translation":"經理的突然離職在員工之間引起了許多關於即將到來的專案截止日期的困惑。","explanation":"名詞「離開/離職」。"}],"related_forms":["departures","depart"]}

{"headword":"dependent","explanation":"形容詞「依賴的」；名詞「受撫養者」。注意與 depend on 的搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"The success of the new project is highly <dependent> *on* the cooperation between the marketing and product development departments.","translation":"新專案的成功高度依賴於行銷部門與產品開發部門之間的合作。","explanation":"be dependent on 為固定用法，意指依賴於。"},{"sentence":"As a single parent, he has two young <dependents> who rely on his *income* to cover their daily living expenses.","translation":"作為單親家長，他有兩位需要撫養的人，他們依賴他的收入來支付日常開銷。","explanation":"名詞「受撫養者」。"}],"related_forms":["depend","dependence"]}

{"headword":"depression","explanation":"名詞用法：(1)「憂鬱症」或「沮喪的情緒」，常搭配 suffer from；(2)「經濟蕭條/不景氣」，如 The Great Depression；(3)「凹陷處」。注意與 depressed (形容詞) 的區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students suffer from <depression> due to *academic pressure* and the fear of failing their final entrance examinations this year.","translation":"許多學生因為學業壓力以及害怕在今年的期末入學考試中失敗而深受憂鬱症之苦。","explanation":"指心理狀態的憂鬱症。suffer from depression 是常見的搭配。"},{"sentence":"The country is currently facing a severe economic <depression>, which has led to a *sharp rise* in the national unemployment rate.","translation":"該國目前面臨嚴重的經濟蕭條，這導致全國失業率急劇上升。","explanation":"指經濟上的蕭條。常與 economic 搭配使用。"}],"related_forms":["depress","depressed","depressing"]}

{"headword":"deserve","explanation":"動詞用法：(1)「應得/值得」，後接名詞或不定詞 to V；(2) 常見用法 deserve + V-ing (主動表被動)。注意不可用於進行式。","entries":[{"sentence":"After working hard on the research project for months, the team <deserves> *to win* the first prize in the competition.","translation":"在研究計畫上努力了數月後，該團隊值得贏得比賽的第一名。","explanation":"deserve + to V 表示值得做某事或獲得某物。"},{"sentence":"The complex historical issues discussed in the lecture <deserve> *careful consideration* before we draw any final conclusions about the event.","translation":"講座中討論的複雜歷史議題在我們對該事件得出最終結論前，值得仔細考量。","explanation":"deserve + 名詞，表示值得某種對待。"}],"related_forms":["deserved","deserving"]}

{"headword":"desperate","explanation":"形容詞用法：(1)「絕望的/走投無路的」；(2)「極度渴望的」，後接 for sth 或 to V。注意拼字與 desperate 相關的副詞為 desperately。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <desperate> refugees were *in search of* food and shelter after their homes were completely destroyed by the massive earthquake.","translation":"在房屋被大地震完全摧毀後，那些絕望的難民正在尋找食物和避難所。","explanation":"形容處境絕望、走投無路。"},{"sentence":"He is <desperate> *to improve* his English proficiency so that he can apply for an exchange program in the United States.","translation":"他極度渴望提升英語能力，以便能申請美國的交換學生計畫。","explanation":"desperate to V 表示極度渴望做某事。"}],"related_forms":["desperately","desperation"]}

{"headword":"despite","explanation":"介係詞用法：(1)「儘管/雖然」，後接名詞、代名詞或 V-ing。注意 despite 後面不可直接接子句 (S+V)，若要接子句需用 in spite of the fact that 或 although。","entries":[{"sentence":"<Despite> the *heavy rain*, the outdoor music festival continued as scheduled, attracting thousands of enthusiastic fans to the city center.","translation":"儘管下著大雨，戶外音樂節仍按計畫進行，吸引了數千名熱情的粉絲來到市中心。","explanation":"despite + 名詞片語，表讓步。"},{"sentence":"<Despite> *working* overtime every day, the manager still could not finish the urgent report before the deadline this afternoon.","translation":"儘管每天加班，經理仍然無法在今天下午的截止日期前完成那份緊急報告。","explanation":"despite + V-ing，表儘管做了某事。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"destruction","explanation":"名詞用法：(1)「破壞/毀滅」，常與 cause, lead to 搭配。注意動詞形式為 destroy，形容詞為 destructive。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hurricane caused widespread <destruction> *to* the coastal villages, leaving many families without electricity or clean water for weeks.","translation":"颶風對沿海村莊造成了廣泛的破壞，導致許多家庭數週沒有電力或乾淨的水可用。","explanation":"cause destruction to sth 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"Environmentalists are warning that the <destruction> *of* the rainforest will have a long-term negative impact on the global climate.","translation":"環保人士警告說，雨林的破壞將對全球氣候產生長期的負面影響。","explanation":"destruction of sth 表示某物的毀滅。"}],"related_forms":["destroy","destructive"]}

{"headword":"detective","explanation":"名詞/形容詞用法：(1) 名詞「偵探/刑警」；(2) 形容詞「偵探的/偵測的」。常與 mystery, story 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"The experienced <detective> spent several weeks *investigating* the mysterious case, eventually finding the crucial evidence hidden in the old warehouse.","translation":"那位經驗豐富的偵探花了數週調查這起神秘案件，最終在舊倉庫裡找到了隱藏的關鍵證據。","explanation":"名詞用法，指職業偵探。"},{"sentence":"She enjoys reading <detective> *novels* because they always challenge her to think logically and solve complex puzzles along with the characters.","translation":"她喜歡閱讀偵探小說，因為它們總是挑戰她進行邏輯思考，並與書中角色一起解開複雜的謎題。","explanation":"形容詞用法，修飾 novels。"}],"related_forms":["detect","detection"]}

{"headword":"determination","explanation":"名詞用法：(1)「決心/堅定」，常搭配 show, have, with。注意動詞為 determine，形容詞為 determined。","entries":[{"sentence":"With great <determination>, the young athlete overcame her injury and finally *qualified for* the Olympic Games after years of training.","translation":"憑藉著巨大的決心，這位年輕運動員克服了傷勢，在多年訓練後終於獲得奧運參賽資格。","explanation":"with determination 表示帶著決心。"},{"sentence":"His <determination> *to succeed* in the business world motivated him to study hard and learn from his previous failures.","translation":"他要在商業世界成功的決心激勵他努力學習，並從之前的失敗中汲取教訓。","explanation":"determination to V 是常見的用法。"}],"related_forms":["determine","determined"]}

{"headword":"device","explanation":"名詞用法：(1)「裝置/設備/儀器」，常指小型的電子產品。注意與 devise (動詞) 的拼字區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"This new electronic <device> is designed to *monitor* your heart rate and sleep quality throughout the day and night.","translation":"這款新的電子裝置旨在全天候監測您的心率和睡眠品質。","explanation":"指電子設備。"},{"sentence":"The teacher used a visual <device> to help students *understand* the abstract concepts of physics more effectively during the class.","translation":"老師使用了一種視覺輔助工具，幫助學生在課堂上更有效地理解抽象的物理概念。","explanation":"指輔助工具或裝置。"}],"related_forms":["devise"]}

{"headword":"devise","explanation":"動詞用法：(1)「設計/發明/策劃」，常用於計畫、系統或方法。注意與 device (名詞) 的拼字區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The engineering team needs to <devise> a more efficient *system* to reduce energy consumption in the factory by next month.","translation":"工程團隊需要設計出一套更有效率的系統，以在下個月前減少工廠的能源消耗。","explanation":"devise a system/plan 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are trying to <devise> a new *method* for cleaning up oil spills in the ocean without harming marine life.","translation":"科學家們正試圖設計一種清理海洋漏油的新方法，且不傷害海洋生物。","explanation":"devise a method 指發明或策劃出某種方法。"}],"related_forms":["device"]}

{"headword":"devote","explanation":"動詞用法：(1)「致力於/奉獻」，固定搭配 devote oneself/time/energy to + N/V-ing。注意 to 是介係詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"She decided to <devote> her life *to* helping underprivileged children receive a better education in remote rural areas of the country.","translation":"她決定將一生奉獻給幫助偏遠農村地區的弱勢兒童獲得更好的教育。","explanation":"devote sth to sth，注意 to 是介係詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing。"},{"sentence":"The professor <devoted> most of his *research* time to studying the effects of climate change on local biodiversity in Taiwan.","translation":"教授將他大部分的研究時間致力於研究氣候變遷對台灣當地生物多樣性的影響。","explanation":"devote time to V-ing，表示將時間投入於某事。"}],"related_forms":["devoted","devotion"]}

{"headword":"dew","explanation":"名詞用法：(1)「露水」。常在文學或描寫清晨的場景中出現。","entries":[{"sentence":"The grass in the garden was still wet with <dew> when we went for a *morning walk* at sunrise today.","translation":"當我們今天日出時去晨間散步時，花園裡的草地上還沾著露水。","explanation":"指早晨的露水。"},{"sentence":"Small drops of <dew> *sparkled* like diamonds under the early morning sunlight, creating a beautiful scene in the quiet park.","translation":"清晨的陽光下，小小的露珠像鑽石般閃閃發光，在寧靜的公園裡營造出美麗的景象。","explanation":"描寫露水的狀態。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"diagram","explanation":"名詞/動詞用法：(1) 名詞「圖表/圖解」；(2) 動詞「用圖表表示」。常與 label, draw 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please look at the <diagram> on page ten to *better understand* how the human circulatory system functions in our daily lives.","translation":"請看第十頁的圖表，以更了解人體循環系統在我們日常生活中是如何運作的。","explanation":"名詞用法，指圖解。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to <diagram> the *structure* of the sentence to show they understood the basic rules of grammar.","translation":"老師要求學生將句子的結構畫成圖表，以顯示他們理解基本的語法規則。","explanation":"動詞用法，指將某物畫成圖表。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"differ","explanation":"動詞用法：(1)「不同/有差異」，常搭配 differ from。注意與 different (形容詞) 的區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"The opinions of the two experts <differ> *significantly* from each other regarding the long-term effects of the new government policy.","translation":"兩位專家對於新政府政策的長期影響，意見有顯著的不同。","explanation":"differ from sth，表示與某物不同。"},{"sentence":"Although they are twins, their personalities <differ> *in many ways*, with one being very outgoing and the other quite shy.","translation":"雖然他們是雙胞胎，但他們的個性在許多方面都不同，一個非常外向，另一個則相當害羞。","explanation":"differ in + 方面，表示在某方面不同。"}],"related_forms":["different","difference"]}

{"headword":"digest","explanation":"動詞/名詞用法：(1) 動詞「消化/吸收知識」；(2) 名詞「摘要/文摘」。注意動詞重音在第二音節，名詞重音在第一音節。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is difficult for the human body to <digest> *fatty foods* if they are consumed in large quantities late at night.","translation":"如果深夜大量食用油膩食物，人體是很難消化的。","explanation":"動詞用法，指生理上的消化。"},{"sentence":"After reading the long article, I found it helpful to read a short <digest> to *summarize* the main points of the argument.","translation":"讀完那篇長文章後，我發現閱讀一篇簡短的摘要來總結論點的主要內容很有幫助。","explanation":"名詞用法，指摘要。"}],"related_forms":["digestion","digestive"]}

{"headword":"digital","explanation":"形容詞用法：(1)「數位的/數位化的」。常與 technology, device, age 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"In this <digital> *age*, most students prefer to read e-books on their tablets rather than carrying heavy printed textbooks to school.","translation":"在這個數位時代，大多數學生更喜歡在平板電腦上閱讀電子書，而不是帶沉重的印刷課本去學校。","explanation":"digital age 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The company is planning to switch all its paper records to a <digital> *format* to save space and improve data security.","translation":"該公司計畫將所有紙本紀錄轉換為數位格式，以節省空間並提高資料安全性。","explanation":"形容數位化的格式。"}],"related_forms":["digit"]}

{"headword":"dignity","explanation":"名詞用法：(1)「尊嚴/莊重」。常搭配 maintain, lose, with。","entries":[{"sentence":"Even when facing difficult challenges, she always managed to maintain her <dignity> and *treat others* with kindness and respect.","translation":"即使在面對困難的挑戰時，她總能保持尊嚴，並以友善和尊重的態度對待他人。","explanation":"maintain one's dignity 是常見用法。"},{"sentence":"Every human being has the right to live with <dignity>, regardless of their social status, *background*, or personal beliefs in life.","translation":"每個人都有權利有尊嚴地活著，無論他們的社會地位、背景或個人的生活信仰為何。","explanation":"live with dignity 表示有尊嚴地活著。"}],"related_forms":["dignified"]}

{"headword":"diligence","explanation":"名詞用法：(1)「勤奮/勤勉」。常搭配 with, show。注意形容詞為 diligent。","entries":[{"sentence":"Through hard work and <diligence>, he finally achieved his goal of *getting admitted* to his dream university after three years of effort.","translation":"透過努力工作和勤奮，他在三年的努力後終於實現了進入夢想大學的目標。","explanation":"diligence 指勤奮的特質。"},{"sentence":"The manager praised the employee for his <diligence> and *dedication* to the project, which led to its successful completion ahead of schedule.","translation":"經理稱讚該員工對專案的勤奮和奉獻，這使得專案能提前順利完成。","explanation":"指工作上的勤勉。"}],"related_forms":["diligent"]}

{"headword":"diligent","explanation":"形容詞用法：(1)「勤奮的/用功的」。常搭配 student, worker。注意與 diligence (名詞) 的區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"As a <diligent> student, she always finishes her homework on time and *prepares* for her lessons before coming to the classroom.","translation":"作為一名勤奮的學生，她總是在課前準時完成作業並預習課程。","explanation":"形容學生勤奮。"},{"sentence":"The <diligent> researchers spent years collecting data to ensure that their *scientific findings* were accurate and reliable for the public.","translation":"勤奮的研究人員花了數年時間收集數據，以確保他們的科學發現對大眾而言是準確且可靠的。","explanation":"形容研究人員勤奮。"}],"related_forms":["diligence"]}

{"headword":"diploma","explanation":"名詞用法：(1)「畢業證書/文憑」。常搭配 receive, earn, high school。","entries":[{"sentence":"After completing all the required courses, he finally received his high school <diploma> and is now *ready to* start his college life.","translation":"在完成所有必修課程後，他終於收到了高中畢業證書，現在準備好開始他的大學生活了。","explanation":"指畢業證書。"},{"sentence":"Many students work part-time while studying to earn enough money to pay for their <diploma> *program* at the local technical college.","translation":"許多學生在學習期間打工，以賺取足夠的錢來支付當地技術學院的文憑課程費用。","explanation":"指學位或文憑課程。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"diplomat","explanation":"名詞用法：(1)「外交官」。注意與 diplomacy (外交) 的區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <diplomat> traveled to several countries to *negotiate* peace agreements and strengthen the relationships between different nations in the region.","translation":"這位外交官前往多個國家談判和平協議，並加強該地區不同國家之間的關係。","explanation":"指外交官的職業。"},{"sentence":"Being a <diplomat> requires excellent *communication skills* and the ability to handle sensitive international issues with great care and tact.","translation":"身為一名外交官需要優秀的溝通技巧，以及能非常小心且圓滑地處理敏感國際議題的能力。","explanation":"指外交官的角色。"}],"related_forms":["diplomacy","diplomatic"]}

{"headword":"disability","explanation":"指生理或心理上的「殘疾」或「無能」。常用於描述身體障礙，注意與 disadvantage（劣勢）區分。常見搭配：physical disability, learning disability。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school provides special support for students with a physical <disability> to ensure they have *equal* *access* *to* all campus facilities.","translation":"學校為身心障礙學生提供特別支援，以確保他們能平等使用所有校園設施。","explanation":"指生理上的殘疾。equal access to 是常見的搭配，表示平等使用權。"},{"sentence":"Despite his learning <disability>, he worked hard and eventually graduated from the university with top honors in his class.","translation":"儘管有學習障礙，他仍努力不懈，最終以班上最高榮譽從大學畢業。","explanation":"指學習上的障礙。despite 後接名詞，表示「儘管」。"},{"sentence":"Many people with a <disability> face challenges in their daily lives, but they often show great courage and determination to overcome them.","translation":"許多身心障礙者在日常生活中面臨挑戰，但他們常展現出極大的勇氣與決心來克服這些困難。","explanation":"指廣義的殘疾。overcome challenges 是常見的搭配。"}],"related_forms":["disable","disabled"]}

{"headword":"disadvantage","explanation":"名詞指「劣勢、不利條件」，動詞指「使處於不利地位」。常見片語：at a disadvantage（處於劣勢）。","entries":[{"sentence":"Living in a remote area can be a major <disadvantage> when you are trying to *find* *a* *job* in the city center.","translation":"當你試圖在市中心找工作時，住在偏遠地區可能是一個主要的劣勢。","explanation":"名詞用法，指不利的條件。find a job 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The team was *at* *a* <disadvantage> because their star player was injured and could not play in the final match.","translation":"該隊處於劣勢，因為他們的明星球員受傷了，無法參加最後一場比賽。","explanation":"片語 at a disadvantage，表示處於不利的狀態。"},{"sentence":"The new tax policy might <disadvantage> small businesses by forcing them to pay higher fees than larger corporations.","translation":"新的稅收政策可能會使小型企業處於不利地位，因為迫使他們支付比大公司更高的費用。","explanation":"動詞用法，指使某人或某物處於不利地位。"}],"related_forms":["disadvantaged"]}

{"headword":"disappoint","explanation":"動詞「使失望」。常見搭配：be disappointed with/in/at。名詞 disappointment 指「失望」。","entries":[{"sentence":"I did not want to <disappoint> my parents, so I studied very hard to *get* *good* *grades* on the final exam.","translation":"我不想讓父母失望，所以我非常努力讀書，以便在期末考取得好成績。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示讓某人失望。get good grades 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"To my great <disappointment>, the concert was canceled at the last minute due to the heavy rain and strong wind.","translation":"令我非常失望的是，由於大雨和強風，音樂會在最後一刻被取消了。","explanation":"名詞用法。To one's disappointment 是常見的句型，表示「令某人失望的是」。"},{"sentence":"The movie was a huge <disappointment> because the plot was boring and the actors did not perform well at all.","translation":"這部電影非常令人失望，因為劇情很無聊，演員的表現一點也不好。","explanation":"名詞用法，指令人失望的事物。"}],"related_forms":["disappointed","disappointing","disappointment"]}

{"headword":"disaster","explanation":"名詞「災難、大禍」。形容詞為 disastrous。常見搭配：natural disaster（天然災害）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The earthquake was a terrible natural <disaster> that destroyed many houses and left thousands of people without a home.","translation":"那場地震是一場可怕的天然災害，摧毀了許多房屋，使成千上萬的人無家可歸。","explanation":"名詞用法，指天然災害。natural disaster 是固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"If we do not *take* *action* to protect the environment, we will face a global <disaster> in the near future.","translation":"如果我們不採取行動保護環境，我們在不久的將來將面臨全球性的災難。","explanation":"名詞用法。take action 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The party was a total <disaster> because the food was cold and the music system broke down during the event.","translation":"派對簡直是一場災難，因為食物是冷的，而且音樂系統在活動期間壞掉了。","explanation":"名詞用法，引申指「徹底的失敗」。"}],"related_forms":["disastrous"]}

{"headword":"discipline","explanation":"名詞「紀律、學科」，動詞「訓練、懲戒」。注意與 self-discipline（自律）的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The coach believes that strict <discipline> is the key to success for any athlete who wants to *reach* *the* *top*.","translation":"教練認為嚴格的紀律是任何想要達到頂峰的運動員成功的關鍵。","explanation":"名詞用法，指紀律。reach the top 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"Students need to learn how to <discipline> themselves to finish their homework before they go out to play with friends.","translation":"學生需要學習如何自我約束，在出去和朋友玩之前完成作業。","explanation":"動詞用法，指自我約束或訓練。"},{"sentence":"History is a fascinating academic <discipline> that helps us understand the mistakes and achievements of people in the past.","translation":"歷史是一門迷人的學科，幫助我們了解過去人們的錯誤與成就。","explanation":"名詞用法，指學術領域或學科。"}],"related_forms":["disciplined","disciplinary"]}

{"headword":"discourage","explanation":"動詞「使氣餒、勸阻」。常見句型：discourage sb from V-ing（勸阻某人做某事）。","entries":[{"sentence":"Do not let one failure <discourage> you; instead, you should *learn* *from* your mistakes and try again with more confidence.","translation":"不要讓一次失敗使你氣餒；相反地，你應該從錯誤中學習，並帶著更多的自信再試一次。","explanation":"動詞用法，指使人失去信心。learn from 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The government is trying to <discourage> people *from* *smoking* in public places by increasing the tax on cigarettes.","translation":"政府正試圖透過增加香菸稅來勸阻人們在公共場所吸菸。","explanation":"動詞用法，搭配 from V-ing。discourage sb from V-ing 是重要句型。"},{"sentence":"His parents' constant <discouragement> made him give up his dream of becoming a professional musician at a young age.","translation":"他父母不斷的打擊使他在年輕時就放棄了成為專業音樂家的夢想。","explanation":"名詞用法，指打擊或勸阻。"}],"related_forms":["discouraged","discouraging","discouragement"]}

{"headword":"disguise","explanation":"動詞「偽裝」，名詞「偽裝物」。常見搭配：in disguise（偽裝地）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The spy had to <disguise> himself as a waiter to *get* *into* the building without being noticed by the guards.","translation":"間諜必須將自己偽裝成服務生，才能在不被警衛注意的情況下進入大樓。","explanation":"動詞用法，指偽裝。disguise oneself as 是常見用法。"},{"sentence":"The thief wore a mask as a <disguise> to hide his face from the security cameras during the robbery.","translation":"小偷戴著面具作為偽裝，以便在搶劫期間向監視器隱藏他的臉。","explanation":"名詞用法，指偽裝物。"},{"sentence":"Sometimes, a difficult challenge is just a blessing *in* <disguise> because it helps us become stronger and wiser.","translation":"有時候，困難的挑戰只是偽裝的祝福，因為它幫助我們變得更強大、更聰明。","explanation":"名詞用法。a blessing in disguise 是常見的固定片語，意指「因禍得福」。"}],"related_forms":["disguised"]}

{"headword":"disgust","explanation":"名詞「厭惡」，動詞「使作嘔」。常見搭配：be disgusted with/at。","entries":[{"sentence":"The smell of the garbage in the street filled the neighbors with <disgust> and they asked the city to clean it up.","translation":"街上垃圾的臭味讓鄰居們感到厭惡，他們要求市府清理乾淨。","explanation":"名詞用法，指厭惡感。"},{"sentence":"I was deeply <disgusted> *by* the way he treated the stray dog, so I decided to report him to the animal shelter.","translation":"我對他對待流浪狗的方式感到非常厭惡，所以我決定向動物收容所舉報他。","explanation":"動詞用法，常用被動語態。be disgusted by/with 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The rude behavior of the customer <disgusted> the waiter, who had been working hard to provide excellent service all day.","translation":"顧客粗魯的行為讓服務生感到噁心，他整天都在努力提供優質的服務。","explanation":"動詞用法，指使人感到厭惡。"}],"related_forms":["disgusted","disgusting"]}

{"headword":"dismiss","explanation":"動詞「解僱、駁回、不予理會」。注意在學校情境中可指「下課」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The manager decided to <dismiss> the employee because he was often late and did not *finish* *his* *work* on time.","translation":"經理決定解僱該員工，因為他經常遲到且沒有準時完成工作。","explanation":"動詞用法，指解僱。finish one's work 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The judge chose to <dismiss> the case because there was not enough evidence to prove that the man was guilty.","translation":"法官選擇駁回此案，因為沒有足夠的證據證明該男子有罪。","explanation":"動詞用法，指駁回法律訴訟。"},{"sentence":"The teacher will <dismiss> the class at three o'clock, so please make sure you have finished your group project by then.","translation":"老師將在三點鐘下課，所以請確保在那之前你們已經完成小組報告。","explanation":"動詞用法，指讓學生下課。"}],"related_forms":["dismissal"]}

{"headword":"disorder","explanation":"名詞「混亂、失調、疾病」，動詞「使混亂」。常見搭配：eating disorder（飲食失調）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The room was in complete <disorder> after the children finished playing with all their toys on the floor.","translation":"孩子們在地板上玩完所有玩具後，房間裡一片混亂。","explanation":"名詞用法，指混亂狀態。in disorder 是常見片語。"},{"sentence":"The doctor explained that the patient was suffering from a sleep <disorder> and needed to change his daily habits.","translation":"醫生解釋說該病患患有睡眠障礙，需要改變他的日常生活習慣。","explanation":"名詞用法，指生理或心理失調。"},{"sentence":"The sudden news of the company's bankruptcy caused a great <disorder> among the employees who were worried about their future.","translation":"公司破產的突發消息在擔心未來的員工之間引起了極大的混亂。","explanation":"名詞用法，指混亂或騷動。"}],"related_forms":["disordered"]}

{"headword":"dispute","explanation":"名詞「爭論、糾紛」，動詞「爭論、質疑」。常見搭配：in dispute（有爭議的）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two neighbors had a long <dispute> over the boundary of their gardens, which finally led to a legal battle.","translation":"兩位鄰居對他們花園的邊界有長期的爭執，這最終導致了一場法律訴訟。","explanation":"名詞用法，指爭論。have a dispute over 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The scientists continue to <dispute> the results of the study, claiming that the data was not collected in a fair way.","translation":"科學家們繼續質疑該研究的結果，聲稱數據並非以公平的方式收集。","explanation":"動詞用法，指質疑或爭論。"},{"sentence":"The ownership of the land is still *in* <dispute>, so the construction company cannot start building the new shopping mall yet.","translation":"這塊土地的所有權仍有爭議，所以建築公司還不能開始建造新的購物中心。","explanation":"名詞用法。in dispute 是常見片語，表示「有爭議的」。"}],"related_forms":["disputed"]}

{"headword":"distinct","explanation":"形容詞「明顯的、截然不同的」。注意與 distinctive（獨特的）的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"There is a <distinct> difference between the two languages, even though they share some similar words and grammar rules.","translation":"這兩種語言之間有明顯的差異，儘管它們共享一些相似的單字和語法規則。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指明顯的。distinct difference 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The twins have <distinct> personalities; one is very outgoing and talkative, while the other is quiet and shy.","translation":"這對雙胞胎有截然不同的個性；一個非常外向且健談，而另一個則安靜且害羞。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指截然不同的。"},{"sentence":"I could hear a <distinct> sound coming from the kitchen, so I went to check if someone was cooking dinner.","translation":"我可以聽到從廚房傳來一個清晰的聲音，所以我去檢查是否有人在煮晚餐。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指清晰可辨的。"}],"related_forms":["distinction","distinctive"]}

{"headword":"distinguish","explanation":"動詞「區分、辨別」。常見句型：distinguish A from B（區分 A 與 B）。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is often difficult to <distinguish> the truth *from* lies when people are trying to hide their mistakes.","translation":"當人們試圖隱瞞錯誤時，通常很難區分事實與謊言。","explanation":"動詞用法，distinguish A from B 是固定用法。"},{"sentence":"The young artist was able to <distinguish> himself *from* other painters by using bright colors and unique shapes in his work.","translation":"這位年輕藝術家透過在作品中使用明亮的色彩和獨特的形狀，使自己與其他畫家區別開來。","explanation":"動詞用法，distinguish oneself 指「使自己出眾/與眾不同」。"},{"sentence":"Can you <distinguish> the sound of a violin *from* that of a cello in this beautiful piece of classical music?","translation":"在這首優美的古典樂曲中，你能分辨出小提琴和大提琴的聲音嗎？","explanation":"動詞用法，指辨別聲音。"}],"related_forms":["distinguishable","distinguished"]}

{"headword":"distinguished","explanation":"形容詞「傑出的、著名的」。常用於形容人的成就或地位。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university invited a <distinguished> professor to give a speech about the future of technology and its impact on society.","translation":"大學邀請了一位傑出的教授來演講，主題是關於科技的未來及其對社會的影響。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指傑出的。distinguished professor 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"He had a long and <distinguished> career in medicine, saving many lives during his thirty years of practice.","translation":"他在醫學領域有著漫長且傑出的職業生涯，在他三十年的執業期間拯救了許多生命。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指卓越的。"},{"sentence":"The guest of honor was a <distinguished> writer who had won many awards for her novels and short stories.","translation":"貴賓是一位傑出的作家，她的小說和短篇故事贏得了許多獎項。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指著名的。"}],"related_forms":["distinguish"]}

{"headword":"distribute","explanation":"動詞「分發、分配」。常見搭配：distribute sth to sb。","entries":[{"sentence":"The charity organization will <distribute> free food and clothes *to* the families who were affected by the recent flood.","translation":"慈善組織將會分發免費的食物和衣服給受近期洪水影響的家庭。","explanation":"動詞用法，指分發。distribute to 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the class monitor to <distribute> the exam papers to every student before the test started.","translation":"老師請班長在考試開始前將考卷分發給每一位學生。","explanation":"動詞用法，指分發文件。"},{"sentence":"The company plans to <distribute> its new products to stores all over the country by the end of this month.","translation":"公司計劃在本月底前將其新產品分銷到全國各地的商店。","explanation":"動詞用法，指分銷商品。"}],"related_forms":["distribution","distributor"]}

{"headword":"distribution","explanation":"名詞「分發、分配、分佈」。常見搭配：the distribution of wealth（財富分配）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <distribution> of aid to the remote villages was delayed because the roads were blocked by the heavy snow.","translation":"對偏遠村莊的援助分發工作被延誤了，因為道路被大雪堵住了。","explanation":"名詞用法，指分發過程。"},{"sentence":"The government is working on a new policy to improve the <distribution> of wealth among different social classes in the country.","translation":"政府正在制定一項新政策，以改善國內不同社會階層之間的財富分配。","explanation":"名詞用法，指分配。distribution of wealth 是固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"The study looks at the <distribution> of different plant species across the island to understand how the climate affects them.","translation":"這項研究觀察島上不同植物物種的分佈，以了解氣候如何影響它們。","explanation":"名詞用法，指地理分佈。"}],"related_forms":["distribute"]}

{"headword":"district","explanation":"名詞「區域、行政區」。常用於指特定的商業區或學校學區。","entries":[{"sentence":"The shopping <district> in the city center is always crowded with tourists who want to buy souvenirs and local snacks.","translation":"市中心的購物區總是擠滿了想要購買紀念品和當地小吃的遊客。","explanation":"名詞用法，指特定區域。shopping district 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"She lives in a quiet residential <district> where there are many parks and trees, making it a great place for families.","translation":"她住在一個安靜的住宅區，那裡有很多公園和樹木，這使它成為家庭居住的好地方。","explanation":"名詞用法，指住宅區。"},{"sentence":"The school <district> decided to build a new library to provide students with more resources for their research projects.","translation":"學區決定蓋一座新圖書館，為學生提供更多研究計畫的資源。","explanation":"名詞用法，指學區。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"disturb","explanation":"動詞「打擾、擾亂」。常見用法：Sorry to disturb you（抱歉打擾你）。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please do not <disturb> the students while they are taking the exam in the classroom, as they need to focus.","translation":"當學生在教室裡考試時，請不要打擾他們，因為他們需要專心。","explanation":"動詞用法，指打擾。do not disturb 是常見標語。"},{"sentence":"The loud noise from the construction site <disturbed> my sleep last night, so I feel very tired today.","translation":"工地傳來的巨大噪音昨晚擾亂了我的睡眠，所以我今天感到很累。","explanation":"動詞用法，指擾亂。"},{"sentence":"The news of the sudden change in the plan <disturbed> everyone on the team, as they were not prepared for it.","translation":"計畫突然改變的消息擾亂了團隊中的每個人，因為他們對此毫無準備。","explanation":"動詞用法，指使人不安或心煩。"}],"related_forms":["disturbed","disturbing","disturbance"]}

{"headword":"diverse","explanation":"形容詞「多樣的、不同的」。常用於描述文化、背景或意見的多樣性。","entries":[{"sentence":"Our class has a <diverse> group of students from many different countries, which makes our discussions very interesting.","translation":"我們班有一群來自許多不同國家的多元學生，這使得我們的討論非常有趣。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指多樣的。diverse group 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The island is home to a <diverse> range of wildlife, including many rare birds and plants that cannot be found elsewhere.","translation":"這座島嶼是多樣野生動物的家園，包括許多在其他地方找不到的稀有鳥類和植物。","explanation":"形容詞用法，a diverse range of 是固定用法。"},{"sentence":"It is important to listen to <diverse> opinions before making a final decision to ensure that everyone's needs are considered.","translation":"在做出最終決定之前，傾聽不同的意見很重要，以確保每個人的需求都被考慮到。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指不同的。"}],"related_forms":["diversity"]}

{"headword":"diversity","explanation":"名詞「多樣性」。常見搭配：cultural diversity（文化多樣性）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company values <diversity> in the workplace and encourages employees from different backgrounds to share their unique ideas.","translation":"公司重視職場的多樣性，並鼓勵來自不同背景的員工分享他們獨特的想法。","explanation":"名詞用法，指多樣性。"},{"sentence":"Cultural <diversity> is one of the main features of this city, where people from all over the world live together in peace.","translation":"文化多樣性是這座城市的主要特色之一，來自世界各地的人們在這裡和平共處。","explanation":"名詞用法，cultural diversity 是固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"The <diversity> of the landscape, from high mountains to deep valleys, makes this region a popular destination for hikers.","translation":"從高山到深谷的地景多樣性，使這個地區成為健行者熱門的目的地。","explanation":"名詞用法，指事物種類的多樣。"}],"related_forms":["diverse"]}

{"headword":"divine","explanation":"形容詞，意為「神聖的」或「極好的」。在宗教語境中指與神有關的，在日常口語中常誇張地用來形容食物或體驗非常棒。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many ancient cultures believed that the king was chosen by <divine> *will* to lead the people and protect the land from harm.","translation":"許多古老文化相信國王是由神聖的意志所選擇，來領導人民並保護土地免受傷害。","explanation":"形容詞「神聖的」。常與 will, power, intervention 等詞搭配。"},{"sentence":"The chocolate cake we had at the new bakery was absolutely <divine>; I have never tasted anything so delicious in my life.","translation":"我們在那家新麵包店吃的巧克力蛋糕真是太棒了；我這輩子從沒吃過這麼美味的東西。","explanation":"形容詞「極好的/美味的」。常用於口語中誇飾讚美。"},{"sentence":"The choir sang with such <divine> *beauty* that the entire audience sat in silence, moved by the peaceful melody.","translation":"唱詩班以一種神聖的美感歌唱，讓全場觀眾安靜地坐著，被那寧靜的旋律所感動。","explanation":"形容詞「神聖的/超凡的」。強調超越世俗的美感。"}],"related_forms":["divinely"]}

{"headword":"divorce","explanation":"名詞「離婚」，動詞「與...離婚」。注意與介係詞 from 搭配使用。","entries":[{"sentence":"After years of constant arguments, the couple finally decided to <divorce> *each other* and go their separate ways for a better life.","translation":"經過多年的不斷爭吵，這對夫妻最終決定離婚，並為了更好的生活各奔東西。","explanation":"動詞「離婚」。常用 divorce someone 或 get divorced from someone。"},{"sentence":"The high rate of <divorce> *in* modern society has led many experts to study the importance of communication in a marriage.","translation":"現代社會的高離婚率促使許多專家研究溝通在婚姻中的重要性。","explanation":"名詞「離婚」。常與 rate, statistics 等詞搭配。"},{"sentence":"It is often difficult for children to cope with the emotional stress caused by their parents' <divorce> *at* a young age.","translation":"孩子們通常很難應付年幼時父母離婚所帶來的心理壓力。","explanation":"名詞「離婚」。強調離婚帶來的影響。"}],"related_forms":["divorced"]}

{"headword":"dodge","explanation":"動詞「閃避/逃避」，名詞「閃避」。指快速移動身體以避開某物，或用技巧規避責任。","entries":[{"sentence":"The soccer player managed to <dodge> *the* defender and score a goal in the final minute of the intense game.","translation":"這位足球員在比賽最後一分鐘成功閃過防守者並踢進一球。","explanation":"動詞「閃避」。指身體動作上的閃躲。"},{"sentence":"Some students try to <dodge> *their* responsibilities by making excuses when they fail to complete their homework on time.","translation":"有些學生在沒能準時完成作業時，會試圖藉由找藉口來逃避責任。","explanation":"動詞「逃避」。指規避責任或問題。"},{"sentence":"With a quick <dodge>, he avoided being hit by the ball that was thrown toward him during the gym class.","translation":"他快速閃避，避開了體育課中朝他丟過來的球。","explanation":"名詞「閃避」。指閃避的動作。"}],"related_forms":["dodged","dodging"]}

{"headword":"dominant","explanation":"形容詞「佔優勢的/支配的」。指在數量、力量或影響力上超過其他事物。","entries":[{"sentence":"English has become the <dominant> *language* in international business, allowing people from different countries to communicate effectively.","translation":"英語已成為國際商業中的主要語言，使來自不同國家的人們能夠有效地溝通。","explanation":"形容詞「佔優勢的」。常與 language, position, role 搭配。"},{"sentence":"In the forest, the <dominant> *species* of trees often block the sunlight, making it hard for smaller plants to grow.","translation":"在森林中，佔優勢的樹種常會遮擋陽光，使得較小的植物難以生長。","explanation":"形容詞「優勢的/支配的」。指在生態或競爭中佔據主導地位。"},{"sentence":"The team played a <dominant> *role* throughout the tournament, winning every match with a large score difference.","translation":"該隊在整個錦標賽中扮演了主導角色，以大比分差距贏得了每一場比賽。","explanation":"形容詞「主導的」。常與 role 搭配。"}],"related_forms":["dominance","dominate"]}

{"headword":"dominate","explanation":"動詞「支配/主導」。指在某個領域中佔據絕對優勢或控制地位。","entries":[{"sentence":"The large company continues to <dominate> *the* market, making it very difficult for smaller businesses to compete successfully.","translation":"這家大公司持續主導市場，使得小型企業很難成功競爭。","explanation":"動詞「主導」。常與 market, field, industry 搭配。"},{"sentence":"The tall mountain seems to <dominate> *the* landscape, as it can be seen from almost every corner of the small town.","translation":"這座高山似乎主宰了當地的景觀，因為從這小鎮的幾乎每個角落都能看見它。","explanation":"動詞「俯瞰/主宰」。指在視覺上佔據顯著位置。"},{"sentence":"He tends to <dominate> *the* conversation, rarely giving others a chance to express their own opinions or ideas.","translation":"他傾向於主導對話，很少給別人表達自己意見或想法的機會。","explanation":"動詞「主導」。指在社交場合中控制發言權。"}],"related_forms":["dominant","domination"]}

{"headword":"draft","explanation":"名詞「草稿/徵兵」，動詞「起草/徵召」。注意區分名詞與動詞用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before submitting your essay, you should write a first <draft> *to* organize your thoughts and check for any grammar mistakes.","translation":"在繳交論文之前，你應該先寫一份草稿來整理思緒並檢查是否有文法錯誤。","explanation":"名詞「草稿」。常用 first/final draft。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer spent the whole afternoon <drafting> *a* legal document to ensure that all the terms were clearly stated.","translation":"律師花了一整個下午起草法律文件，以確保所有條款都清楚說明。","explanation":"動詞「起草」。指撰寫文件或計畫的初步版本。"},{"sentence":"In some countries, young men are required to join the army under a military <draft> *system* when they turn eighteen.","translation":"在某些國家，年輕男子在年滿十八歲時必須根據徵兵制度加入軍隊。","explanation":"名詞「徵兵」。指強制性的兵役制度。"}],"related_forms":["drafted","drafting"]}

{"headword":"dread","explanation":"名詞「恐懼/擔憂」，動詞「非常害怕/擔憂」。指對未來可能發生的壞事感到焦慮。","entries":[{"sentence":"I always <dread> *the* Monday morning meeting because it usually lasts for three hours and involves many boring reports.","translation":"我總是害怕週一早上的會議，因為它通常持續三小時，而且包含許多無聊的報告。","explanation":"動詞「非常害怕/擔憂」。指對即將到來的負面事件感到焦慮。"},{"sentence":"The thought of failing the final exam filled her with a sense of <dread> *that* kept her awake at night.","translation":"想到期末考不及格，她心中充滿了恐懼，讓她徹夜難眠。","explanation":"名詞「恐懼/擔憂」。常用 fill sb with dread。"},{"sentence":"Many people <dread> *going* to the dentist, but regular checkups are necessary to keep our teeth healthy and strong.","translation":"許多人害怕去看牙醫，但定期檢查對於保持牙齒健康強壯是必要的。","explanation":"動詞「害怕」。後接 V-ing 或不定詞。"}],"related_forms":["dreadful","dreaded"]}

{"headword":"drift","explanation":"動詞「漂流/遊蕩」，名詞「漂流/趨勢」。指緩慢地移動或隨波逐流。","entries":[{"sentence":"The small boat began to <drift> *away* from the shore as the wind grew stronger during the stormy afternoon.","translation":"當暴風雨的午後風勢增強時，小船開始從岸邊漂走。","explanation":"動詞「漂流」。指在水面或空中緩慢移動。"},{"sentence":"After graduating from college, he spent a year <drifting> *around* the world to discover his true passion in life.","translation":"大學畢業後，他花了一年時間在世界各地遊蕩，以發掘他生命中真正的熱情。","explanation":"動詞「遊蕩」。指漫無目的地旅行或生活。"},{"sentence":"There is a general <drift> *toward* using digital tools in classrooms to make learning more interactive and engaging for students.","translation":"教室內有一種使用數位工具的普遍趨勢，旨在讓學生的學習更具互動性和吸引力。","explanation":"名詞「趨勢/走向」。指緩慢的變化或發展方向。"}],"related_forms":["drifted","drifting"]}

{"headword":"drill","explanation":"名詞「鑽子/練習」，動詞「鑽孔/反覆練習」。指機械性的重複訓練或工具使用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher used a vocabulary <drill> *to* help students memorize the new words before the big test on Friday.","translation":"老師使用單字練習來幫助學生在週五的大考前記住這些新單字。","explanation":"名詞「練習」。指機械式的反覆訓練。"},{"sentence":"The fire <drill> *is* scheduled for next Tuesday, so all students must follow the instructions and leave the building quickly.","translation":"消防演習預定在下週二舉行，所以所有學生必須遵守指示並迅速離開大樓。","explanation":"名詞「演習」。指緊急情況的預防訓練。"},{"sentence":"You need to <drill> *the* basic grammar rules until you can use them correctly without thinking too much.","translation":"你需要反覆練習基本的文法規則，直到你不需要多想就能正確使用它們。","explanation":"動詞「反覆練習」。指透過重複達到熟練。"}],"related_forms":["drilled","drilling"]}

{"headword":"drowsy","explanation":"形容詞「昏昏欲睡的」。指因為疲勞或藥物作用而想睡覺。","entries":[{"sentence":"The medicine made me feel very <drowsy>, so I decided to take a short nap before starting my homework.","translation":"這藥讓我感到很昏昏欲睡，所以我決定在開始寫作業前小睡一下。","explanation":"形容詞「昏昏欲睡的」。常與 feel, make sb 搭配。"},{"sentence":"Driving while <drowsy> *is* extremely dangerous, as it slows down your reaction time and increases the risk of accidents.","translation":"在昏昏欲睡時開車極度危險，因為這會減慢你的反應時間並增加事故風險。","explanation":"形容詞「昏昏欲睡的」。強調疲勞駕駛的危險性。"},{"sentence":"The warm sunlight and the quiet library made the student feel <drowsy> while reading his history textbook.","translation":"溫暖的陽光和安靜的圖書館讓學生在閱讀歷史課本時感到昏昏欲睡。","explanation":"形容詞「昏昏欲睡的」。描述環境導致的睡意。"}],"related_forms":["drowsiness"]}

{"headword":"durable","explanation":"形容詞「耐用的/持久的」。指物品品質好，不易損壞。","entries":[{"sentence":"These hiking boots are very <durable> *and* can withstand harsh weather conditions during long trips in the mountains.","translation":"這些登山靴非常耐用，可以在山區長途旅行中承受惡劣的天氣條件。","explanation":"形容詞「耐用的」。指物品結構堅固。"},{"sentence":"We should invest in <durable> *goods* that will last for many years instead of buying cheap items that break easily.","translation":"我們應該投資耐用的商品，讓它們能使用多年，而不是購買容易損壞的廉價品。","explanation":"形容詞「耐用的」。常用 durable goods (耐用財)。"},{"sentence":"The plastic material is highly <durable>, making it a popular choice for manufacturing outdoor furniture and playground equipment.","translation":"這種塑膠材質非常耐用，使其成為製造戶外家具和遊樂場設備的熱門選擇。","explanation":"形容詞「耐用的」。強調材質的持久性。"}],"related_forms":["durability"]}

{"headword":"dusty","explanation":"形容詞「佈滿灰塵的」。指表面積滿灰塵，通常暗示很久沒清理。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old books in the attic were very <dusty>, so I had to clean them carefully before reading them.","translation":"閣樓裡的舊書佈滿了灰塵，所以我必須在閱讀前小心地清理它們。","explanation":"形容詞「佈滿灰塵的」。描述物品狀態。"},{"sentence":"After the long walk on the <dusty> *road*, our shoes were covered in dirt and we were very tired.","translation":"在佈滿灰塵的道路上長途跋涉後，我們的鞋子沾滿了泥土，我們也累壞了。","explanation":"形容詞「佈滿灰塵的」。描述環境。"},{"sentence":"The <dusty> *shelves* in the basement showed that nobody had visited this room for a very long time.","translation":"地下室佈滿灰塵的架子顯示已經很久沒有人來過這個房間了。","explanation":"形容詞「佈滿灰塵的」。暗示時間久遠。"}],"related_forms":["dust"]}

{"headword":"dye","explanation":"名詞「染料」，動詞「染色」。指改變布料或頭髮的顏色。","entries":[{"sentence":"She decided to <dye> *her* hair a bright blue color to express her unique personality and style.","translation":"她決定把頭髮染成亮藍色，以表達她獨特的個性和風格。","explanation":"動詞「染色」。常用 dye one's hair。"},{"sentence":"The traditional fabric is made using a natural <dye> *extracted* from local plants found in the nearby forest.","translation":"這種傳統布料是使用從附近森林中發現的當地植物中提取的天然染料製成的。","explanation":"名詞「染料」。指用於改變顏色的物質。"},{"sentence":"They used a special <dye> *to* change the color of the white cotton shirts into a deep shade of green.","translation":"他們使用一種特殊的染料將白色棉襯衫的顏色變成了深綠色。","explanation":"名詞「染料」。指染色過程。"}],"related_forms":["dyed","dyeing"]}

{"headword":"dynamic","explanation":"形容詞「充滿活力的/動態的」。指不斷變化或非常有能量。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city is a <dynamic> *place* where new businesses and creative ideas are constantly emerging every single day.","translation":"這座城市是一個充滿活力的地方，新的企業和創意每天都在不斷湧現。","explanation":"形容詞「充滿活力的」。指充滿變動與生機。"},{"sentence":"To succeed in the modern world, students need to develop <dynamic> *skills* that allow them to adapt to new challenges.","translation":"為了在現代世界取得成功，學生需要培養動態的技能，使他們能夠適應新的挑戰。","explanation":"形容詞「動態的/靈活的」。指能隨情況變化的能力。"},{"sentence":"The <dynamic> *relationship* between the two countries has changed significantly over the past few years due to new trade agreements.","translation":"由於新的貿易協定，這兩國之間的動態關係在過去幾年中發生了顯著變化。","explanation":"形容詞「動態的」。指關係是不斷變化的。"}],"related_forms":["dynamically"]}

{"headword":"dynasty","explanation":"名詞「朝代」。指由同一家族統治的一系列君主。","entries":[{"sentence":"The Tang <dynasty> *is* often considered one of the most prosperous periods in Chinese history, known for its poetry and art.","translation":"唐朝常被認為是中國歷史上最繁榮的時期之一，以其詩歌和藝術聞名。","explanation":"名詞「朝代」。指歷史上的統治時期。"},{"sentence":"Many historical artifacts from the Ming <dynasty> *can* be found in the museum, showing the advanced technology of that time.","translation":"許多來自明朝的歷史文物可以在博物館中找到，展示了當時先進的技術。","explanation":"名詞「朝代」。常與特定朝代名稱連用。"},{"sentence":"The powerful family built a business <dynasty> *that* lasted for over a century, controlling many industries across the country.","translation":"這個強大的家族建立了一個持續了一個多世紀的商業王朝，控制了全國許多產業。","explanation":"名詞「王朝」。引申為長期控制某領域的家族或勢力。"}],"related_forms":["dynastic"]}

{"headword":"earnest","explanation":"形容詞「認真的/誠摯的」。指態度非常嚴肅且真誠。","entries":[{"sentence":"He made an <earnest> *effort* to improve his grades by studying extra hours every night after school.","translation":"他非常認真地努力提高成績，每天放學後都多花幾小時讀書。","explanation":"形容詞「認真的」。常用 earnest effort。"},{"sentence":"She gave an <earnest> *apology* for her mistake, and everyone could see that she truly felt sorry for what happened.","translation":"她為自己的錯誤做了誠摯的道歉，每個人都看得出她對發生的事感到非常抱歉。","explanation":"形容詞「誠摯的」。指發自內心的真誠。"},{"sentence":"The student was in <earnest> *about* his goal of becoming a doctor, so he worked hard in all his science classes.","translation":"這名學生對於成為醫生的目標非常認真，因此他在所有的科學課中都努力學習。","explanation":"形容詞「認真的」。常用 in earnest (認真地/嚴肅地)。"}],"related_forms":["earnestly"]}

{"headword":"earphone","explanation":"名詞「耳機」。指戴在耳朵上聽聲音的裝置。","entries":[{"sentence":"I always wear my <earphone> *to* listen to music or podcasts while I am taking the bus to school.","translation":"我搭公車去學校時，總是戴著耳機聽音樂或播客。","explanation":"名詞「耳機」。常用 wear earphones。"},{"sentence":"Please take off your <earphone> *when* the teacher is speaking so that you can pay attention to the lesson.","translation":"當老師在說話時，請把耳機拿下來，這樣你才能專心聽課。","explanation":"名詞「耳機」。指聽課時應有的禮貌。"},{"sentence":"The new <earphone> *design* is very comfortable, allowing users to wear it for hours without feeling any pain.","translation":"這款新耳機設計非常舒適，讓使用者可以戴著它好幾個小時而不會感到任何疼痛。","explanation":"名詞「耳機」。強調設計的舒適度。"}],"related_forms":["earphones"]}

{"headword":"economic","explanation":"形容詞「經濟的」。指與經濟學或國家經濟狀況有關。","entries":[{"sentence":"The country is facing serious <economic> *problems* due to the high inflation rate and the lack of new job opportunities.","translation":"由於高通貨膨脹率和缺乏新的就業機會，該國正面臨嚴重的經濟問題。","explanation":"形容詞「經濟的」。常與 problems, growth, crisis 搭配。"},{"sentence":"The government is trying to improve the <economic> *situation* by encouraging foreign companies to invest in local businesses.","translation":"政府正試圖藉由鼓勵外國公司投資當地企業來改善經濟狀況。","explanation":"形容詞「經濟的」。指整體的經濟環境。"},{"sentence":"We need to consider the <economic> *impact* of this new policy on small families before we decide to implement it.","translation":"在決定實施這項新政策之前，我們需要考慮它對小家庭的經濟影響。","explanation":"形容詞「經濟的」。指對財政的影響。"}],"related_forms":["economical","economics","economy"]}

{"headword":"economical","explanation":"形容詞「節約的/經濟實惠的」。指花錢少、物超所值。","entries":[{"sentence":"Buying in bulk is a very <economical> *way* to save money on groceries if you have enough storage space at home.","translation":"如果你家裡有足夠的儲存空間，大量購買是節省雜貨開支的一種非常經濟實惠的方法。","explanation":"形容詞「經濟實惠的」。指省錢的策略。"},{"sentence":"This small car is very <economical> *to* drive because it uses very little fuel compared to larger vehicles.","translation":"這輛小車開起來非常省錢，因為與大型車輛相比，它消耗的燃料非常少。","explanation":"形容詞「節約的」。指消耗資源少。"},{"sentence":"We are looking for an <economical> *solution* to our heating problem that will not cost too much money every month.","translation":"我們正在尋找一種經濟實惠的供暖問題解決方案，每個月不會花費太多錢。","explanation":"形容詞「節約的」。指成本低廉的方案。"}],"related_forms":["economic","economics","economy"]}

{"headword":"economics","explanation":"名詞「經濟學」。指研究資源分配的學科。","entries":[{"sentence":"She decided to study <economics> *at* university because she is interested in how money and resources are managed in society.","translation":"她決定在大學學習經濟學，因為她對社會中金錢和資源如何被管理感興趣。","explanation":"名詞「經濟學」。學科名稱，視為單數。"},{"sentence":"Understanding the basic principles of <economics> *can* help you make better decisions about your personal finances and savings.","translation":"了解經濟學的基本原則可以幫助你對個人財務和儲蓄做出更好的決定。","explanation":"名詞「經濟學」。指學科原則。"},{"sentence":"The professor gave a lecture on <economics> *that* explained why prices of goods change based on supply and demand.","translation":"教授做了一場關於經濟學的演講，解釋了為什麼商品價格會根據供需而改變。","explanation":"名詞「經濟學」。指學科內容。"}],"related_forms":["economic","economical","economy"]}

{"headword":"economist","explanation":"指研究經濟學的專家。常與形容詞搭配，如 leading, prominent, famous 等。注意與 economy (經濟) 和 economic (經濟的) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <economist> *predicted* that the country's financial situation would improve significantly by the end of the next fiscal year.","translation":"該經濟學家預測，該國的財務狀況將在下個財政年度結束前顯著改善。","explanation":"名詞「經濟學家」。常用動詞搭配 predict, warn, argue 等。"},{"sentence":"Many <economists> *are* *concerned* about the rising inflation rates and their long-term impact on the global market.","translation":"許多經濟學家對不斷上升的通貨膨脹率及其對全球市場的長期影響感到擔憂。","explanation":"複數用法。be concerned about 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"As a leading <economist>, she was invited to give a speech at the international conference about sustainable development.","translation":"身為一位頂尖的經濟學家，她受邀在國際會議上發表關於永續發展的演講。","explanation":"描述職業身分。leading 為常見形容詞修飾詞。"}],"related_forms":["economy","economic","economical"]}

{"headword":"economy","explanation":"指「經濟」或「節約」。常見用法包括 global economy (全球經濟), boost the economy (促進經濟)。注意形容詞 economic (經濟的) 與 economical (節儉的) 的差異。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is trying to *boost* the national <economy> by supporting small businesses and encouraging new technology investments.","translation":"政府正試圖透過支持小型企業和鼓勵新技術投資來促進國家經濟。","explanation":"名詞「經濟」。boost the economy 是常見的固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"Due to the weak <economy>, many families have decided to cut down on their daily spending and save more money.","translation":"由於經濟疲軟，許多家庭決定減少日常開支並存更多的錢。","explanation":"描述經濟狀況。weak/strong economy 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The company decided to switch to a more energy-efficient model for the sake of <economy> and environmental protection.","translation":"為了節約成本和保護環境，該公司決定改用更節能的型號。","explanation":"名詞「節約/節省」。此處指節省開支。"}],"related_forms":["economic","economical","economize"]}

{"headword":"efficiency","explanation":"指「效率」。常用搭配包括 improve efficiency, energy efficiency。注意與形容詞 efficient 的詞性轉換。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new software was designed to *improve* the <efficiency> of the office staff by automating repetitive daily tasks.","translation":"這套新軟體旨在透過自動化重複的日常工作來提高辦公室員工的效率。","explanation":"名詞「效率」。improve efficiency 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"We should focus on energy <efficiency> to reduce our monthly electricity bills and protect the planet at the same time.","translation":"我們應該專注於能源效率，以減少每月的電費，同時保護地球。","explanation":"energy efficiency 為常見術語。"},{"sentence":"The manager praised the team for their high level of <efficiency> in completing the project ahead of the deadline.","translation":"經理稱讚該團隊在提前完成專案時展現出的高效率。","explanation":"high level of efficiency 為常見用法。"}],"related_forms":["efficient","efficiently"]}

{"headword":"elastic","explanation":"指「有彈性的」。可指物理性質，也可引申為「靈活的」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The waistband of these sports pants is made of <elastic> material, making them very comfortable for running and jumping.","translation":"這條運動褲的腰帶是由有彈性的材質製成的，這讓它們在跑步和跳躍時非常舒適。","explanation":"形容詞「有彈性的」。"},{"sentence":"The schedule for the summer camp is quite <elastic>, so we can easily adjust the activities based on the weather conditions.","translation":"夏令營的行程相當靈活，所以我們可以根據天氣狀況輕鬆調整活動。","explanation":"形容詞「靈活的/可變動的」。"},{"sentence":"She used an <elastic> band to tie her hair back while she was busy cleaning the house this morning.","translation":"她今天早上忙著打掃房子時，用一條橡皮筋把頭髮綁起來。","explanation":"名詞「橡皮筋/彈性帶」。"}],"related_forms":["elasticity"]}

{"headword":"electronics","explanation":"指「電子學」或「電子產品」。注意此字結尾為 -s，但通常視為單數名詞（學科）或複數名詞（產品）。","entries":[{"sentence":"He has a great interest in <electronics> and spends his weekends building small robots in his garage.","translation":"他對電子學有很大的興趣，週末都在車庫裡組裝小型機器人。","explanation":"名詞「電子學」。"},{"sentence":"The store sells a wide range of <electronics>, including smartphones, laptops, and high-quality digital cameras.","translation":"這家商店販售各式各樣的電子產品，包括智慧型手機、筆記型電腦和高品質數位相機。","explanation":"名詞「電子產品」。"},{"sentence":"Modern <electronics> have *changed* the way we communicate and access information in our daily lives.","translation":"現代電子產品改變了我們在日常生活中溝通和獲取資訊的方式。","explanation":"名詞「電子產品」。"}],"related_forms":["electronic","electron"]}

{"headword":"elegant","explanation":"指「優雅的」。常用於形容人的舉止、裝扮或設計風格。","entries":[{"sentence":"She wore an <elegant> dress to the party and received many compliments from her friends throughout the evening.","translation":"她穿了一件優雅的洋裝參加派對，整個晚上都收到朋友們的讚美。","explanation":"形容詞「優雅的」。"},{"sentence":"The hotel is known for its <elegant> design and excellent service, making it a popular choice for weddings.","translation":"這家飯店以其優雅的設計和卓越的服務聞名，使其成為婚禮的熱門選擇。","explanation":"形容詞「優雅的」。"},{"sentence":"His <elegant> manners and polite speech made a very good impression on everyone he met at the meeting.","translation":"他優雅的舉止和禮貌的談吐給他在會議上遇到的每個人留下了很好的印象。","explanation":"形容詞「優雅的」。"}],"related_forms":["elegance"]}

{"headword":"elementary","explanation":"指「基本的」或「初級的」。常見搭配 elementary school (小學)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Learning the alphabet is an <elementary> step for anyone who wants to master a new language.","translation":"學習字母表對於任何想要精通新語言的人來說都是一個基本的步驟。","explanation":"形容詞「基本的」。"},{"sentence":"The teacher explained the <elementary> rules of the game so that even the youngest students could understand how to play.","translation":"老師解釋了遊戲的基本規則，以便即使是最年幼的學生也能理解如何玩。","explanation":"形容詞「基本的」。"},{"sentence":"After finishing <elementary> school, he moved to a different city to attend a middle school with his brother.","translation":"小學畢業後，他搬到另一個城市與他的兄弟一起上國中。","explanation":"形容詞「小學的」。"}],"related_forms":["element"]}

{"headword":"eliminate","explanation":"指「消除」或「淘汰」。常用於消除問題、風險或在比賽中淘汰對手。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new policy aims to <eliminate> the use of plastic bags in our school to protect the environment.","translation":"這項新政策旨在消除我們學校對塑膠袋的使用，以保護環境。","explanation":"動詞「消除」。"},{"sentence":"Our team was <eliminated> from the basketball tournament after losing the final game by only two points.","translation":"我們的球隊在最後一場比賽以兩分之差輸掉後，被淘汰出籃球錦標賽。","explanation":"動詞「淘汰」。常用被動語態 be eliminated from。"},{"sentence":"Regular exercise can help <eliminate> stress and improve your overall health after a long day of work.","translation":"規律的運動可以幫助消除壓力，並在漫長的工作日後改善你的整體健康。","explanation":"動詞「消除」。"}],"related_forms":["elimination"]}

{"headword":"elsewhere","explanation":"指「在別處」或「到別處」。常作為副詞使用，不需要介係詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you cannot find the book you need here, you should try looking for it <elsewhere> in the library.","translation":"如果你在這裡找不到你需要的書，你應該試著在圖書館的其他地方找找看。","explanation":"副詞「在別處」。"},{"sentence":"The company decided to move its factory <elsewhere> because the rent in this city has become too expensive.","translation":"公司決定將工廠搬到別處，因為這座城市的租金變得太貴了。","explanation":"副詞「到別處」。"},{"sentence":"He felt unhappy in his current job and started looking for opportunities <elsewhere> to advance his career.","translation":"他對目前的工作感到不快樂，並開始在別處尋找機會以促進他的職業生涯。","explanation":"副詞「在別處」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"embarrass","explanation":"指「使尷尬」。注意拼字，中間有兩個 r。形容詞形式為 embarrassing (令人尷尬的) 或 embarrassed (感到尷尬的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"I did not want to <embarrass> him by asking about his low test scores in front of the whole class.","translation":"我不想在全班面前問他關於低分成績的事，以免讓他感到尷尬。","explanation":"動詞「使尷尬」。"},{"sentence":"It was very <embarrassing> for her to realize that she had been wearing her shirt inside out all day.","translation":"當她發現自己整天都把襯衫穿反時，感到非常尷尬。","explanation":"形容詞 embarrassing 指「令人尷尬的」。"},{"sentence":"He felt <embarrassed> when he tripped and fell down in the middle of the crowded cafeteria during lunch.","translation":"當他在午餐時間於擁擠的餐廳中間絆倒摔跤時，他感到很尷尬。","explanation":"形容詞 embarrassed 指「感到尷尬的」。"}],"related_forms":["embarrassment","embarrassing","embarrassed"]}

{"headword":"embassy","explanation":"指「大使館」。通常指派駐在國外首都的官方機構。","entries":[{"sentence":"She went to the <embassy> to apply for a visa before her trip to Europe next month.","translation":"她在下個月去歐洲旅行之前，去了大使館申請簽證。","explanation":"名詞「大使館」。"},{"sentence":"The <embassy> staff provided helpful information to the tourists who had lost their passports while traveling abroad.","translation":"大使館工作人員為在國外旅行時遺失護照的遊客提供了有用的資訊。","explanation":"名詞「大使館」。"},{"sentence":"Many people gathered outside the <embassy> to show their support for the peaceful protest happening in the country.","translation":"許多人聚集在大使館外，以表達他們對該國發生的和平抗議活動的支持。","explanation":"名詞「大使館」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"emerge","explanation":"指「出現」或「浮現」。常用於從隱藏處出現，或問題、事實的顯現。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sun began to <emerge> from behind the clouds, and the sky turned a beautiful shade of orange.","translation":"太陽開始從雲層後出現，天空變成了美麗的橘色。","explanation":"動詞「出現」。"},{"sentence":"New evidence has <emerged> that might change the outcome of the investigation into the mysterious accident.","translation":"新的證據已經浮現，這可能會改變對這起神秘事故的調查結果。","explanation":"動詞「浮現/顯現」。"},{"sentence":"After the long winter, small green plants started to <emerge> from the soil in the garden.","translation":"漫長的冬天過後，小小的綠色植物開始從花園的土壤中冒出來。","explanation":"動詞「出現」。"}],"related_forms":["emergence","emergency"]}

{"headword":"emphasis","explanation":"指「強調」。常用搭配 place/put emphasis on sth。注意複數形式為 emphases。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school *places* great <emphasis> *on* the importance of teamwork and communication in all student projects.","translation":"學校在所有學生專案中都非常強調團隊合作與溝通的重要性。","explanation":"名詞「強調」。place emphasis on 為固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"In his speech, the principal *put* special <emphasis> *on* the need for students to develop good study habits.","translation":"校長在演講中特別強調學生培養良好讀書習慣的必要性。","explanation":"名詞「強調」。put emphasis on 為固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"There is a strong <emphasis> *on* learning practical skills in this vocational training program.","translation":"這個職業訓練課程非常強調學習實用技能。","explanation":"名詞「強調」。"}],"related_forms":["emphasize"]}

{"headword":"empire","explanation":"指「帝國」。可用於歷史背景，也可引申為龐大的企業組織。","entries":[{"sentence":"The Roman <empire> was one of the most powerful and influential civilizations in human history.","translation":"羅馬帝國是人類歷史上最強大且最具影響力的文明之一。","explanation":"名詞「帝國」。"},{"sentence":"He worked hard for many years to build his business <empire> from a small local shop into a global company.","translation":"他努力工作多年，將他的商業帝國從一家小型地方商店建立成一家全球性公司。","explanation":"名詞「帝國」。此處引申為龐大的企業。"},{"sentence":"The fall of the <empire> led to many changes in the political and social structure of the region.","translation":"帝國的滅亡導致該地區政治和社會結構的許多改變。","explanation":"名詞「帝國」。"}],"related_forms":["emperor"]}

{"headword":"enclose","explanation":"指「圍住」或「隨信附上」。常見於書信用語。","entries":[{"sentence":"The garden is <enclosed> by a high stone wall to keep the animals safe and provide some privacy.","translation":"花園被一道高高的石牆圍住，以確保動物的安全並提供一些隱私。","explanation":"動詞「圍住」。"},{"sentence":"I have <enclosed> a copy of my resume with this letter for your review and consideration.","translation":"我已隨信附上一份我的履歷表，供您審閱與考慮。","explanation":"動詞「隨信附上」。常見於商務書信。"},{"sentence":"The park is <enclosed> within the city center, offering a quiet place for people to relax.","translation":"這座公園被圍在市中心內，為人們提供了一個放鬆的安靜場所。","explanation":"動詞「圍住」。"}],"related_forms":["enclosure"]}

{"headword":"encounter","explanation":"指「遭遇」或「偶遇」。可作名詞或動詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"During our hike in the mountains, we did not <encounter> any wild animals, which was a relief for everyone.","translation":"在我們山中健行時，我們沒有遇到任何野生動物，這讓每個人都鬆了一口氣。","explanation":"動詞「遭遇」。"},{"sentence":"She had a pleasant <encounter> with her old teacher at the supermarket yesterday afternoon.","translation":"她昨天下午在超市與她的老師有了一次愉快的偶遇。","explanation":"名詞「偶遇」。"},{"sentence":"We might <encounter> some difficulties when we start the new project, but we are prepared to solve them together.","translation":"我們在開始新專案時可能會遇到一些困難，但我們準備好一起解決它們了。","explanation":"動詞「遭遇」。常與 difficulties, problems 搭配。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"endanger","explanation":"指「使危險」。常用被動語態 be endangered (瀕臨絕種的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Pollution and climate change continue to <endanger> the lives of many species in the ocean.","translation":"污染和氣候變遷持續危及海洋中許多物種的生命。","explanation":"動詞「危及」。"},{"sentence":"The giant panda is an <endangered> species, and many organizations are working hard to protect its natural habitat.","translation":"大貓熊是瀕臨絕種的物種，許多組織正努力保護牠們的自然棲息地。","explanation":"形容詞 endangered 指「瀕臨絕種的」。"},{"sentence":"Driving too fast in bad weather will <endanger> not only your own life but also the lives of other drivers.","translation":"在惡劣天氣下開車太快不僅會危及你自己的生命，也會危及其他駕駛的生命。","explanation":"動詞「危及」。"}],"related_forms":["danger","dangerous"]}

{"headword":"endure","explanation":"指「忍受」或「持久」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athletes had to <endure> extreme heat and humidity during the long marathon race this summer.","translation":"運動員在今年夏天的馬拉松長跑中必須忍受極端的炎熱和潮濕。","explanation":"動詞「忍受」。"},{"sentence":"True friendship is something that can <endure> through many years of separation and different life experiences.","translation":"真正的友誼是可以經歷多年分離和不同人生經驗而持久的。","explanation":"動詞「持久」。"},{"sentence":"She had to <endure> a lot of pain after the surgery, but she remained positive throughout her recovery.","translation":"她在手術後必須忍受許多疼痛，但她在整個恢復期間都保持樂觀。","explanation":"動詞「忍受」。"}],"related_forms":["endurance"]}

{"headword":"enforce","explanation":"指「執行」或「強制實施」。常用於法律、規則或政策。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police are responsible for <enforcing> the traffic laws to ensure the safety of all road users.","translation":"警方有責任執行交通法規，以確保所有道路使用者的安全。","explanation":"動詞「執行」。"},{"sentence":"The <enforcement> of the new school rules has led to a quieter and more focused learning environment for everyone.","translation":"新校規的執行為每個人帶來了一個更安靜、更專注的學習環境。","explanation":"名詞 enforcement 指「執行/實施」。"},{"sentence":"It is difficult to <enforce> these regulations when many people do not fully understand why they are necessary.","translation":"當許多人並不完全理解這些規定為何必要時，要執行它們是很困難的。","explanation":"動詞「執行」。"}],"related_forms":["enforcement"]}

{"headword":"engineering","explanation":"指「工程學」。常見搭配 civil engineering, mechanical engineering。","entries":[{"sentence":"He decided to study <engineering> at university because he has always been interested in how machines work.","translation":"他決定在大學學習工程學，因為他一直對機器如何運作很感興趣。","explanation":"名詞「工程學」。"},{"sentence":"The bridge is a great achievement in modern <engineering>, connecting the two sides of the river perfectly.","translation":"這座橋是現代工程學的一大成就，完美地連接了河流的兩岸。","explanation":"名詞「工程學」。"},{"sentence":"Many students choose a career in <engineering> because it offers many opportunities to solve real-world problems.","translation":"許多學生選擇工程學作為職業，因為它提供了許多解決現實世界問題的機會。","explanation":"名詞「工程學」。"}],"related_forms":["engineer"]}

{"headword":"enlarge","explanation":"動詞「擴大/放大」；名詞 enlargement「擴大/擴建」。常與圖片、空間或規模搭配。注意拼字變化，去e加ing。","entries":[{"sentence":"The photographer decided to <enlarge> the *digital photo* so that everyone could see the details clearly.","translation":"攝影師決定將這張數位照片放大，這樣每個人都能清楚地看到細節。","explanation":"動詞「放大」。常用於照片或影像。"},{"sentence":"The city council plans to <enlarge> the *public library* to provide more space for students to study.","translation":"市議會計畫擴建公共圖書館，為學生提供更多學習空間。","explanation":"動詞「擴建/擴大」。指空間或規模的增加。"},{"sentence":"The <enlargement> *of* the factory will create many new job opportunities for the local people.","translation":"工廠的擴建將為當地居民創造許多新的就業機會。","explanation":"名詞「擴建」。注意介係詞 of 的使用。"}],"related_forms":["enlargement","enlarges","enlarging"]}

{"headword":"enormous","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的/龐大的」。與 huge 或 giant 同義，但語氣更強烈。常修飾數量、體積或影響力。","entries":[{"sentence":"The construction project requires an <enormous> *amount of* money and effort to complete on time.","translation":"這項建設工程需要巨大的資金和努力才能準時完成。","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。常與 amount of 搭配。"},{"sentence":"There is an <enormous> *difference* between the two candidates' opinions on how to improve the economy.","translation":"兩位候選人在如何改善經濟的看法上有巨大的差異。","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。修飾抽象名詞 difference。"},{"sentence":"The whale is an <enormous> *creature* that lives deep in the ocean, far away from the coast.","translation":"鯨魚是一種生活在遠離海岸的深海中的巨大生物。","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。修飾實體生物。"}],"related_forms":["enormously"]}

{"headword":"ensure","explanation":"動詞「確保/保證」。用法：ensure that + 子句；ensure sth.；ensure sb. sth.。常與 success, safety 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please check your luggage again to <ensure> *that* you have not left anything important behind.","translation":"請再次檢查你的行李，以確保你沒有遺漏任何重要的東西。","explanation":"動詞「確保」。後接 that 子句。"},{"sentence":"The school has taken strict measures to <ensure> the *safety of* all students during the field trip.","translation":"學校已採取嚴格措施，以確保所有學生在校外教學期間的安全。","explanation":"動詞「確保」。常用搭配 ensure the safety of。"},{"sentence":"Hard work and careful planning are the best ways to <ensure> *future success* in your career.","translation":"努力工作和謹慎規劃是確保未來職業生涯成功的最佳途徑。","explanation":"動詞「確保」。常用搭配 ensure success。"}],"related_forms":["ensures","ensuring","ensured"]}

{"headword":"entertain","explanation":"動詞「娛樂/款待」；名詞 entertainment「娛樂」。常用於形容表演、活動或對客人的款待。","entries":[{"sentence":"The street performers tried to <entertain> the *crowd of* tourists with their amazing magic tricks.","translation":"街頭藝人試圖用他們神奇的魔術來娛樂那群遊客。","explanation":"動詞「娛樂」。指提供表演讓他人開心。"},{"sentence":"My parents often <entertain> *guests* at home by cooking a delicious dinner on weekends.","translation":"我的父母週末常在家裡做一頓美味的晚餐來款待客人。","explanation":"動詞「款待」。指招待客人。"},{"sentence":"The city offers a wide variety of <entertainment>, such as movies, concerts, and art exhibitions.","translation":"這座城市提供多樣化的娛樂活動，例如電影、音樂會和藝術展覽。","explanation":"名詞「娛樂」。不可數名詞。"}],"related_forms":["entertainment","entertainer","entertaining"]}

{"headword":"enthusiasm","explanation":"名詞「熱忱/熱情」。常用搭配：show/have enthusiasm for。注意拼字，中間有 th 和 u。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young teacher showed great <enthusiasm> *for* teaching, which inspired all the students in the class.","translation":"這位年輕老師展現了對教學的極大熱忱，這啟發了班上所有的學生。","explanation":"名詞「熱忱」。常用搭配 enthusiasm for。"},{"sentence":"Despite the heavy rain, the fans cheered with <enthusiasm> *during* the entire baseball game.","translation":"儘管下著大雨，球迷們在整場棒球比賽中仍熱情地歡呼。","explanation":"名詞「熱情」。表示情緒高昂。"},{"sentence":"He accepted the new project with <enthusiasm>, eager to show his skills to the manager.","translation":"他熱情地接受了這個新專案，渴望向經理展示他的技能。","explanation":"名詞「熱忱」。表示積極的態度。"}],"related_forms":["enthusiastic","enthusiast"]}

{"headword":"equality","explanation":"名詞「平等」。常與 gender, social, racial 搭配。強調權利或地位的對等。","entries":[{"sentence":"The organization works hard to promote *gender* <equality> in the workplace and in society.","translation":"該組織致力於促進職場和社會中的性別平等。","explanation":"名詞「平等」。常用搭配 gender equality。"},{"sentence":"Everyone deserves to be treated with respect and <equality>, regardless of their background or beliefs.","translation":"每個人都值得被平等且尊重地對待，無論他們的背景或信仰為何。","explanation":"名詞「平等」。指對待方式的公平。"},{"sentence":"The government is trying to achieve *social* <equality> by providing better education for poor children.","translation":"政府正試圖透過為貧困兒童提供更好的教育來實現社會平等。","explanation":"名詞「平等」。常用搭配 social equality。"}],"related_forms":["equal","equally"]}

{"headword":"equip","explanation":"動詞「裝備/配備」；名詞 equipment「設備/器材」。常用搭配：equip A with B (用B裝備A)。注意 equipment 是不可數名詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school decided to <equip> *every classroom* *with* a new computer and a projector.","translation":"學校決定為每間教室配備一台新電腦和投影機。","explanation":"動詞「配備」。常用搭配 equip A with B。"},{"sentence":"Before going hiking in the mountains, you should make sure you have the right <equipment>.","translation":"在去山裡健行之前，你應該確保你有正確的裝備。","explanation":"名詞「裝備」。不可數名詞，不可加 s。"},{"sentence":"The laboratory is well <equipped> *with* modern tools for scientific research.","translation":"這間實驗室配備了完善的現代化科學研究工具。","explanation":"動詞過去分詞作形容詞。常用搭配 be equipped with。"}],"related_forms":["equipment","equipping","equipped"]}

{"headword":"era","explanation":"名詞「時代/紀元」。指具有特定特徵的歷史時期。","entries":[{"sentence":"We are living in an <era> *of* rapid technological change, where new inventions appear every day.","translation":"我們生活在一個科技快速變遷的時代，每天都有新的發明出現。","explanation":"名詞「時代」。常用搭配 an era of。"},{"sentence":"The invention of the internet marked the beginning of a new <era> *in* global communication.","translation":"網際網路的發明標誌著全球通訊新時代的開始。","explanation":"名詞「時代」。常用搭配 an era in。"},{"sentence":"Many people believe that the <era> *of* fossil fuels will soon end as green energy becomes popular.","translation":"許多人相信，隨著綠色能源變得普及，化石燃料的時代將很快結束。","explanation":"名詞「時代」。指特定能源主導的時期。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"essential","explanation":"形容詞「必要的/不可或缺的」；名詞「必需品」。用法：It is essential that... (that子句動詞用原形)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is <essential> *that* every student *attend* the meeting to discuss the upcoming school event.","translation":"每位學生都必須參加會議，討論即將到來的學校活動。","explanation":"形容詞「必要的」。It is essential that 後接原形動詞。"},{"sentence":"Water and food are <essential> *for* human survival, especially in hot and dry climates.","translation":"水和食物對人類生存至關重要，尤其是在炎熱乾燥的氣候中。","explanation":"形容詞「必要的」。常用搭配 essential for。"},{"sentence":"Before you start the journey, make sure you pack all the <essentials> *like* medicine and warm clothes.","translation":"在你開始旅程之前，確保你打包了所有必需品，像是藥品和保暖衣物。","explanation":"名詞「必需品」。常用複數形 essentials。"}],"related_forms":["essentially"]}

{"headword":"establish","explanation":"動詞「建立/設立」；名詞 establishment「建立/機構」。常指建立公司、制度或關係。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company was <established> *in* 1990, and it has grown into a global business today.","translation":"這家公司成立於1990年，如今已成長為一家全球性企業。","explanation":"動詞「建立」。常用於公司或組織。"},{"sentence":"It is important to <establish> *a good relationship* with your neighbors to live in peace.","translation":"與鄰居建立良好的關係對於和平生活很重要。","explanation":"動詞「建立」。常用搭配 establish a relationship。"},{"sentence":"The <establishment> *of* the new park has provided a great place for families to relax.","translation":"新公園的建立為家庭提供了一個放鬆的好地方。","explanation":"名詞「建立」。指設立的過程或結果。"}],"related_forms":["establishment","establishes","establishing"]}

{"headword":"estimate","explanation":"動詞「估計」；名詞「估計值」。注意發音，動詞結尾為 -ate 發 [et]，名詞結尾發 [ət]。","entries":[{"sentence":"Experts <estimate> *that* the population of this city will reach one million within ten years.","translation":"專家估計這座城市的人口將在十年內達到一百萬。","explanation":"動詞「估計」。後接 that 子句。"},{"sentence":"The repair cost is just an <estimate>; the final price might be higher depending on the parts.","translation":"維修費用只是一個估計值；最終價格可能會根據零件而更高。","explanation":"名詞「估計值」。指粗略的計算。"},{"sentence":"It is hard to <estimate> *the number of* people who will attend the concert this weekend.","translation":"很難估計這個週末會有多少人參加音樂會。","explanation":"動詞「估計」。常用搭配 estimate the number of。"}],"related_forms":["estimated","estimation"]}

{"headword":"ethnic","explanation":"形容詞「種族的/民族的」。指與特定文化或族群相關的特徵。","entries":[{"sentence":"The country is home to many different <ethnic> *groups*, each with its own unique language and traditions.","translation":"這個國家是許多不同種族群體的家園，每個群體都有自己獨特的語言和傳統。","explanation":"形容詞「種族的」。常用搭配 ethnic groups。"},{"sentence":"The restaurant serves a variety of <ethnic> *food*, including dishes from Thailand, India, and Mexico.","translation":"這家餐廳供應各種民族風味的食物，包括來自泰國、印度和墨西哥的菜餚。","explanation":"形容詞「民族的」。指特定文化的食物。"},{"sentence":"We should respect the <ethnic> *diversity* of our society and learn from each other's cultures.","translation":"我們應該尊重社會的種族多樣性，並學習彼此的文化。","explanation":"形容詞「種族的」。常用搭配 ethnic diversity。"}],"related_forms":["ethnicity"]}

{"headword":"evaluate","explanation":"動詞「評估/評價」。指對某事物的價值或表現進行判斷。","entries":[{"sentence":"Teachers often <evaluate> *students'* *performance* based on their homework, tests, and class participation.","translation":"老師通常根據學生的作業、考試和課堂參與度來評估他們的表現。","explanation":"動詞「評估」。常用搭配 evaluate performance。"},{"sentence":"Before buying a new car, you should <evaluate> *the pros and cons* to make a wise decision.","translation":"在買新車之前，你應該評估優缺點，以做出明智的決定。","explanation":"動詞「評估」。常用搭配 evaluate the pros and cons。"},{"sentence":"The manager needs more time to <evaluate> the *new plan* before deciding whether to support it.","translation":"經理需要更多時間來評估這個新計畫，再決定是否支持它。","explanation":"動詞「評估」。指審慎考慮。"}],"related_forms":["evaluation","evaluates","evaluating"]}

{"headword":"evaluation","explanation":"名詞「評估/評價」。指對表現或價值的正式判斷。","entries":[{"sentence":"The final <evaluation> *of* the project will take place at the end of the semester.","translation":"該專案的最終評估將在學期末進行。","explanation":"名詞「評估」。常用搭配 evaluation of。"},{"sentence":"After a careful <evaluation>, the committee decided that the proposal was not suitable for the company.","translation":"經過仔細評估後，委員會認為該提案不適合公司。","explanation":"名詞「評估」。指經過深思熟慮的判斷。"},{"sentence":"Students can improve their work by listening to the teacher's <evaluation> *and* suggestions.","translation":"學生可以透過聽取老師的評價和建議來改進他們的作品。","explanation":"名詞「評價」。指回饋意見。"}],"related_forms":["evaluate"]}

{"headword":"eventual","explanation":"形容詞「最終的/結果的」。指經過一段時間後發生的事情。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite many difficulties, their <eventual> *success* was the result of hard work and persistence.","translation":"儘管困難重重，他們最終的成功是努力工作和堅持不懈的結果。","explanation":"形容詞「最終的」。常用搭配 eventual success。"},{"sentence":"The <eventual> *goal* of the project is to provide clean water to all people in the village.","translation":"該專案的最終目標是為村裡的所有人提供乾淨的水。","explanation":"形容詞「最終的」。常用搭配 eventual goal。"},{"sentence":"We were worried about the <eventual> *outcome* of the election, but the results were peaceful.","translation":"我們很擔心選舉的最終結果，但結果很和平。","explanation":"形容詞「最終的」。常用搭配 eventual outcome。"}],"related_forms":["eventually"]}

{"headword":"evidence","explanation":"名詞「證據/跡象」；動詞「證明」。名詞為不可數，若要表示「一項證據」需用 a piece of evidence。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police found enough <evidence> *to* prove that the man was guilty of the crime.","translation":"警方找到了足夠的證據來證明該男子犯了罪。","explanation":"名詞「證據」。不可數名詞。"},{"sentence":"There is no <evidence> *that* the new medicine has any serious side effects on patients.","translation":"沒有證據顯示這種新藥對病患有任何嚴重的副作用。","explanation":"名詞「證據」。後接 that 子句。"},{"sentence":"The scientist's research <evidences> *the fact* that climate change is affecting our daily lives.","translation":"這位科學家的研究證明了氣候變遷正在影響我們日常生活的事實。","explanation":"動詞「證明」。較正式的用法。"}],"related_forms":["evident"]}

{"headword":"evident","explanation":"形容詞「明顯的/顯而易見的」。與 obvious 同義。常用搭配：It is evident that...。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is <evident> *that* the team worked very hard to win the championship this year.","translation":"顯而易見，這支隊伍為了贏得今年的冠軍非常努力。","explanation":"形容詞「明顯的」。常用句型 It is evident that。"},{"sentence":"The change in her attitude was <evident> *to* everyone who talked to her today.","translation":"她態度的轉變對今天跟她交談的每個人來說都很明顯。","explanation":"形容詞「明顯的」。常用搭配 evident to sb."},{"sentence":"His disappointment was <evident> *in* his voice when he heard the bad news.","translation":"當他聽到壞消息時，他的失望在語氣中顯而易見。","explanation":"形容詞「明顯的」。指情緒表現明顯。"}],"related_forms":["evidence","evidently"]}

{"headword":"exaggerate","explanation":"動詞「誇張/誇大」。指把事情說得比實際情況更嚴重或更重要。","entries":[{"sentence":"Don't <exaggerate> *the story*; just tell me exactly what happened at the party last night.","translation":"不要誇大故事；只要告訴我昨晚派對上到底發生了什麼事。","explanation":"動詞「誇張」。指誇大事實。"},{"sentence":"He tends to <exaggerate> *his achievements* to make himself look more impressive to others.","translation":"他傾向於誇大自己的成就，好讓自己在別人眼中看起來更令人印象深刻。","explanation":"動詞「誇大」。常用搭配 exaggerate one's achievements。"},{"sentence":"It is common for people to <exaggerate> *the size of* the fish they caught during their fishing trip.","translation":"人們在釣魚之旅中誇大他們釣到的魚的大小是很常見的。","explanation":"動詞「誇大」。指誇大數量或尺寸。"}],"related_forms":["exaggerated","exaggeration"]}

{"headword":"exception","explanation":"名詞「例外」。常用搭配：make an exception (破例)；with the exception of (除了...之外)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Everyone must follow the school rules, and the teacher will not <make an exception> *for* anyone.","translation":"每個人都必須遵守校規，老師不會為任何人破例。","explanation":"片語 make an exception。注意介係詞 for。"},{"sentence":"<With the exception of> *the last question*, I found the math test quite easy to finish.","translation":"除了最後一題之外，我覺得數學考試很容易完成。","explanation":"片語 with the exception of = except for。"},{"sentence":"Most of the students passed the exam, with only a few <exceptions> *in* the class.","translation":"班上大多數學生都通過了考試，只有少數例外。","explanation":"名詞「例外」。指不符合一般情況的人或事。"}],"related_forms":["except","exceptional"]}

{"headword":"exhaust","explanation":"動詞「使筋疲力盡/耗盡」；名詞「廢氣」。常用被動語態 exhausted (感到疲憊的) 或主動語態 exhausting (令人疲憊的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The long hike up the mountain <exhausted> *all of* the students, so they slept early that night.","translation":"漫長的登山健行讓所有學生都筋疲力盡，所以他們那天晚上很早就睡了。","explanation":"動詞「使筋疲力盡」。"},{"sentence":"We have <exhausted> *our supply of* water, so we need to find a new source immediately.","translation":"我們已經耗盡了水資源，所以我們需要立即找到新的水源。","explanation":"動詞「耗盡」。指用光資源。"},{"sentence":"The <exhaust> *from* the cars in the city center makes the air quality very poor.","translation":"市中心汽車排放的廢氣使得空氣品質非常差。","explanation":"名詞「廢氣」。指引擎排出的氣體。"}],"related_forms":["exhausted","exhausting","exhaustion"]}

{"headword":"exhibit","explanation":"名詞指「展覽品/展覽會」；動詞指「展現/陳列」。注意動詞用法常與 display 互換，名詞則常指具體的展出物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The museum <exhibits> *a* wide *range* of ancient pottery, attracting thousands of visitors from all over the world every summer.","translation":"博物館展出各式各樣的古代陶器，每年夏天吸引來自世界各地的數千名遊客。","explanation":"動詞用法，意為「展出/陳列」。常用搭配 exhibit a range of sth。"},{"sentence":"The young artist <exhibited> *great* *talent* for painting during the school art competition, surprising all the teachers and judges.","translation":"那位年輕藝術家在學校美術比賽中展現了極高的繪畫天賦，讓所有老師和評審感到驚訝。","explanation":"動詞用法，意為「展現/顯露」。常用搭配 exhibit talent/ability。"},{"sentence":"Visitors are not allowed to touch any of the <exhibits> *in* the gallery to ensure the safety of these valuable historical items.","translation":"為了確保這些珍貴歷史文物的安全，參觀者不得觸摸畫廊內的任何展覽品。","explanation":"名詞用法，意為「展覽品」。"}],"related_forms":["exhibits","exhibited","exhibiting","exhibition"]}

{"headword":"expand","explanation":"動詞「擴張/擴大」。注意與 extend 的區別，expand 多指體積、範圍或規模的增加。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company plans to <expand> *its* *business* *into* international markets to increase its annual revenue and global influence.","translation":"公司計劃將業務擴展到國際市場，以增加年度營收和全球影響力。","explanation":"動詞用法，指業務規模的擴張。常用搭配 expand into markets。"},{"sentence":"Water <expands> *when* it *freezes*, which is why you should not fill a glass bottle completely with water before putting it in the freezer.","translation":"水結冰時會膨脹，這就是為什麼你不應該在放入冷凍庫前將玻璃瓶裝滿水。","explanation":"動詞用法，指物理上的膨脹。"},{"sentence":"The city government decided to <expand> *the* *public* *transportation* system to reduce traffic congestion during rush hours.","translation":"市政府決定擴大公共交通系統，以減少尖峰時刻的交通擁堵。","explanation":"動詞用法，指系統或規模的擴大。"}],"related_forms":["expands","expanded","expanding"]}

{"headword":"expansion","explanation":"名詞「擴張/膨脹」。常指經濟、領土或規模的成長。","entries":[{"sentence":"The rapid <expansion> *of* the internet has changed the way people communicate and access information in their daily lives.","translation":"網際網路的快速擴張改變了人們在日常生活中溝通和獲取資訊的方式。","explanation":"名詞用法，指科技或影響力的擴張。"},{"sentence":"Economic <expansion> *leads* *to* more job opportunities, which helps improve the overall standard of living for the citizens.","translation":"經濟擴張帶來更多就業機會，這有助於提升公民的整體生活水準。","explanation":"名詞用法，指經濟成長。"},{"sentence":"The company's recent <expansion> *into* new regions has brought both great success and many new challenges for the management team.","translation":"公司最近向新地區的擴張，為管理團隊帶來了巨大的成功，也帶來了許多新的挑戰。","explanation":"名詞用法，指市場或地理範圍的擴張。"}],"related_forms":["expansions"]}

{"headword":"experimental","explanation":"形容詞「實驗性的/試驗性的」。指處於測試階段或用於科學實驗。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scientists are conducting an <experimental> *study* *to* determine whether the new medicine is effective against the virus.","translation":"科學家們正在進行一項實驗性研究，以確定這種新藥是否對該病毒有效。","explanation":"形容詞用法，修飾研究。"},{"sentence":"This <experimental> *method* *of* teaching has proven to be very popular among students who prefer hands-on learning activities.","translation":"這種實驗性的教學方法已被證明在喜歡動手學習活動的學生中非常受歡迎。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指創新的或處於測試階段的方法。"},{"sentence":"The car is still at an <experimental> *stage*, so it is not yet ready for mass production or public sale.","translation":"這輛車仍處於實驗階段，因此尚未準備好進行量產或公開銷售。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指處於測試階段的狀態。"}],"related_forms":["experiment"]}

{"headword":"explanation","explanation":"名詞「解釋/說明」。常見搭配 give/provide an explanation for sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the student to provide a clear <explanation> *for* his absence from class yesterday morning.","translation":"老師要求學生為他昨天早上缺席課堂提供一個清楚的解釋。","explanation":"名詞用法，指對某事的解釋。注意介係詞 for。"},{"sentence":"There is no simple <explanation> *for* why the weather has been so unpredictable throughout this entire month.","translation":"對於為什麼這個月的天氣一直如此難以預測，並沒有簡單的解釋。","explanation":"名詞用法，指對現象的說明。"},{"sentence":"After a brief <explanation> *of* the rules, the game finally started, and everyone was excited to participate.","translation":"在對規則進行簡短說明後，遊戲終於開始了，每個人都很興奮地參與其中。","explanation":"名詞用法，指對規則或程序的說明。"}],"related_forms":["explanations"]}

{"headword":"explosion","explanation":"名詞「爆炸/爆發」。可用於物理爆炸，也可用於指數量或現象的激增。","entries":[{"sentence":"The loud <explosion> *caused* *by* the gas leak damaged several buildings in the neighborhood early this morning.","translation":"今天清晨由瓦斯外洩引起的巨大爆炸損壞了附近幾棟建築物。","explanation":"名詞用法，指物理上的爆炸。"},{"sentence":"The sudden <explosion> *of* interest in AI technology has led many students to choose computer science as their major.","translation":"對人工智慧技術興趣的突然激增，導致許多學生選擇電腦科學作為主修。","explanation":"名詞用法，指興趣或現象的激增。"},{"sentence":"Firefighters arrived quickly to prevent another <explosion> *at* the factory after the first fire broke out.","translation":"在第一次火災發生後，消防員迅速趕到以防止工廠發生另一次爆炸。","explanation":"名詞用法，指潛在的爆炸危險。"}],"related_forms":["explosions"]}
