{"headword":"explosive","explanation":"形容詞「爆炸性的/易爆的」；名詞「炸藥」。形容詞也可用於形容情緒或局勢一觸即發。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police warned the public to stay away from the area because of the <explosive> *materials* found in the abandoned warehouse.","translation":"警方警告大眾遠離該區域，因為在廢棄倉庫中發現了爆炸性物質。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指易爆的物質。"},{"sentence":"The politician's <explosive> *remarks* *about* the new policy caused a heated debate among the members of the parliament.","translation":"那位政治人物關於新政策的爆炸性言論，在國會議員之間引發了激烈的辯論。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指引起強烈反應的言論。"},{"sentence":"The soldiers carefully handled the <explosives> *to* ensure that no accidents would occur during the construction project.","translation":"士兵們小心地處理炸藥，以確保在施工過程中不會發生任何意外。","explanation":"名詞用法，指炸藥。"}],"related_forms":["explosives"]}

{"headword":"expose","explanation":"動詞「暴露/揭露」。常用搭配 expose A to B (使 A 接觸 B) 或 expose the truth (揭露真相)。","entries":[{"sentence":"You should wear sunscreen to avoid <exposing> *your* *skin* *to* the harmful ultraviolet rays of the sun.","translation":"你應該擦防曬乳，以避免皮膚暴露在太陽有害的紫外線下。","explanation":"動詞用法，指使接觸。常用搭配 expose to。"},{"sentence":"The investigative reporter worked hard to <expose> *the* *corruption* *within* the local government and bring justice to the people.","translation":"那位調查記者努力揭露地方政府內部的貪腐，並為人民伸張正義。","explanation":"動詞用法，指揭露真相或醜聞。"},{"sentence":"The children were <exposed> *to* classical music at a very young age, which helped develop their appreciation for the arts.","translation":"孩子們在很小的時候就接觸到古典音樂，這有助於培養他們對藝術的欣賞力。","explanation":"動詞用法，指使接觸某種環境或事物。"}],"related_forms":["exposes","exposed","exposing"]}

{"headword":"exposure","explanation":"名詞「暴露/接觸」。常指接觸到有害物質或環境，或指曝光度。","entries":[{"sentence":"Prolonged <exposure> *to* loud noise can lead to permanent hearing loss, so it is important to protect your ears.","translation":"長時間暴露在巨大的噪音中會導致永久性聽力喪失，因此保護耳朵很重要。","explanation":"名詞用法，指接觸到環境。常用搭配 exposure to。"},{"sentence":"The company's <exposure> *to* financial risks increased significantly after they invested all their money in the unstable stock market.","translation":"在將所有資金投入不穩定的股市後，該公司面臨的財務風險顯著增加。","explanation":"名詞用法，指面臨風險。"},{"sentence":"The singer gained more <exposure> *after* appearing on the popular television show, which helped boost her music career.","translation":"那位歌手在參加熱門電視節目後獲得了更多曝光度，這有助於推動她的音樂事業。","explanation":"名詞用法，指媒體曝光度。"}],"related_forms":["exposures"]}

{"headword":"extend","explanation":"動詞「延伸/延長」。指時間、空間或範圍的拉長。注意與 expand 的區別，extend 常指長度或期限。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government decided to <extend> *the* *deadline* *for* submitting the tax forms by two weeks to help busy citizens.","translation":"政府決定將提交稅務表格的截止日期延長兩週，以幫助忙碌的公民。","explanation":"動詞用法，指延長時間。"},{"sentence":"The beautiful beach <extends> *for* miles along the coast, making it a perfect place for long walks in the morning.","translation":"美麗的海灘沿著海岸延伸數英里，使其成為早晨散步的絕佳地點。","explanation":"動詞用法，指空間上的延伸。"},{"sentence":"I would like to <extend> *my* *sincere* *thanks* to everyone who helped me complete this difficult project on time.","translation":"我想向所有幫助我準時完成這個困難專案的人表達我誠摯的謝意。","explanation":"動詞用法，指表達（感謝、邀請等）。"}],"related_forms":["extends","extended","extending"]}

{"headword":"extent","explanation":"名詞「程度/範圍」。常用片語 to a certain extent (在某種程度上)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <extent> *of* the damage caused by the earthquake was much greater than what the experts had initially predicted.","translation":"地震造成的損害程度遠大於專家們最初的預測。","explanation":"名詞用法，指損害的程度。"},{"sentence":"To *a* *certain* <extent>, I agree with your opinion, but I still think we need to consider other factors.","translation":"在某種程度上，我同意你的觀點，但我仍然認為我們需要考慮其他因素。","explanation":"名詞用法，固定片語 to a certain extent。"},{"sentence":"The <extent> *of* the forest is so vast that it is impossible to explore the whole area in just one day.","translation":"森林的範圍非常廣闊，以至於一天之內不可能探索整個區域。","explanation":"名詞用法，指地理範圍。"}],"related_forms":["extents"]}

{"headword":"facial","explanation":"形容詞「臉部的」。常指臉部特徵或護理。","entries":[{"sentence":"The suspect was identified by his <facial> *features* *captured* by the security cameras at the entrance of the building.","translation":"嫌疑人是透過建築物入口處監視器捕捉到的臉部特徵而被識別出來的。","explanation":"形容詞用法，修飾 features。"},{"sentence":"She enjoys getting a <facial> *treatment* *at* the spa every month to keep her skin looking healthy and smooth.","translation":"她喜歡每個月在水療中心做臉部護理，以保持皮膚看起來健康光滑。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指臉部護理。"},{"sentence":"The baby made a funny <facial> *expression* when he tasted the sour lemon for the very first time.","translation":"當嬰兒第一次嚐到酸檸檬時，他做了一個有趣的臉部表情。","explanation":"形容詞用法，修飾 expression。"}],"related_forms":["face"]}

{"headword":"facility","explanation":"名詞「設施/設備」。常指提供特定服務的場所或建築。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school has excellent sports <facilities>, including a large swimming pool, a gym, and a running track for students.","translation":"學校有很棒的運動設施，包括一個大游泳池、健身房和供學生使用的跑道。","explanation":"名詞用法，指運動設施。常用複數。"},{"sentence":"The new medical <facility> *provides* *high-quality* care to patients in the rural area who previously had no access to doctors.","translation":"這家新的醫療機構為偏鄉地區以前無法看醫生的病患提供高品質的照護。","explanation":"名詞用法，指醫療機構。"},{"sentence":"The research <facility> *is* *equipped* *with* the latest technology to help scientists conduct their experiments more efficiently.","translation":"該研究設施配備了最新技術，以幫助科學家更有效率地進行實驗。","explanation":"名詞用法，指研究場所。"}],"related_forms":["facilities"]}

{"headword":"faithful","explanation":"形容詞「忠誠的/忠實的」。指對人忠誠或對事物準確。","entries":[{"sentence":"Dogs are known for being <faithful> *companions* *to* their owners, always staying by their side through good times and bad.","translation":"狗以對主人忠誠的夥伴而聞名，無論好壞總是陪伴在他們身邊。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指忠誠的。"},{"sentence":"The movie is a <faithful> *adaptation* *of* the original novel, keeping all the important characters and plot twists intact.","translation":"這部電影是原著小說的忠實改編，保留了所有重要角色和情節轉折。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指忠實的（改編或描述）。"},{"sentence":"He has been a <faithful> *supporter* *of* the local football team for over twenty years, never missing a single game.","translation":"他二十多年來一直是當地足球隊的忠實支持者，從未錯過任何一場比賽。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指忠實的支持者。"}],"related_forms":["faith","faithfully"]}

{"headword":"fame","explanation":"名詞「名聲/名氣」。常用搭配 rise to fame (成名)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young actor rose to <fame> *after* starring in the hit movie that became a global success last year.","translation":"那位年輕演員在主演了去年在全球取得成功的熱門電影後成名。","explanation":"名詞用法，片語 rise to fame。"},{"sentence":"Despite his great <fame> *and* *wealth*, he remains a humble person who enjoys helping those in need.","translation":"儘管他擁有巨大的名聲和財富，他仍然是一個樂於幫助有需要的人的謙虛之人。","explanation":"名詞用法，指名氣。"},{"sentence":"She decided to leave the world of <fame> *behind* to live a quiet and simple life in the countryside.","translation":"她決定拋下名利世界，到鄉下過著平靜簡單的生活。","explanation":"名詞用法，指名利。"}],"related_forms":["famous"]}

{"headword":"fantastic","explanation":"形容詞「極好的/幻想的」。口語中常用來表示「非常棒」。","entries":[{"sentence":"We had a <fantastic> *time* *at* the beach yesterday, enjoying the warm sun and the clear blue water.","translation":"我們昨天在海灘玩得很開心，享受著溫暖的陽光和清澈的藍色海水。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指極好的體驗。"},{"sentence":"The author is famous for writing <fantastic> *stories* *about* magical creatures living in a hidden world.","translation":"這位作家以撰寫關於生活在隱藏世界中的神奇生物的幻想故事而聞名。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指幻想的。"},{"sentence":"That is a <fantastic> *idea*! I think we should start working on the project as soon as possible.","translation":"那真是個好主意！我想我們應該盡快開始進行這個專案。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指極好的點子。"}],"related_forms":["fantasy"]}

{"headword":"fantasy","explanation":"名詞「幻想/奇幻作品」。指想像中的事物或文學類型。","entries":[{"sentence":"Living on a deserted island is just a <fantasy> *for* most people, but for some, it is a dream they want to achieve.","translation":"住在荒島對大多數人來說只是一種幻想，但對某些人來說，這是他們想要實現的夢想。","explanation":"名詞用法，指幻想。"},{"sentence":"He loves reading <fantasy> *novels* *that* take him to different worlds filled with magic and adventure.","translation":"他喜歡閱讀帶他進入充滿魔法和冒險的不同世界的奇幻小說。","explanation":"名詞用法，指奇幻文學類型。"},{"sentence":"It is important to distinguish between reality and <fantasy> *to* avoid becoming disappointed with your own life.","translation":"區分現實與幻想很重要，以避免對自己的生活感到失望。","explanation":"名詞用法，指幻想。"}],"related_forms":["fantastic"]}

{"headword":"farewell","explanation":"名詞「告別/再見」。常用於正式場合或道別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students held a <farewell> *party* *for* their favorite teacher who is retiring after thirty years of service.","translation":"學生們為他們最喜愛的老師舉辦了告別派對，該老師在服務三十年後即將退休。","explanation":"名詞用法，修飾 party。"},{"sentence":"It is always hard to say <farewell> *to* friends when you know you might not see them for a long time.","translation":"當你知道可能很長一段時間見不到朋友時，向他們道別總是很困難。","explanation":"名詞用法，片語 say farewell to。"},{"sentence":"The captain gave a short <farewell> *speech* *before* the ship left the harbor for the long journey ahead.","translation":"船長在船隻離開港口進行前方漫長旅程之前，發表了簡短的告別演說。","explanation":"名詞用法，修飾 speech。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"fasten","explanation":"動詞「繫緊/扣上」。常用於安全帶或鈕扣。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please <fasten> *your* *seat* *belt* before the plane takes off to ensure your safety during the flight.","translation":"請在飛機起飛前繫好安全帶，以確保您在飛行期間的安全。","explanation":"動詞用法，常用搭配 fasten seat belt。"},{"sentence":"She <fastened> *the* *buttons* *of* her coat because the wind was blowing very hard outside.","translation":"她扣上了外套的鈕扣，因為外面的風吹得很大。","explanation":"動詞用法，指扣上鈕扣。"},{"sentence":"Make sure you <fasten> *the* *door* *securely* so that no one can enter the room while you are away.","translation":"確保你將門鎖緊，這樣在你離開時就沒有人能進入房間。","explanation":"動詞用法，指鎖緊或固定。"}],"related_forms":["fastens","fastened","fastening"]}

{"headword":"fatal","explanation":"形容詞「致命的」。指導致死亡或毀滅性的。","entries":[{"sentence":"The driver made a <fatal> *mistake* *by* falling asleep at the wheel, which led to a serious car accident.","translation":"駕駛因開車時睡著而犯了致命的錯誤，導致了一場嚴重的車禍。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指致命的錯誤。"},{"sentence":"The virus can be <fatal> *to* elderly people or those who have existing health problems, so they must be careful.","translation":"這種病毒對老年人或有既有健康問題的人可能是致命的，所以他們必須小心。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指對某人致命。"},{"sentence":"He suffered a <fatal> *injury* *in* the accident and passed away shortly after arriving at the hospital.","translation":"他在事故中受了致命傷，並在抵達醫院後不久去世。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指致命的傷害。"}],"related_forms":["fatally"]}

{"headword":"favorable","explanation":"形容詞「有利的、贊同的」。常搭配條件、反應或評價。注意拼字為 favorable (美式) 或 favourable (英式)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The weather conditions were <favorable> *for* the outdoor sports competition, so all the students enjoyed the game under the bright sunshine.","translation":"天氣條件對戶外運動競賽很有利，所以所有學生都在明亮的陽光下享受了比賽。","explanation":"favorable for sth. 表示「對某事有利的」。"},{"sentence":"The new policy received a <favorable> *response* *from* the public because it helps reduce the living costs for young families.","translation":"這項新政策得到了公眾的正面回應，因為它有助於降低年輕家庭的生活成本。","explanation":"favorable response 表示「正面的/贊同的回應」。"},{"sentence":"With a <favorable> *impression* *of* the candidate, the manager decided to offer him the job immediately after the interview.","translation":"對這位候選人有良好的印象，經理決定在面試後立即錄用他。","explanation":"favorable impression 表示「良好的印象」。"}],"related_forms":["favor","favorably"]}

{"headword":"fax","explanation":"名詞「傳真」；動詞「傳真」。雖然現代通訊發達，但在商務情境中仍偶爾使用。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please <fax> the signed contract *to* our office before five o'clock so that we can process your application today.","translation":"請在五點前將簽署的合約傳真到我們辦公室，以便我們今天能處理您的申請。","explanation":"動詞用法，fax sth. to sb. 表示「傳真某物給某人」。"},{"sentence":"I sent a <fax> *to* the hotel to confirm my room reservation for the upcoming summer vacation.","translation":"我傳真了一份文件給飯店，以確認我即將到來的暑假訂房。","explanation":"名詞用法，send a fax to sb. 表示「傳真給某人」。"},{"sentence":"The <fax> *machine* *in* the library is broken, so you might need to find another way to send your documents.","translation":"圖書館的傳真機壞了，所以你可能需要找其他方式來寄送你的文件。","explanation":"fax machine 是常見的複合名詞。"}],"related_forms":["faxes","faxed"]}

{"headword":"feast","explanation":"名詞「盛宴、節日」；動詞「盡情享用」。常指豐盛的食物或感官享受。","entries":[{"sentence":"The family prepared a grand <feast> *for* the Thanksgiving dinner, including a large turkey and many delicious side dishes.","translation":"這家人為感恩節晚餐準備了一場盛宴，包括一隻大火雞和許多美味的配菜。","explanation":"名詞用法，指豐盛的餐點。"},{"sentence":"We <feasted> *on* fresh seafood and local fruits during our wonderful trip to the coastal village last weekend.","translation":"上週末我們去沿海村莊旅行時，盡情享用了新鮮的海鮮和當地水果。","explanation":"動詞用法，feast on sth. 表示「盡情享用某物」。"},{"sentence":"The annual music festival is a real <feast> *for* the ears, attracting thousands of fans from all over the country.","translation":"年度音樂節是一場真正的聽覺盛宴，吸引了來自全國各地的數千名粉絲。","explanation":"名詞用法，a feast for the eyes/ears 指「視覺/聽覺的饗宴」。"}],"related_forms":["feasts","feasting"]}

{"headword":"feedback","explanation":"名詞「回饋、意見」。注意此字為不可數名詞，不可加 s。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to provide <feedback> *on* the new teaching method so that she could improve her lessons.","translation":"老師請學生對新的教學方法提供回饋，以便她能改進課程。","explanation":"feedback on sth. 表示「對某事的意見」。"},{"sentence":"We appreciate your valuable <feedback>, which helps us understand how to serve our customers better in the future.","translation":"我們感謝您寶貴的意見，這有助於我們了解未來如何更好地服務客戶。","explanation":"valuable feedback 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"After the presentation, the manager gave some positive <feedback> *to* the team members about their hard work.","translation":"簡報結束後，經理給了團隊成員一些關於他們辛勤工作的正面回饋。","explanation":"give feedback to sb. 表示「給某人回饋」。"}],"related_forms":["feedbacks"]}

{"headword":"ferry","explanation":"名詞「渡輪」；動詞「運送」。指在兩岸間往返的交通工具或行為。","entries":[{"sentence":"We took a <ferry> *across* the river to reach the small island where we spent a relaxing afternoon.","translation":"我們搭乘渡輪過河，到達了我們度過輕鬆下午的小島。","explanation":"名詞用法，take a ferry 表示「搭乘渡輪」。"},{"sentence":"The small boat <ferried> passengers *between* the two islands every hour throughout the busy summer season.","translation":"在繁忙的夏季，這艘小船每小時在兩座島嶼之間運送乘客。","explanation":"動詞用法，ferry sb./sth. between A and B 表示「在A與B之間運送」。"},{"sentence":"The <ferry> *terminal* is located near the city center, making it very convenient for tourists to travel to the nearby islands.","translation":"渡輪碼頭位於市中心附近，這使得遊客前往附近的島嶼非常方便。","explanation":"ferry terminal 是常見的複合名詞。"}],"related_forms":["ferries","ferried"]}

{"headword":"fertile","explanation":"形容詞「肥沃的、多產的」。常用於描述土地或想像力。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <fertile> *soil* *in* this valley is perfect for growing various vegetables and fruits throughout the year.","translation":"這個山谷肥沃的土壤非常適合全年種植各種蔬菜和水果。","explanation":"fertile soil 表示「肥沃的土壤」。"},{"sentence":"The artist has a <fertile> *imagination*, which allows him to create many unique and beautiful paintings every year.","translation":"這位藝術家有豐富的想像力，這使他每年都能創作出許多獨特而美麗的畫作。","explanation":"fertile imagination 表示「豐富的想像力」。"},{"sentence":"Farmers work hard to keep the land <fertile> *by* using natural fertilizers and rotating their crops every season.","translation":"農夫們努力透過使用天然肥料和每季輪作來保持土地肥沃。","explanation":"keep the land fertile 表示「保持土地肥沃」。"}],"related_forms":["fertility","fertilize"]}

{"headword":"fetch","explanation":"動詞「去拿來、取回」。常指去某處拿東西並帶回來。","entries":[{"sentence":"Could you please <fetch> a glass *of* water *for* me? I am feeling a bit thirsty after the long run.","translation":"你可以幫我拿杯水嗎？長跑後我感到有點口渴。","explanation":"fetch sth. for sb. 表示「幫某人拿某物」。"},{"sentence":"The dog loves to play with a ball; it will always run to <fetch> it whenever I throw it far away.","translation":"這隻狗很喜歡玩球；每當我把它丟遠時，牠總會跑去把它撿回來。","explanation":"fetch 常用於描述狗撿球的動作。"},{"sentence":"I need to <fetch> my sister *from* the airport because her flight arrives late at night.","translation":"我需要去機場接我妹妹，因為她的班機很晚才到。","explanation":"fetch sb. from a place 表示「去某地接某人」。"}],"related_forms":["fetches","fetched"]}

{"headword":"fiction","explanation":"名詞「小說、虛構故事」。與 nonfiction (非小說/紀實文學) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"She enjoys reading science <fiction> because it allows her to explore different worlds and future possibilities.","translation":"她喜歡閱讀科幻小說，因為這讓她能探索不同的世界和未來的可能性。","explanation":"science fiction 是常見的類型。"},{"sentence":"Although the story is based *on* real events, the author added some <fiction> to make the plot more exciting.","translation":"雖然這個故事是基於真實事件，但作者加入了一些虛構情節，使劇情更刺激。","explanation":"fiction 在此指「虛構的成分」。"},{"sentence":"Many people find it difficult to distinguish between fact and <fiction> when they read news on the internet.","translation":"許多人在網路上閱讀新聞時，發現很難區分事實與虛構。","explanation":"fact and fiction 是常見的對比搭配。"}],"related_forms":["fictional"]}

{"headword":"fierce","explanation":"形容詞「激烈的、兇猛的」。可用於描述競爭、天氣或動物。","entries":[{"sentence":"There was <fierce> *competition* *among* the students to win the first prize in the national writing contest.","translation":"學生之間為了贏得全國寫作比賽的第一名，競爭非常激烈。","explanation":"fierce competition 表示「激烈的競爭」。"},{"sentence":"The <fierce> *storm* caused a lot of damage to the houses and trees in the small village last night.","translation":"昨晚猛烈的暴風雨對小村莊的房屋和樹木造成了很大的損壞。","explanation":"fierce storm 表示「猛烈的暴風雨」。"},{"sentence":"The lion is known for its <fierce> *nature*, but it usually only attacks when it feels threatened by others.","translation":"獅子以其兇猛的本性聞名，但牠通常只有在感到被威脅時才會攻擊。","explanation":"fierce nature 表示「兇猛的本性」。"}],"related_forms":["fiercely"]}

{"headword":"finance","explanation":"名詞「財務、金融」；動詞「資助」。注意重音位置，名詞重音在第一音節，動詞重音在第二音節。","entries":[{"sentence":"He decided to study <finance> *at* the university because he wants to work in a bank in the future.","translation":"他決定在大學學習金融，因為他未來想在銀行工作。","explanation":"名詞用法，指金融學科或財務狀況。"},{"sentence":"The government will <finance> the new project *to* build more public parks in the city center.","translation":"政府將資助這項在市中心興建更多公園的新計畫。","explanation":"動詞用法，finance sth. 表示「資助某計畫」。"},{"sentence":"The company is having some <finance> *problems* because of the recent economic downturn in the market.","translation":"由於市場最近的經濟衰退，這家公司正遇到一些財務問題。","explanation":"finance problems 表示「財務問題」。"}],"related_forms":["finances","financed"]}

{"headword":"financial","explanation":"形容詞「財務的、金融的」。常用於描述與錢有關的事務。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company is facing a serious <financial> *crisis* and may need to cut down on its expenses.","translation":"這家公司正面臨嚴重的財務危機，可能需要削減開支。","explanation":"financial crisis 表示「財務危機」。"},{"sentence":"Students can apply for <financial> *aid* *from* the school if they have difficulty paying their tuition fees.","translation":"如果學生在支付學費方面有困難，可以向學校申請財務補助。","explanation":"financial aid 表示「財務補助」。"},{"sentence":"It is important to have a good <financial> *plan* to manage your savings and future investments effectively.","translation":"擁有良好的財務計畫來有效管理你的儲蓄和未來投資是很重要的。","explanation":"financial plan 表示「財務計畫」。"}],"related_forms":["financially"]}

{"headword":"fireplace","explanation":"名詞「壁爐」。常與寒冷天氣或溫馨家庭場景連結。","entries":[{"sentence":"We sat *by* the <fireplace> to keep warm while it was snowing heavily outside the house.","translation":"我們坐在壁爐旁取暖，同時房子外面正下著大雪。","explanation":"sit by the fireplace 表示「坐在壁爐旁」。"},{"sentence":"The family hung their socks *above* the <fireplace> on Christmas Eve, hoping to receive gifts from Santa Claus.","translation":"平安夜時，這家人把襪子掛在壁爐上方，希望能收到聖誕老人的禮物。","explanation":"above the fireplace 表示「在壁爐上方」。"},{"sentence":"The living room looks very cozy with a large <fireplace> and comfortable chairs for everyone to relax.","translation":"客廳看起來非常舒適，有一個大壁爐和讓每個人放鬆的舒適椅子。","explanation":"名詞用法，描述居家環境。"}],"related_forms":["fireplaces"]}

{"headword":"flatter","explanation":"動詞「奉承、討好」。指為了某種目的而說好話。","entries":[{"sentence":"He tried to <flatter> his boss *by* giving him many compliments, hoping to get a promotion soon.","translation":"他試圖透過給老闆許多讚美來奉承他，希望很快能獲得升遷。","explanation":"flatter sb. by doing sth. 表示「透過做某事來奉承某人」。"},{"sentence":"I was <flattered> *by* her kind words, but I knew she was just trying to be polite to me.","translation":"我對她的好話感到受寵若驚，但我知道她只是試著對我有禮貌。","explanation":"be flattered by sth. 表示「對某事感到受寵若驚」。"},{"sentence":"Don't let his sweet words <flatter> you; he often says things he doesn't really mean.","translation":"別被他的甜言蜜語給奉承到了；他常說些他並非真心實意的話。","explanation":"動詞用法，指被言語所迷惑。"}],"related_forms":["flatters","flattered","flattery"]}

{"headword":"flea","explanation":"名詞「跳蚤」。常與寵物衛生相關。","entries":[{"sentence":"The dog was scratching itself because it had <flea> *bites* all over its body after playing in the grass.","translation":"這隻狗一直在抓癢，因為牠在草地上玩耍後全身都是跳蚤咬的痕跡。","explanation":"flea bites 表示「跳蚤咬痕」。"},{"sentence":"You should take your cat to the vet to get some <flea> *medicine* to keep it healthy and clean.","translation":"你應該帶你的貓去看獸醫，買些除跳蚤藥，以保持牠健康乾淨。","explanation":"flea medicine 表示「除跳蚤藥」。"},{"sentence":"The <flea> *market* is a great place to find old books, clothes, and unique items at very low prices.","translation":"跳蚤市場是一個能以非常低的價格找到舊書、衣服和獨特物品的好地方。","explanation":"flea market 是固定用法，指「跳蚤市場」。"}],"related_forms":["fleas"]}

{"headword":"flee","explanation":"動詞「逃跑、逃離」。通常指為了躲避危險而離開。注意過去式與過去分詞為 fled。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many people had to <flee> *from* their homes when the war started in their country last year.","translation":"去年當他們的國家爆發戰爭時，許多人不得不逃離家園。","explanation":"flee from a place 表示「從某地逃離」。"},{"sentence":"The thief <fled> *the* *scene* immediately after the police arrived at the bank to investigate the robbery.","translation":"警察到達銀行調查搶案後，小偷立刻逃離了現場。","explanation":"flee the scene 表示「逃離現場」。"},{"sentence":"The animals <fled> *in* *terror* when they heard the loud noise of the forest fire nearby.","translation":"當動物們聽到附近森林大火的巨大聲響時，牠們驚恐地逃跑了。","explanation":"flee in terror 表示「驚恐地逃跑」。"}],"related_forms":["flees","fled"]}

{"headword":"flexible","explanation":"形容詞「靈活的、有彈性的」。可用於描述時間、計畫或身體。","entries":[{"sentence":"Our company has a <flexible> *working* *schedule*, which allows employees to choose their own hours.","translation":"我們公司有靈活的工作時間表，這讓員工可以選擇自己的工作時數。","explanation":"flexible working schedule 表示「靈活的工作時間表」。"},{"sentence":"You need to be <flexible> *with* your study plan because unexpected things might happen during the semester.","translation":"你需要對你的學習計畫保持靈活，因為學期中可能會發生意想不到的事情。","explanation":"flexible with sth. 表示「對某事保持靈活」。"},{"sentence":"Doing yoga every morning can help you become more <flexible> and improve your overall physical health.","translation":"每天早上做瑜伽可以幫助你變得更柔軟，並改善你的整體身體健康。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指身體柔軟。"}],"related_forms":["flexibility"]}

{"headword":"fluent","explanation":"形容詞「流利的」。常用於描述語言能力。","entries":[{"sentence":"She is <fluent> *in* English and French, so she can easily communicate with people from different countries.","translation":"她精通英語和法語，所以她可以輕鬆地與來自不同國家的人溝通。","explanation":"fluent in + 語言 表示「精通某語言」。"},{"sentence":"After living in Japan for three years, he became <fluent> *in* Japanese and made many local friends.","translation":"在日本住了三年後，他變得精通日語，並結交了許多當地朋友。","explanation":"become fluent in 表示「變得精通」。"},{"sentence":"The student gave a <fluent> *presentation* *about* environmental protection, impressing all the teachers in the room.","translation":"這位學生做了一場關於環境保護的流利簡報，讓室內所有的老師印象深刻。","explanation":"fluent presentation 表示「流利的簡報」。"}],"related_forms":["fluency"]}

{"headword":"flush","explanation":"動詞「沖水、臉紅」；名詞「沖水」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please remember to <flush> the toilet after you use it to keep the bathroom clean and fresh.","translation":"請記得在使用後沖馬桶，以保持浴室乾淨清爽。","explanation":"動詞用法，指沖馬桶。"},{"sentence":"She felt her face <flush> *with* embarrassment when everyone started singing happy birthday to her in public.","translation":"當大家開始在公共場合為她唱生日快樂歌時，她感到臉紅尷尬。","explanation":"flush with embarrassment 表示「因尷尬而臉紅」。"},{"sentence":"The <flush> *of* the water was not strong enough to clean the sink, so I had to use a brush.","translation":"沖水的水流不夠強，無法清潔水槽，所以我必須使用刷子。","explanation":"名詞用法，指沖水的水流。"}],"related_forms":["flushes","flushed"]}

{"headword":"foam","explanation":"名詞「泡沫」；動詞「起泡沫」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The waves were covered *in* white <foam> as they crashed against the rocks on the beach.","translation":"當海浪拍打在海灘的岩石上時，上面覆蓋著白色的泡沫。","explanation":"名詞用法，指海浪的泡沫。"},{"sentence":"The soap began to <foam> *when* I added some water and rubbed it between my hands.","translation":"當我加了一些水並在雙手之間搓揉時，肥皂開始起泡沫。","explanation":"動詞用法，指起泡沫。"},{"sentence":"The coffee has a thick layer *of* milk <foam> *on* top, which makes it taste very smooth and delicious.","translation":"咖啡上面有一層厚厚的奶泡，這讓它喝起來非常滑順美味。","explanation":"milk foam 表示「奶泡」。"}],"related_forms":["foams","foamed"]}

{"headword":"forbid","explanation":"動詞「禁止」。注意過去式為 forbade，過去分詞為 forbidden。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school rules <forbid> students *from* using their mobile phones during class to help them focus better.","translation":"校規禁止學生在上課期間使用手機，以幫助他們更專注。","explanation":"forbid sb. from doing sth. 表示「禁止某人做某事」。"},{"sentence":"It is <forbidden> *to* smoke in this building, so please go outside if you want to have a cigarette.","translation":"這棟建築內禁止吸菸，所以如果你想抽菸，請到外面去。","explanation":"It is forbidden to do sth. 表示「做某事是被禁止的」。"},{"sentence":"The law <forbids> the sale *of* alcohol to anyone under the age of eighteen in this country.","translation":"在這個國家，法律禁止向任何未滿十八歲的人販售酒精飲料。","explanation":"forbid the sale of sth. 表示「禁止販售某物」。"}],"related_forms":["forbids","forbade","forbidden"]}

{"headword":"forecast","explanation":"名詞「預測/預報」；動詞「預測」。常見搭配 weather forecast。動詞三態同形 (forecast-forecast-forecast)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The weather <forecast> *predicts* heavy rain for the weekend, so we should probably cancel our outdoor hiking trip to the mountains.","translation":"天氣預報預測週末會有大雨，所以我們或許應該取消去山上的戶外健行之旅。","explanation":"名詞用法，常與動詞 predict 或 call for 連用。"},{"sentence":"Experts <forecast> *a* significant *increase* in global temperatures over the next decade due to the ongoing effects of climate change.","translation":"專家預測，由於氣候變遷的持續影響，未來十年全球氣溫將顯著上升。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示對未來的推測。"},{"sentence":"Based on the latest economic <forecast>, the company decided to reduce its production to avoid having too much stock in the warehouse.","translation":"根據最新的經濟預測，該公司決定減少生產，以避免倉庫中有過多的庫存。","explanation":"名詞用法，用於商業或經濟領域的預測。"}],"related_forms":["forecasting"]}

{"headword":"formation","explanation":"名詞「形成/構成/隊形」。指事物被創造或排列的過程。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <formation> *of* the new government took several weeks of intense negotiation between the different political parties involved in the election.","translation":"新政府的組成花了參與選舉的不同政黨之間數週的激烈談判。","explanation":"指組織或政府的建立過程。"},{"sentence":"Geologists study the <formation> *of* rocks to understand how the Earth's surface has changed over millions of years.","translation":"地質學家研究岩石的形成，以了解地球表面在數百萬年間是如何改變的。","explanation":"指自然界的形成過程。"},{"sentence":"The birds flew in a V-shaped <formation> *across* the sky, which helps them save energy during their long migration journey.","translation":"鳥兒以 V 字型隊形飛過天空，這有助於牠們在漫長的遷徙旅途中節省體力。","explanation":"指物體排列的隊形。"}],"related_forms":["form","formative"]}

{"headword":"formula","explanation":"名詞「公式/配方/準則」。在數學中指公式，在商業或科學中指配方或解決問題的方法。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student memorized the math <formula> *to* solve the complex geometry problems on the final examination paper.","translation":"這名學生背下了數學公式，以解決期末考卷上複雜的幾何問題。","explanation":"指數學或科學公式。"},{"sentence":"The company has a secret <formula> *for* its success, which involves high-quality products and excellent customer service.","translation":"該公司有一套成功的秘訣，其中包括高品質的產品和卓越的客戶服務。","explanation":"指成功的秘訣或方法。"},{"sentence":"The scientist is trying to find the right chemical <formula> *to* create a new type of environmentally friendly plastic.","translation":"科學家正試圖找到正確的化學配方，以創造出一種新型的環保塑膠。","explanation":"指化學配方。"}],"related_forms":["formulate","formulation"]}

{"headword":"fort","explanation":"名詞「堡壘/要塞」。指防禦性的軍事建築。","entries":[{"sentence":"The soldiers defended the <fort> *against* the enemy attacks for several days until reinforcements finally arrived from the capital.","translation":"士兵們防守堡壘抵抗敵人的攻擊數日，直到來自首都的援軍終於抵達。","explanation":"指軍事防禦工事。"},{"sentence":"We visited an old stone <fort> *on* the coast that was built hundreds of years ago to protect the city from pirates.","translation":"我們參觀了海岸邊一座古老的石造堡壘，它是數百年前為了保護城市免受海盜侵擾而建的。","explanation":"指歷史性的防禦建築。"},{"sentence":"The children built a small <fort> *out* of blankets and pillows in the living room to play games during the rainy afternoon.","translation":"孩子們在客廳用毯子和枕頭蓋了一座小堡壘，以便在下雨的午後玩遊戲。","explanation":"指用物品搭建的類似堡壘的遮蔽物。"}],"related_forms":["fortress","fortify"]}

{"headword":"fortunate","explanation":"形容詞「幸運的」。常用搭配 be fortunate to V 或 be fortunate in sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"I was very <fortunate> *to* receive a scholarship, which allowed me to focus on my studies without worrying about tuition fees.","translation":"我很幸運能獲得獎學金，這讓我能專注於學業，而不必擔心學費問題。","explanation":"be fortunate to V 表示「很幸運能做某事」。"},{"sentence":"She is <fortunate> *in* having a supportive family that always encourages her to pursue her dreams no matter how difficult they seem.","translation":"她很幸運擁有一個支持她的家庭，無論夢想看起來多麼困難，他們總是鼓勵她去追求。","explanation":"be fortunate in sth 表示「在某方面很幸運」。"},{"sentence":"It was a <fortunate> *coincidence* that we met at the airport, as we had not seen each other for over ten years.","translation":"我們在機場相遇真是幸運的巧合，因為我們已經超過十年沒見面了。","explanation":"形容詞修飾名詞，表示幸運的。"}],"related_forms":["fortunately","fortune"]}

{"headword":"fossil","explanation":"名詞「化石」；形容詞「化石的/守舊的」。常與 fuel 搭配 (fossil fuel)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The museum displays a giant dinosaur <fossil> *found* in the desert, which attracts many visitors from all over the world.","translation":"博物館展示了一具在沙漠中發現的巨大恐龍化石，吸引了來自世界各地的遊客。","explanation":"名詞用法，指古代生物遺骸。"},{"sentence":"Many countries are trying to reduce their reliance *on* <fossil> *fuels* to combat global warming and protect the environment.","translation":"許多國家正試圖減少對化石燃料的依賴，以對抗全球暖化並保護環境。","explanation":"fossil fuel 是常見的固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"Scientists believe that this rare <fossil> *provides* important clues about how early life on Earth evolved over millions of years.","translation":"科學家認為這個罕見的化石提供了關於地球早期生命如何在數百萬年間演化的重要線索。","explanation":"指化石作為科學研究的證據。"}],"related_forms":["fossilize"]}

{"headword":"foundation","explanation":"名詞「基礎/地基/基金會」。指建築物的地基或抽象事物的根基。","entries":[{"sentence":"A strong <foundation> *in* mathematics is essential for students who want to pursue a career in engineering or computer science.","translation":"對於想要從事工程或電腦科學職涯的學生來說，紮實的數學基礎是必要的。","explanation":"指抽象的基礎，常搭配 in/of。"},{"sentence":"The charity <foundation> *provides* financial support to children in need, helping them get a better education and a brighter future.","translation":"該慈善基金會為有需要的兒童提供經濟支持，幫助他們獲得更好的教育和更光明的未來。","explanation":"指組織機構，即基金會。"},{"sentence":"The workers poured concrete to build the <foundation> *of* the new library, ensuring the building would be safe and stable for years.","translation":"工人們澆灌混凝土來建造新圖書館的地基，確保建築物多年來都能安全且穩固。","explanation":"指建築物的地基。"}],"related_forms":["found"]}

{"headword":"founder","explanation":"名詞「創辦人/創立者」。指建立公司、組織或機構的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <founder> *of* the technology company started the business in a small garage with only a few friends and limited resources.","translation":"這家科技公司的創辦人在一個小車庫裡開始創業，當時只有幾個朋友和有限的資源。","explanation":"指公司或組織的創立者。"},{"sentence":"As the <founder> *of* the local animal shelter, she has dedicated her life to helping stray dogs and cats find new homes.","translation":"身為當地動物收容所的創辦人，她畢生致力於幫助流浪狗和貓找到新家。","explanation":"指機構的創立者。"},{"sentence":"The university was established by a group of scholars, and its <founder> *is* remembered every year during the graduation ceremony.","translation":"這所大學是由一群學者建立的，其創辦人在每年畢業典禮時都會被紀念。","explanation":"指大學或學校的創立者。"}],"related_forms":["found"]}

{"headword":"fragile","explanation":"形容詞「脆弱的/易碎的」。指容易損壞的物品或身體、心理狀態。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please handle the glass vase with care because it is extremely <fragile> *and* can break into pieces if you drop it.","translation":"請小心處理那個玻璃花瓶，因為它非常脆弱，如果掉落可能會碎成碎片。","explanation":"指物品易碎。"},{"sentence":"The peace in the region is very <fragile>, and any small conflict could lead to a major war between the two countries.","translation":"該地區的和平非常脆弱，任何小衝突都可能導致兩國之間的大戰。","explanation":"指抽象概念（如和平、關係）的脆弱。"},{"sentence":"After the long illness, his health remained <fragile>, so he had to rest and avoid any strenuous physical activities for a while.","translation":"生了一場大病後，他的健康狀況仍然很脆弱，所以他必須休息並暫時避免任何劇烈的體能活動。","explanation":"指身體狀況虛弱。"}],"related_forms":["fragility"]}

{"headword":"frame","explanation":"名詞「框架/框」；動詞「給...裝框/陷害」。","entries":[{"sentence":"She decided to <frame> *the* beautiful painting and hang it on the living room wall to decorate her new apartment.","translation":"她決定把那幅美麗的畫裝上框，並掛在客廳牆上來裝飾她的新公寓。","explanation":"動詞用法，指給畫作裝框。"},{"sentence":"The wooden <frame> *of* the window was rotten due to years of exposure to heavy rain and humidity in the coastal area.","translation":"窗戶的木製框架因為多年暴露在沿海地區的大雨和潮濕中而腐爛了。","explanation":"名詞用法，指窗框。"},{"sentence":"The innocent man claimed that someone had tried to <frame> *him* for the crime by planting evidence at his house.","translation":"那名無辜的男子聲稱有人試圖透過在他家放置證據來陷害他犯罪。","explanation":"動詞用法，指陷害某人。"}],"related_forms":["framework"]}

{"headword":"frequency","explanation":"名詞「頻率/發生次數」。指某事發生的頻繁程度。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <frequency> *of* the bus service has been increased to every ten minutes to accommodate the growing number of passengers.","translation":"公車服務的頻率已增加到每十分鐘一班，以容納越來越多的乘客。","explanation":"指事件發生的頻率。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are studying the <frequency> *of* earthquakes in this area to better predict and prepare for future natural disasters.","translation":"科學家正在研究該地區地震的發生頻率，以便更好地預測並為未來的自然災害做準備。","explanation":"指災害發生的頻率。"},{"sentence":"You can tune your radio to a different <frequency> *to* listen to a variety of music stations throughout the city.","translation":"你可以將收音機調到不同的頻率，以收聽城市中各種不同的音樂電台。","explanation":"指無線電頻率。"}],"related_forms":["frequent"]}

{"headword":"freshman","explanation":"名詞「大一新生」。在美國高中或大學的第一年學生。","entries":[{"sentence":"As a college <freshman>, he felt nervous about living away from home for the first time and meeting so many new people.","translation":"身為大學新鮮人，他對於第一次離家生活以及結識這麼多新朋友感到緊張。","explanation":"指大學一年級學生。"},{"sentence":"The university organized an orientation program for all <freshmen> *to* help them adjust to campus life and learn about school resources.","translation":"大學為所有大一新生舉辦了迎新活動，幫助他們適應校園生活並了解學校資源。","explanation":"複數形式為 freshmen。"},{"sentence":"During her <freshman> *year*, she joined several clubs to explore her interests and make friends with students from different departments.","translation":"在大一那年，她參加了幾個社團，以探索自己的興趣並與不同系的學生交朋友。","explanation":"形容詞用法，修飾 year。"}],"related_forms":["fresh"]}

{"headword":"frost","explanation":"名詞「霜」；動詞「結霜」。指低溫造成的現象。","entries":[{"sentence":"The grass was covered with <frost> *in* the early morning, making the garden look like a beautiful winter wonderland.","translation":"清晨草地上覆蓋著一層霜，使花園看起來像一個美麗的冬日仙境。","explanation":"名詞用法，指地表的霜。"},{"sentence":"The cold weather caused the car windows to <frost> *over* during the night, so I had to scrape the ice off before driving.","translation":"寒冷的天氣導致車窗在夜間結霜，所以我開車前必須把冰刮掉。","explanation":"動詞用法，指結霜。"},{"sentence":"A sudden <frost> *destroyed* most of the crops in the field, causing a significant financial loss for the local farmers this year.","translation":"突如其來的霜害摧毀了田裡大部分的農作物，導致當地農民今年損失慘重。","explanation":"名詞用法，指霜害。"}],"related_forms":["frosty"]}

{"headword":"frown","explanation":"名詞「皺眉」；動詞「皺眉」。常用搭配 frown at sb/sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"She <frowned> *at* the difficult math problem, trying to figure out the correct answer before the time ran out.","translation":"她對著那道困難的數學題皺眉，試圖在時間結束前算出正確答案。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示對某事感到困惑或不滿。"},{"sentence":"A deep <frown> *appeared* on his face when he heard the bad news about the cancellation of the school trip.","translation":"當他聽到學校旅行取消的壞消息時，臉上出現了深鎖的眉頭。","explanation":"名詞用法，指皺眉的表情。"},{"sentence":"The teacher <frowned> *upon* students using their mobile phones during class, as it distracted them from learning the lesson.","translation":"老師不贊成學生在課堂上使用手機，因為這會讓他們分心而無法學習課程。","explanation":"片語 frown upon sth 表示「不贊成/反對」。"}],"related_forms":["frowning"]}

{"headword":"frustrate","explanation":"動詞「使受挫/使沮喪」。常以被動語態 be frustrated with/by 表示「對...感到沮喪」。","entries":[{"sentence":"It can <frustrate> *students* when they study hard for an exam but still do not get the grades they expected.","translation":"當學生為考試努力讀書卻仍未得到預期的成績時，這會讓他們感到沮喪。","explanation":"主動用法，指某事讓人感到沮喪。"},{"sentence":"She was <frustrated> *by* the slow internet connection, which made it impossible for her to finish her online assignment on time.","translation":"她對緩慢的網路連線感到沮喪，這讓她無法準時完成線上作業。","explanation":"被動用法，表示對某事感到沮喪。"},{"sentence":"The lack of progress in the project began to <frustrate> *the* team members, leading to many arguments during the weekly meetings.","translation":"專案進度停滯不前開始讓團隊成員感到挫折，導致每週會議中出現許多爭論。","explanation":"主動用法，指挫折感影響了團隊。"}],"related_forms":["frustrated","frustrating","frustration"]}

{"headword":"frustration","explanation":"名詞「挫折/沮喪」。指無法達成目標時產生的情緒。","entries":[{"sentence":"He expressed his <frustration> *with* the new software, which was difficult to use and kept crashing during his work.","translation":"他表達了對新軟體的挫折感，因為它很難使用，而且工作時一直當機。","explanation":"搭配 with，表示對某事感到挫折。"},{"sentence":"Despite her <frustration> *at* not being able to solve the puzzle, she decided to take a break and try again later.","translation":"儘管對無法解開謎題感到沮喪，她還是決定休息一下，稍後再試一次。","explanation":"搭配 at，表示對某事感到沮喪。"},{"sentence":"Learning a new language can be full of <frustration>, but the sense of achievement when you finally speak it is worth it.","translation":"學習一門新語言可能會充滿挫折，但當你最終能開口說時，那種成就感是值得的。","explanation":"指學習過程中的挫折感。"}],"related_forms":["frustrate"]}

{"headword":"fulfill","explanation":"動詞「履行/實現/滿足」。常用搭配 fulfill a dream/promise/requirement。","entries":[{"sentence":"She worked hard to <fulfill> *her* long-held *dream* of becoming a doctor and helping people in need.","translation":"她努力工作以實現她成為醫生並幫助有需要的人的長久夢想。","explanation":"fulfill a dream 表示實現夢想。"},{"sentence":"The company failed to <fulfill> *the* requirements of the contract, so they had to pay a large fine to the client.","translation":"該公司未能履行合約的要求，因此他們必須支付客戶一筆大額罰款。","explanation":"fulfill requirements 表示履行要求。"},{"sentence":"He promised to help his friend, and he was determined to <fulfill> *his* promise no matter how busy he was.","translation":"他答應要幫助朋友，無論多忙，他都決心履行他的承諾。","explanation":"fulfill a promise 表示履行承諾。"}],"related_forms":["fulfillment"]}

{"headword":"functional","explanation":"形容詞「功能的/實用的」。指物品具有實際用途或運作正常。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new office design is very <functional>, with plenty of space for employees to work comfortably and efficiently.","translation":"新的辦公室設計非常實用，有足夠的空間讓員工舒適且有效率地工作。","explanation":"指設計實用。"},{"sentence":"Although the old computer is slow, it is still <functional> *for* basic tasks like writing documents and checking emails.","translation":"雖然這台舊電腦很慢，但對於編寫文件和查看電子郵件等基本任務來說，它仍然可以運作。","explanation":"指機器運作正常。"},{"sentence":"The kitchen was designed to be <functional> *rather* than beautiful, focusing on making cooking easier for the chef.","translation":"廚房的設計旨在實用而非美觀，重點在於讓廚師烹飪更輕鬆。","explanation":"指功能性重於美觀。"}],"related_forms":["function"]}

{"headword":"fundamental","explanation":"形容詞「基本的/根本的」；名詞「基本原則」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Respect is a <fundamental> *part* of any healthy relationship, whether it is between friends, family members, or colleagues.","translation":"尊重是任何健康關係的基本部分，無論是在朋友、家人或同事之間。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指根本的。"},{"sentence":"The teacher explained the <fundamental> *principles* of physics to help students understand how the world around them works.","translation":"老師解釋了物理學的基本原則，以幫助學生了解周遭世界是如何運作的。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指基本原則。"},{"sentence":"We need to make some <fundamental> *changes* to our lifestyle if we want to improve our health and live longer.","translation":"如果我們想要改善健康並活得更久，我們需要對生活方式做出一些根本性的改變。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指根本性的改變。"}],"related_forms":["fundamentally"]}

{"headword":"funeral","explanation":"名詞「葬禮」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many friends and family members attended the <funeral> *to* pay their last respects to the man who had passed away.","translation":"許多親友參加了葬禮，向那位過世的男子致上最後的敬意。","explanation":"指參加葬禮。"},{"sentence":"She felt very sad during the <funeral>, but she was comforted by the kind words of support from her friends.","translation":"她在葬禮期間感到非常難過，但朋友們溫暖的支持話語安慰了她。","explanation":"指在葬禮期間的感受。"},{"sentence":"The family decided to hold a small, private <funeral> *for* their grandfather, inviting only close relatives to the ceremony.","translation":"這家人決定為他們的祖父舉行一場小型、私人的葬禮，只邀請親近的親戚參加儀式。","explanation":"指舉行葬禮。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"furious","explanation":"形容詞「暴怒的/激烈的」。常見搭配 be furious with sb about/at sth。注意與 angry 相比，furious 語氣更強，意指「極度憤怒」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher was <furious> *with* the students who were talking loudly while she was explaining the difficult math problem to the class.","translation":"老師對於在她向全班解釋困難數學題時大聲交談的學生感到非常憤怒。","explanation":"furious with sb 結構，表示對某人生氣。"},{"sentence":"He was <furious> *at* the unfair decision made by the manager, so he decided to quit his job immediately and look for a new one.","translation":"他對經理做出的不公平決定感到非常憤怒，因此他決定立即辭職並尋找新工作。","explanation":"furious at sth 結構，表示對某事感到憤怒。"},{"sentence":"There was a <furious> *debate* among the committee members regarding the new school policy, as everyone had different opinions about the changes.","translation":"委員會成員之間針對新校規進行了激烈的辯論，因為每個人對這些變動都有不同的看法。","explanation":"furious 亦可用於形容活動或爭論「激烈的」。"}],"related_forms":["furiously","fury"]}

{"headword":"furnish","explanation":"動詞「佈置/提供」。常見搭配 furnish a room with furniture 或 furnish sb with sth。在學測中常考「提供資訊/設備」的用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young couple decided to <furnish> their new apartment *with* simple and modern wooden furniture to create a comfortable living space.","translation":"這對年輕夫婦決定用簡單現代的木製家具佈置他們的新公寓，以創造一個舒適的居住空間。","explanation":"furnish sth with sth 結構，表示用某物佈置某處。"},{"sentence":"The witness was asked to <furnish> the police *with* more details about the suspect he saw near the bank yesterday afternoon.","translation":"警方要求目擊者提供更多關於他昨天下午在銀行附近看到的嫌疑人的細節。","explanation":"furnish sb with sth 結構，表示提供某人某物，等同於 provide sb with sth。"},{"sentence":"The hotel room was <furnished> *with* all the necessary equipment, including a high-speed internet connection and a large desk for working.","translation":"飯店房間配備了所有必要的設備，包括高速網路連線和一張適合工作的大桌子。","explanation":"被動語態用法，表示某處配備了某物。"}],"related_forms":["furnished","furnishing","furniture"]}

{"headword":"furthermore","explanation":"副詞「此外/而且」。用於連接兩個觀點，表示補充說明。在寫作中常用於段落銜接，語氣比 moreover 正式。","entries":[{"sentence":"Eating healthy food helps you stay in good shape; <furthermore>, it can improve your concentration and energy levels throughout the busy school day.","translation":"吃健康的食物有助於保持良好的體態；此外，它還能提高你在繁忙校園生活中的專注力和能量水平。","explanation":"用於補充說明前述觀點的好處。"},{"sentence":"The library offers a wide range of books for students to borrow; <furthermore>, it provides a quiet environment for those who need to study.","translation":"圖書館提供各種書籍供學生借閱；此外，它還為需要讀書的人提供了一個安靜的環境。","explanation":"用於列舉圖書館的另一項功能。"},{"sentence":"The project is too expensive for our current budget; <furthermore>, we do not have enough staff members to complete it on time.","translation":"這個計畫對我們目前的預算來說太昂貴了；此外，我們也沒有足夠的員工能按時完成它。","explanation":"用於列舉計畫不可行的另一個原因。"}],"related_forms":["further"]}

{"headword":"gallery","explanation":"名詞「畫廊/美術館」。指展示藝術品的地方。注意拼字，不要與 galaxy (銀河) 混淆。","entries":[{"sentence":"We visited a local art <gallery> to see the latest paintings by young artists, which were very impressive and creative.","translation":"我們參觀了一間當地的藝術畫廊，欣賞年輕藝術家們最新的畫作，那些作品非常令人印象深刻且富有創意。","explanation":"指展示藝術品的場所。"},{"sentence":"The famous <gallery> *in* the city center will hold a special exhibition next month, featuring works from the nineteenth century.","translation":"市中心那間著名的美術館下個月將舉辦一場特別展覽，展出十九世紀的作品。","explanation":"指美術館或畫廊。"},{"sentence":"After walking around the <gallery> for two hours, we felt a bit tired but enjoyed learning about the history of modern art.","translation":"在畫廊逛了兩個小時後，我們感到有點累，但很享受了解現代藝術歷史的過程。","explanation":"指逛畫廊的活動。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"gaze","explanation":"名詞/動詞「凝視/注視」。通常指長時間、專注地看。常見搭配 gaze at sb/sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"The little boy <gazed> *at* the colorful toys in the shop window, wishing he could have one for his upcoming birthday.","translation":"小男孩凝視著櫥窗裡色彩繽紛的玩具，希望他即將到來的生日能得到一個。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示專注地看。"},{"sentence":"She kept her <gaze> *fixed* *on* the stage, waiting for her favorite singer to appear and start the concert.","translation":"她的目光固定在舞台上，等待她最喜歡的歌手出現並開始演唱會。","explanation":"名詞用法，常用搭配 keep one's gaze fixed on sth。"},{"sentence":"It is rude to <gaze> *at* strangers in public, so you should try to avoid staring at people while you are on the bus.","translation":"在公共場合凝視陌生人是不禮貌的，所以你在搭公車時應該盡量避免盯著別人看。","explanation":"動詞用法，提醒社交禮儀。"}],"related_forms":["gazed","gazing"]}

{"headword":"gear","explanation":"名詞「裝備/齒輪」；動詞「使適合/調整」。常見搭配 gear toward/to (使適合...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before going hiking in the mountains, you should make sure you have all the necessary <gear>, such as a map and a flashlight.","translation":"在去山裡健行之前，你應該確保你有所有必要的裝備，例如地圖和手電筒。","explanation":"名詞用法，指裝備。"},{"sentence":"The new English course is <geared> *toward* beginners who want to improve their basic communication skills in a short period.","translation":"這門新的英語課程是為想要在短時間內提升基本溝通技巧的初學者所設計的。","explanation":"動詞片語 be geared toward，表示「專門為...設計/調整」。"},{"sentence":"The bicycle's <gear> system needs to be checked regularly to ensure that you can ride smoothly on different types of roads.","translation":"腳踏車的變速系統需要定期檢查，以確保你能在不同類型的道路上順暢騎行。","explanation":"名詞用法，指機械齒輪或變速系統。"}],"related_forms":["gears"]}

{"headword":"gender","explanation":"名詞「性別」。指社會或文化上的性別區分。注意與 sex (生理性別) 的細微差別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school promotes <gender> *equality* by ensuring that both boys and girls have equal opportunities to participate in all sports activities.","translation":"學校透過確保男孩和女孩都有平等的機會參與所有體育活動，來提倡性別平等。","explanation":"常見搭配 gender equality (性別平等)。"},{"sentence":"In many modern companies, employees are treated equally regardless of their <gender>, age, or background, which creates a better working environment.","translation":"在許多現代公司中，員工無論性別、年齡或背景如何，都受到平等待遇，這創造了更好的工作環境。","explanation":"指不分性別的平等對待。"},{"sentence":"Sociologists often study how <gender> *roles* have changed over the past few decades in different parts of the world.","translation":"社會學家經常研究過去幾十年來，世界各地對性別角色的看法是如何改變的。","explanation":"常見搭配 gender roles (性別角色)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"gene","explanation":"名詞「基因」。指生物遺傳的基本單位。常與 genetic (基因的) 混淆，gene 是名詞，genetic 是形容詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"Scientists have discovered a specific <gene> that may be related to how our bodies respond to certain types of medicine.","translation":"科學家發現了一種特定的基因，可能與我們的身體對某些藥物的反應方式有關。","explanation":"指生物學上的基因。"},{"sentence":"It is interesting to learn how our <genes> determine our physical characteristics, such as eye color and height, from our parents.","translation":"了解我們的基因如何從父母那裡決定我們的身體特徵（例如眼睛顏色和身高）是很有趣的。","explanation":"指遺傳特徵的基因。"},{"sentence":"Through advanced <gene> *research*, doctors hope to find new ways to treat diseases that were once considered impossible to cure.","translation":"透過先進的基因研究，醫生們希望能找到治療過去被認為無法治癒的疾病的新方法。","explanation":"常見搭配 gene research (基因研究)。"}],"related_forms":["genetic","genetics"]}

{"headword":"generation","explanation":"名詞「世代」。指大約 20-30 年的時間跨度，或指同一時期出生的人。常見搭配 the younger/older generation。","entries":[{"sentence":"The gap between the older <generation> and the younger one can sometimes lead to misunderstandings about values and lifestyle choices.","translation":"年長一代與年輕一代之間的代溝，有時會導致對價值觀和生活方式選擇的誤解。","explanation":"指不同年齡層的群體。"},{"sentence":"This traditional craft has been passed down from one <generation> *to* the next for over two hundred years in this small village.","translation":"這項傳統工藝在這個小村莊裡已經傳承了兩百多年，一代傳給下一代。","explanation":"常見搭配 from one generation to the next。"},{"sentence":"The new <generation> of smartphones is much faster and has a better camera than the models released just two years ago.","translation":"新一代的智慧型手機比兩年前發布的型號快得多，且相機功能更好。","explanation":"指產品的新一代。"}],"related_forms":["generational"]}

{"headword":"generosity","explanation":"名詞「慷慨/大方」。形容詞為 generous。注意拼字，結尾是 -osity。","entries":[{"sentence":"The charity was able to build a new school for the children thanks to the <generosity> of many anonymous donors.","translation":"多虧了許多匿名捐贈者的慷慨，慈善機構才能為孩子們蓋一所新學校。","explanation":"指捐贈者的慷慨行為。"},{"sentence":"He is known for his <generosity> *toward* his friends, as he is always willing to help them when they are in trouble.","translation":"他以對朋友慷慨而聞名，因為當朋友遇到困難時，他總是樂於伸出援手。","explanation":"指對人的慷慨。"},{"sentence":"We were touched by the <generosity> of the local people, who welcomed us into their homes and shared their food with us.","translation":"我們被當地人的慷慨所感動，他們歡迎我們進入他們的家，並與我們分享他們的食物。","explanation":"指待人的慷慨。"}],"related_forms":["generous","generously"]}

{"headword":"genius","explanation":"名詞「天才/天賦」。指極高的智力或特殊才能。複數形為 geniuses。","entries":[{"sentence":"Albert Einstein was a <genius> who changed our understanding of the universe with his groundbreaking theories in physics.","translation":"阿爾伯特·愛因斯坦是一位天才，他以其在物理學上的開創性理論改變了我們對宇宙的理解。","explanation":"指具有極高智力的人。"},{"sentence":"She has a <genius> *for* music; she can play any song on the piano after hearing it just once.","translation":"她在音樂方面有天賦；她聽過一次後就能在鋼琴上彈奏任何歌曲。","explanation":"常見搭配 have a genius for sth (在某方面有天賦)。"},{"sentence":"It was a stroke of <genius> to organize the event online, as it allowed more people from different countries to participate.","translation":"將活動改為線上舉辦真是天才之舉，因為這讓更多來自不同國家的人能夠參與。","explanation":"指極佳的點子或策略。"}],"related_forms":["geniuses"]}

{"headword":"genuine","explanation":"形容詞「真正的/真誠的」。指非偽造的，或情感真實的。常見搭配 genuine interest/concern。","entries":[{"sentence":"The antique dealer confirmed that the painting was a <genuine> work of art from the eighteenth century, not a copy.","translation":"古董商證實這幅畫是十八世紀的真跡，而不是複製品。","explanation":"指物品是真的，非偽造。"},{"sentence":"He showed a <genuine> *interest* in learning about other cultures, so he spent a lot of time talking to international students.","translation":"他對了解其他文化表現出真誠的興趣，因此他花了很多時間與國際學生交談。","explanation":"指情感是真誠的。"},{"sentence":"It is hard to find <genuine> *friendship* in a busy city, but he was lucky enough to meet someone he could trust completely.","translation":"在繁忙的城市中很難找到真誠的友誼，但他很幸運地遇到了一個他可以完全信任的人。","explanation":"指友誼是真誠的。"}],"related_forms":["genuinely"]}

{"headword":"germ","explanation":"名詞「細菌/病菌」。指引起疾病的微生物。常用複數 germs。","entries":[{"sentence":"You should wash your hands before eating to kill any <germs> that might have been picked up from touching public surfaces.","translation":"飯前應該洗手，以殺死可能因觸摸公共表面而沾上的細菌。","explanation":"指引起疾病的細菌。"},{"sentence":"The doctor explained that the <germs> spread quickly in crowded places, so it is important to keep the room well-ventilated.","translation":"醫生解釋說細菌在擁擠的地方傳播得很快，所以保持房間通風很重要。","explanation":"指細菌的傳播。"},{"sentence":"Using soap and water is the most effective way to remove <germs> and prevent the spread of common colds and flu.","translation":"使用肥皂和水是去除細菌並預防普通感冒和流感傳播最有效的方法。","explanation":"指衛生習慣與細菌的關係。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"gifted","explanation":"形容詞「有天賦的」。指在某方面具有特殊才能。常與 talented 互換使用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <gifted> student was able to solve the complex math problem in just a few minutes, while others were still struggling.","translation":"那位有天賦的學生能在幾分鐘內解開複雜的數學題，而其他人還在掙扎。","explanation":"指在學習上有天賦。"},{"sentence":"She is a <gifted> *musician* who has won several international awards for her beautiful violin performances.","translation":"她是一位有天賦的音樂家，因其優美的鋼琴演奏而贏得了多項國際獎項。","explanation":"指在藝術上有天賦。"},{"sentence":"The school provides special programs for <gifted> children to help them develop their potential and explore their interests further.","translation":"學校為有天賦的兒童提供特別課程，幫助他們發展潛力並進一步探索興趣。","explanation":"指資優兒童。"}],"related_forms":["gift"]}

{"headword":"gigantic","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。指體積或規模非常大。與 huge, enormous 同義。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <gigantic> statue in the middle of the park was built to honor the heroes who protected the city during the war.","translation":"公園中央那座巨大的雕像，是為了紀念在戰爭期間保護城市的英雄們而建的。","explanation":"指體積巨大。"},{"sentence":"The company faces a <gigantic> *task* of moving all its offices to a new location within just one month.","translation":"公司面臨著在短短一個月內將所有辦公室搬遷到新地點的巨大任務。","explanation":"指任務規模巨大。"},{"sentence":"We were amazed by the <gigantic> size of the whale when it suddenly jumped out of the water near our boat.","translation":"當鯨魚突然從我們船附近的水中跳出來時，我們對它巨大的體型感到震驚。","explanation":"指鯨魚體型巨大。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"giggle","explanation":"名詞/動詞「咯咯笑」。指輕微、抑制不住的笑聲。常帶有羞澀或開心的意味。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two friends couldn't stop <giggling> *at* the funny faces the clown was making during the birthday party.","translation":"這兩個朋友在生日派對上，對小丑做的鬼臉忍不住一直咯咯笑。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示因好笑而咯咯笑。"},{"sentence":"I heard a soft <giggle> coming from the next room, so I knew that my little sister was playing with her toys.","translation":"我聽到隔壁房間傳來一陣輕微的咯咯笑聲，所以我知道我妹妹正在玩她的玩具。","explanation":"名詞用法，指笑聲。"},{"sentence":"It is sometimes hard to suppress a <giggle> when someone tells a joke in a very serious meeting, even if you know it is inappropriate.","translation":"當有人在非常嚴肅的會議中講笑話時，有時很難抑制住咯咯笑，即使你知道那是不恰當的。","explanation":"指在不適當場合想笑的衝動。"}],"related_forms":["giggled","giggling"]}

{"headword":"ginger","explanation":"名詞「薑」。常用於烹飪或作為藥用。亦可形容顏色「薑黃色/紅棕色」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Adding some fresh <ginger> to the soup can help improve the flavor and is also good for your health during the winter.","translation":"在湯裡加一些新鮮的薑可以幫助提升風味，在冬天對你的健康也很有幫助。","explanation":"指烹飪用的薑。"},{"sentence":"She has beautiful <ginger> hair that shines brightly under the sunlight, making her stand out in the crowd.","translation":"她有一頭漂亮的紅棕色頭髮，在陽光下閃閃發光，使她在人群中脫穎而出。","explanation":"指紅棕色的頭髮。"},{"sentence":"Many people drink <ginger> *tea* when they have a cold because it is known to help warm the body and soothe a sore throat.","translation":"許多人在感冒時會喝薑茶，因為眾所周知它有助於溫暖身體並緩解喉嚨痛。","explanation":"常見搭配 ginger tea (薑茶)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"glimpse","explanation":"名詞/動詞「瞥見/一瞥」。指短暫地看一眼。常見搭配 catch a glimpse of sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"I managed to catch a <glimpse> *of* the famous actor as he was getting into his car after the movie premiere.","translation":"在電影首映後，那位著名演員上車時，我設法瞥見了他一眼。","explanation":"常見搭配 catch a glimpse of sth (瞥見某物)。"},{"sentence":"The short documentary gave us a brief <glimpse> *into* the daily lives of people living in remote mountain villages.","translation":"這部短紀錄片讓我們簡短地一窺住在偏遠山村人們的日常生活。","explanation":"指對某事物的初步了解。"},{"sentence":"She <glimpsed> a shadow moving in the garden, but when she looked again, there was nothing there.","translation":"她瞥見花園裡有個影子在移動，但當她再看一次時，那裡什麼也沒有。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示瞥見。"}],"related_forms":["glimpsed","glimpsing"]}

{"headword":"globe","explanation":"名詞「地球儀/全球」。指球狀模型或指整個世界。常見搭配 around the globe (全球)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher used a large <globe> to show the students where different countries are located and how they relate to each other.","translation":"老師用一個大的地球儀向學生展示不同國家位於何處，以及它們彼此之間的相對位置。","explanation":"指地球儀。"},{"sentence":"The internet has connected people from all over the <globe>, allowing them to share information and ideas instantly.","translation":"網際網路連結了來自全球各地的人們，讓他們能即時分享資訊與想法。","explanation":"指全世界。"},{"sentence":"Environmental issues are a concern for people *around* the <globe>, as climate change affects everyone regardless of where they live.","translation":"環境議題是全球人們所關心的，因為氣候變遷影響著每一個人，無論他們住在何處。","explanation":"常見搭配 around the globe (全球)。"}],"related_forms":["global"]}

{"headword":"glorious","explanation":"形容詞「光榮的/壯麗的」。指極好的、令人讚嘆的，或與榮耀相關的。","entries":[{"sentence":"We spent a <glorious> afternoon walking along the beach, enjoying the warm sunshine and the beautiful view of the ocean.","translation":"我們在海邊度過了一個美好的下午，享受著溫暖的陽光和美麗的海景。","explanation":"指極好的、美好的。"},{"sentence":"The team achieved a <glorious> *victory* in the final game, making all their hard work and training over the past year worthwhile.","translation":"球隊在決賽中取得了光榮的勝利，讓他們過去一年所有的努力和訓練都變得值得。","explanation":"指光榮的勝利。"},{"sentence":"The sunset over the mountains was truly <glorious>, with colors of orange and purple filling the entire sky.","translation":"山上的日落景象真是壯麗，橘色和紫色的光芒填滿了整個天空。","explanation":"指壯麗的景象。"}],"related_forms":["glory"]}

{"headword":"goods","explanation":"名詞「商品/貨物」，恆為複數形。常見搭配：consumer goods (消費品), stolen goods (贓物)。注意不可單數使用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The store offers a wide variety of *consumer* <goods>, ranging from fresh vegetables to high-quality electronic devices for local residents.","translation":"這家商店為當地居民提供各式各樣的消費品，從新鮮蔬菜到高品質電子設備應有盡有。","explanation":"consumer goods 為常見搭配，指一般大眾購買的商品。"},{"sentence":"The police searched the warehouse and successfully *recovered* the *stolen* <goods> that were taken from the jewelry store last week.","translation":"警方搜索了倉庫，並成功找回了上週從珠寶店被偷走的贓物。","explanation":"stolen goods 指被竊取的貨物，常與 recover 或 find 搭配。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"gown","explanation":"名詞「禮服/長袍」。常指正式場合穿著的長裙 (evening gown) 或畢業典禮穿的學位袍 (graduation gown)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young actress wore a beautiful *evening* <gown> to the film festival, attracting the attention of many photographers on the red carpet.","translation":"那位年輕女演員穿著一件美麗的晚禮服參加影展，在紅地毯上吸引了許多攝影師的目光。","explanation":"evening gown 指正式晚宴穿的長禮服。"},{"sentence":"All the students were required to wear their *graduation* <gown> and cap during the ceremony to receive their diplomas on stage.","translation":"所有學生在典禮期間都被要求穿上畢業袍和學士帽，以便在台上領取畢業證書。","explanation":"graduation gown 指畢業典禮穿的學位袍。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"grace","explanation":"名詞「優雅/恩典」；動詞「使優雅/增色」。常見片語：with grace (優雅地), fall from grace (失寵)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ballerina moved across the stage *with* such <grace> that the entire audience was completely captivated by her performance.","translation":"芭蕾舞者在舞台上移動的姿態如此優雅，讓全場觀眾都被她的表演深深吸引。","explanation":"with grace 為固定用法，形容動作優雅。"},{"sentence":"Her presence <graced> the *charity event*, making the night even more special for all the guests who attended.","translation":"她的出席為慈善活動增色不少，讓所有參加的賓客都覺得那個夜晚更加特別。","explanation":"動詞用法，指使某場合因某人的出現而更顯光彩。"}],"related_forms":["graces","graced","gracing"]}

{"headword":"graceful","explanation":"形容詞「優雅的」。常用於形容人的動作、姿態或外表。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite her age, the old lady still maintained a <graceful> *posture* and walked with confidence in the park every morning.","translation":"儘管年事已高，這位老太太依然保持著優雅的姿態，每天早上都自信地在公園散步。","explanation":"graceful posture 指優雅的姿勢。"},{"sentence":"The swan made a <graceful> *movement* across the calm lake, creating a peaceful scene for the tourists nearby.","translation":"天鵝在平靜的湖面上優雅地移動，為附近的遊客創造了一幅寧靜的景象。","explanation":"形容動作優雅，與 movement 搭配。"}],"related_forms":["gracefully"]}

{"headword":"gracious","explanation":"形容詞「親切的/和藹的」。常用於形容對人友善、有禮貌，特別是地位較高者對人親切。","entries":[{"sentence":"The host was very <gracious> *to* all the guests, ensuring that everyone felt welcome and comfortable throughout the dinner party.","translation":"主人對所有賓客都非常親切，確保每個人在晚宴期間都感到受歡迎且舒適。","explanation":"gracious to sb 指對某人親切。"},{"sentence":"She gave a <gracious> *smile* when she accepted the award, showing her appreciation for the support she received from her team.","translation":"她在領獎時露出親切的微笑，表達對團隊支持的感謝。","explanation":"gracious smile 指親切的微笑。"}],"related_forms":["graciously"]}

{"headword":"graduation","explanation":"名詞「畢業」。常見搭配：graduation ceremony (畢業典禮), graduation cap (學士帽)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students feel both excited and nervous about their future as they prepare for their upcoming <graduation> *ceremony* next month.","translation":"許多學生在準備下個月即將到來的畢業典禮時，對未來感到既興奮又緊張。","explanation":"graduation ceremony 為固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"After four years of hard work, he finally reached his <graduation> *day* and felt proud of everything he had achieved.","translation":"經過四年的努力，他終於迎來了畢業日，並對自己所達成的一切感到驕傲。","explanation":"graduation day 指畢業當天。"}],"related_forms":["graduate"]}

{"headword":"grammar","explanation":"名詞「文法」。注意拼字結尾是 -ar，非 -er。","entries":[{"sentence":"Learning English <grammar> *rules* can be challenging, but it is essential for writing clear and professional emails in the workplace.","translation":"學習英文文法規則可能很有挑戰性，但這對於在職場上撰寫清晰且專業的電子郵件至關重要。","explanation":"grammar rules 指文法規則。"},{"sentence":"The teacher corrected the <grammar> *mistakes* in my essay and explained how to improve my sentence structure for better flow.","translation":"老師糾正了我作文中的文法錯誤，並解釋如何改善句型結構以增加流暢度。","explanation":"grammar mistakes 指文法錯誤。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"grammatical","explanation":"形容詞「文法上的」。常用於描述錯誤或結構。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before submitting your report, please check it carefully for any <grammatical> *errors* that might affect the quality of your writing.","translation":"在提交報告之前，請仔細檢查是否有任何可能影響寫作品質的文法錯誤。","explanation":"grammatical errors 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The student struggled to form a <grammatical> *sentence* in his first attempt at speaking a foreign language during class.","translation":"這名學生在課堂上第一次嘗試說外語時，很難組成一個文法正確的句子。","explanation":"grammatical sentence 指文法正確的句子。"}],"related_forms":["grammatically"]}

{"headword":"graph","explanation":"名詞「圖表/曲線圖」；動詞「用圖表表示」。常見搭配：bar graph (長條圖), line graph (折線圖)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <graph> *shows* a steady increase in the company's sales over the past twelve months, indicating a successful marketing strategy.","translation":"圖表顯示過去十二個月公司銷售額穩定成長，顯示行銷策略相當成功。","explanation":"graph shows 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"It is helpful to <graph> the *data* so that we can easily identify the trends and patterns in the research results.","translation":"將數據繪製成圖表很有幫助，這樣我們就能輕鬆識別研究結果中的趨勢和模式。","explanation":"動詞用法，指將數據繪製成圖表。"}],"related_forms":["graphs","graphed","graphing"]}

{"headword":"grateful","explanation":"形容詞「感激的」。常用搭配：be grateful to sb for sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"I am deeply <grateful> *to* my teacher for all the guidance and support she provided during my preparation for the exam.","translation":"我非常感激老師在我準備考試期間所提供的所有指導與支持。","explanation":"grateful to sb for sth 為固定句型。"},{"sentence":"The volunteers were <grateful> *for* the donations from the community, which helped them provide more food for the homeless.","translation":"志工們很感激社區的捐款，這幫助他們為遊民提供了更多的食物。","explanation":"grateful for sth 指對某事感到感激。"}],"related_forms":["gratefully"]}

{"headword":"gratitude","explanation":"名詞「感激之情」。常與 express 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"She wanted to *express* her <gratitude> *to* the doctors who saved her life by sending them a thank-you card.","translation":"她想透過寄送感謝卡，表達她對救了她一命的醫生的感激之情。","explanation":"express gratitude to sb 為固定用法。"},{"sentence":"The students showed their <gratitude> *by* preparing a small gift for their coach at the end of the sports season.","translation":"學生們在運動賽季結束時，透過準備一份小禮物給教練來表達他們的感激之情。","explanation":"show gratitude by doing sth 指透過某行動表達感激。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"grave","explanation":"名詞「墳墓」；形容詞「嚴重的/嚴肅的」。注意形容詞用法在 GSAT 常考。","entries":[{"sentence":"The country is facing a <grave> *situation* due to the sudden economic crisis, and the government is taking urgent measures.","translation":"由於突如其來的經濟危機，該國正面臨嚴峻的局勢，政府正在採取緊急措施。","explanation":"grave situation 指嚴重的局勢。"},{"sentence":"He visited his grandfather's <grave> *in* the cemetery to pay his respects on the anniversary of his passing.","translation":"他在祖父逝世週年時前往墓園探視祖父的墳墓，以表達他的敬意。","explanation":"名詞用法，指墳墓。"}],"related_forms":["gravely"]}

{"headword":"greasy","explanation":"形容詞「油膩的」。常用於形容食物或表面。","entries":[{"sentence":"Eating too much <greasy> *food* can lead to health problems, such as high cholesterol and weight gain over time.","translation":"吃太多油膩的食物會導致健康問題，例如長期的膽固醇過高和體重增加。","explanation":"greasy food 指油膩的食物。"},{"sentence":"The kitchen floor became <greasy> *after* the cooking accident, so we had to clean it thoroughly with soap and water.","translation":"烹飪意外發生後，廚房地板變得油膩膩的，所以我們必須用肥皂和水徹底清理乾淨。","explanation":"形容表面油膩。"}],"related_forms":["grease"]}

{"headword":"greeting","explanation":"名詞「問候/招呼」。常用複數 greetings 表「問候語」。","entries":[{"sentence":"He offered a *warm* <greeting> *to* his colleagues when he walked into the office this morning to start the day.","translation":"他今天早上走進辦公室開始一天的工作時，給了同事們一個溫暖的問候。","explanation":"warm greeting 指溫暖的問候。"},{"sentence":"Please send my *best* <greetings> *to* your family when you see them at the party this weekend.","translation":"這個週末你在派對上見到你家人時，請代我向他們問好。","explanation":"send one's greetings to sb 為固定用法。"}],"related_forms":["greet"]}

{"headword":"grief","explanation":"名詞「悲傷/悲痛」。常用於形容失去親人後的強烈情緒。","entries":[{"sentence":"She was *overcome* *with* <grief> after hearing the news of her best friend's sudden death in the accident.","translation":"在聽到她最好的朋友在事故中突然過世的消息後，她陷入了極度的悲痛之中。","explanation":"overcome with grief 為固定搭配，指悲痛欲絕。"},{"sentence":"It takes time to *deal* *with* <grief>, and it is important to talk to someone you trust during difficult times.","translation":"處理悲傷需要時間，在困難時期與你信任的人交談是很重要的。","explanation":"deal with grief 指處理悲傷情緒。"}],"related_forms":["grieve"]}

{"headword":"grind","explanation":"動詞「研磨/苦幹」；名詞「苦差事」。常見搭配：grind coffee beans (磨咖啡豆)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chef likes to <grind> *fresh* coffee beans every morning to make the best cup of coffee for his customers.","translation":"主廚喜歡每天早上研磨新鮮咖啡豆，為他的顧客製作最棒的咖啡。","explanation":"grind coffee beans 指磨咖啡豆。"},{"sentence":"Studying for the final exams is a real <grind>, but it is necessary if you want to get good grades.","translation":"準備期末考真的是件苦差事，但如果你想拿到好成績，這是必要的過程。","explanation":"名詞用法，指枯燥乏味的苦差事。"}],"related_forms":["ground"]}

{"headword":"guarantee","explanation":"動詞「保證」；名詞「保證/保固」。常見搭配：guarantee that... (保證...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company <guarantees> *that* all their products are made of high-quality materials and will last for many years.","translation":"該公司保證他們所有的產品都是由高品質材料製成，並且可以使用多年。","explanation":"guarantee that... 為常見句型。"},{"sentence":"This laptop comes with a *one-year* <guarantee>, so you can get it repaired for free if any problems occur.","translation":"這台筆記型電腦附有一年保固，所以如果發生任何問題，你可以免費維修。","explanation":"one-year guarantee 指一年保固。"}],"related_forms":["guaranteed","guaranteeing"]}

{"headword":"guardian","explanation":"名詞「監護人/守護者」。指法律上的監護人或保護某人事物的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"As a minor, she needs her <guardian> *to* sign the consent form before she can participate in the school trip.","translation":"身為未成年人，她需要監護人在同意書上簽名，才能參加學校旅行。","explanation":"指法律上的監護人。"},{"sentence":"Parents are the natural <guardians> *of* their children, responsible for their safety and well-being as they grow up.","translation":"父母是孩子天生的守護者，負責他們成長過程中的安全與福祉。","explanation":"指守護者，與 of 搭配。"}],"related_forms":["guard"]}

{"headword":"guilt","explanation":"名詞「罪惡感/內疚」。常與 feel 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"He felt a deep sense of <guilt> *for* not being there when his brother needed his help the most.","translation":"他因為在兄弟最需要幫助時不在場，而感到深深的內疚。","explanation":"feel a sense of guilt for sth 為固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"The criminal could not hide his <guilt> *when* the police presented the evidence found at the crime scene.","translation":"當警方出示在犯罪現場發現的證據時，罪犯無法掩飾他的罪行。","explanation":"指罪行或內疚感。"}],"related_forms":["guilty"]}

{"headword":"guilty","explanation":"形容詞「有罪的/內疚的」。常見搭配：be guilty of (犯了...罪)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The jury found the man <guilty> *of* stealing the money from the bank after reviewing all the evidence presented.","translation":"陪審團在審閱所有提出的證據後，判定該男子犯有從銀行竊取金錢的罪行。","explanation":"be guilty of sth 為固定用法。"},{"sentence":"I felt <guilty> *about* forgetting my best friend's birthday, so I bought her a gift to make it up to her.","translation":"我因為忘記了最好朋友的生日而感到內疚，所以我買了禮物來補償她。","explanation":"feel guilty about sth 指對某事感到內疚。"}],"related_forms":["guilt"]}
